304:

306:         setActiveTask((prev) =>
307:           prev

309:               ...prev,
310:               userStatuses: {
311:                 ...prev.userStatuses,

315:             }
316:             : null

320:           const accumulatedTime = status.totalWorkTime || 0;
321:           activeTasksService.startTask(taskId, userId, accumulatedTime);
322:           setUserTaskTime(Math.floor(accumulatedTime / 1000));
323:         }
324:

326:           setUserTaskTime(Math.floor((status.totalWorkTime || 0) / 1000));

335:   const handleCreateSubmission = async (
336:     taskId: string,
337:     submissionData: Omit<
338:       Submission,
339:       "id" | "taskId" | "userId" | "createdAt" | "updatedAt"
340:     >
341:   ) => {
342:     if (!currentUser) return;
343:     try {
344:       const now = new Date().toISOString();
345:       const newSubmission: Submission = {
346:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
347:         taskId,
348:         userId: currentUser.id,
349:         items: submissionData.items,
350:         createdAt: now,
351:         updatedAt: now,
352:         status: "pending",
353:       };
354: 
355:       let totalWorkTime = 0;
356:       const currentTask = tasks.find((t) => t.id === taskId);
357:       const currentUserStatus = currentTask?.userStatuses?.[currentUser.id];
358: 
359:       if (activeTasksService.isTaskActive(taskId, currentUser.id)) {
360:         totalWorkTime = activeTasksService.getCurrentTime(
361:           taskId,
362:           currentUser.id
363:         );
364:         activeTasksService.stopTask(taskId, currentUser.id);
365:       } else if (currentUserStatus) {
366:         totalWorkTime = currentUserStatus.totalWorkTime || 0;
367:         if (
368:           currentUserStatus.status === "in_progress" &&
369:           currentUserStatus.workStartTime
370:         ) {
371:           const startTime = new Date(currentUserStatus.workStartTime).getTime();
372:           const sessionTime = Date.now() - startTime;
373:           totalWorkTime += sessionTime;
374:         }
375:       }
376: 
377:       const log = createLog(currentUser.id, "SUBMISSION_CREATED");
378:       await addSubmissionToTaskInDb(taskId, newSubmission, log);
379: 
380:       await handleUpdateUserTaskStatus(taskId, currentUser.id, {
381:         status: "submitted",
382:         submittedAt: now,
383:         totalWorkTime: totalWorkTime,
384:         currentWorkTime: 0,
385:         workStartTime: null,
386:       });
387: 
388:       if (activeTask && activeTask.id === taskId) {
389:         setActiveTask(null);
390:         setAppView("tasks");
391:       }
392:       setSelectedTaskDetails(null);
393:     } catch (e) {
394:       console.error("Error creating submission:", e);
395:       alert("حدث خطأ أثناء حفظ التسليم. الرجاء المحاولة مرة أخرى.");
396:     }
397:   };

427:           );
428:           return { ...prev, submissions: updatedSubmissions };

430:       }

437:   const handleUpdateSubmissionStatus = async (
438:     taskId: string,
439:     submissionId: string,
440:     status: "approved" | "rejected",
441:     reviewerNotes?: string
442:   ) => {
443:     if (!currentUser) return;
444:     try {
445:       const task = tasks.find((t) => t.id === taskId);
446:       if (!task) return;
447: 
448:       const submission = task.submissions?.find((s) => s.id === submissionId);
449:       if (!submission) return;
450: 
451:       const userTaskStatus = task.userStatuses?.[submission.userId];
452:       const userHasCompletedTask = userTaskStatus?.status === "completed";
453: 
454:       if (status === "approved" && !userHasCompletedTask) {
455:         const userToReward = users.find((u) => u.id === submission.userId);
456:         if (userToReward) {
457:           const today = new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0];
458:           // Fix: Use totalPoints instead of points, and remove pointsHistory which is not in User type
459:           const newUserPoints = (userToReward.totalPoints || 0) + 5;
460: 
461:           const updatedUser: User = {
462:             ...userToReward,
463:             totalPoints: newUserPoints,
464:           };
465: 
466:           // Note: pointsHistory is handled by pointsHistoryService below, not in the User object directly
467: 
468:           await updateUserInDb(updatedUser);
469: 
470:           const currentPoints = await pointsHistoryService.getDailyPoints(
471:             submission.userId,
472:             today
473:           );
474: 
475:           const updatedTaskPoints = (currentPoints?.taskPoints || 0) + 5;
476:           const updatedCompletedTasks = (currentPoints?.completedTasks || 0) + 1;
477:           const updatedTotalPoints = (currentPoints?.totalPoints || 0) + 5;
478: 
479:           await pointsHistoryService.updatePointsManually(
480:             submission.userId,
481:             today,
482:             {
483:               taskPoints: updatedTaskPoints,
484:               completedTasks: updatedCompletedTasks,
485:               totalPoints: updatedTotalPoints,
486:               attendancePoints: currentPoints?.attendancePoints || 0,
487:               activityPoints: currentPoints?.activityPoints || 0,
488:               workMinutes: currentPoints?.workMinutes || 0,
489:               checkinClicks: currentPoints?.checkinClicks || 0,
490:               attended: currentPoints?.attended || false,
491:             }
492:           );
493: 
494:           setUsers((prevUsers) =>
495:             prevUsers.map((u) => (u.id === submission.userId ? updatedUser : u))
496:           );
497:         }
498:       }
499: 
500:       const updatedSubmission: Submission = {
501:         ...submission,
502:         status,
503:         reviewerNotes,
504:         reviewedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
505:         reviewedBy: currentUser.id,
506:       };
507: 
508:       const log = createLog(
509:         currentUser.id,
510:         "SUBMISSION_REVIEWED",
511:         submission.status,
512:         status
513:       );
514: 
515:       const updatedTask: Task = {
516:         ...task,
517:         submissions:
518:           task.submissions?.map((s) =>
519:             s.id === submissionId ? updatedSubmission : s
520:           ) || [],
521:         logs: [...task.logs, log],
522:         updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
523:       };
524: 
525:       const userId = submission.userId;
526:       const userStatus = task.userStatuses?.[userId];
527: 
528:       if (userStatus) {
529:         if (status === "approved") {
530:           updatedTask.userStatuses = {
531:             ...task.userStatuses,
532:             [userId]: {
533:               ...userStatus,
534:               status: "completed",
535:               completedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
536:               totalWorkTime: userStatus.totalWorkTime || 0,
537:               currentWorkTime: 0,
538:               workStartTime: null,
539:             },
540:           };
541:           if (activeTask?.id === taskId && userId === currentUser.id) {
542:             activeTasksService.stopTask(taskId, userId);
543:           }
544:         } else if (status === "rejected") {
545:           updatedTask.userStatuses = {
546:             ...task.userStatuses,
547:             [userId]: {
548:               ...userStatus,
549:               status: "rejected",
550:               completedAt: undefined,
551:               totalWorkTime: userStatus.totalWorkTime || 0,
552:               currentWorkTime: 0,
553:               workStartTime: null,
554:             },
555:           };
556:         }
557:       }
558: 
559:       setTasks((prevTasks) =>
560:         prevTasks.map((t) => (t.id === taskId ? updatedTask : t))
561:       );
562: 
563:       if (selectedTaskDetails?.id === taskId) {
564:         setSelectedTaskDetails(updatedTask);
565:       }
566: 
567:       await updateTaskInDb(updatedTask);
568:     } catch (error) {
569:       console.error("❌ خطأ في handleUpdateSubmissionStatus:", error);
570:       alert("حدث خطأ أثناء تحديث حالة التسليم");

667:     newValue?: string
668:   ): ActivityLog => {
669:     return {

671:       userId,
672:       action,

675:       ...(newValue !== undefined && { newValue }),

687:     newStatus: TaskStatus
688:   ) => {

691:     if (!task) return;
692:

694:       setRejectingTask(task);
695:       return;
696:     }
697:

699:       currentUser.id,
700:       "STATUS_CHANGED",
701:       task.status,
702:       newStatus
703:     );
704:     const updatedTask: Task = {
705:       ...task,
706:       status: newStatus,
707:       logs: [...task.logs, log],
708:       updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
709:     };
710: 
711:     if (newStatus === "COMPLETED") {
712:       updatedTask.completedAt = new Date().toISOString();
713:       if (currentUser) activeTasksService.stopTask(taskId, currentUser.id);
714:     }
715: 
716:     if (task.status === "REJECTED" && newStatus === "IN_PROGRESS") {
717:       updatedTask.rejectReason = "";
718:     }
719: 
720:     if (newStatus === "IN_PROGRESS") {
721:       updatedTask.workStartTime = new Date().toISOString();
722:       setActiveTask(updatedTask);
723:       setAppView("sourcing");

======= consolidate.js =======
1: const fs = require('fs');
2: const path = require('path');
3: 
4: const baseDir = '.';
5: const outputFile = 'Consolidated_Project_Code.md';
6: const extensions = ['.tsx', '.ts', '.html', '.css', '.json'];
7: const excludeDirs = ['node_modules', '.git', 'dist', 'build', '.next', '.vite'];
8: const excludeFiles = ['package-lock.json', outputFile, 'consolidate.js'];
9: 
10: let output = '# Full Project Source Code - Smart Product Search Platform\n\n';
11: output += 'هذا الملف يحتوي على جميع الأكواد البرمجية للمشروع مع شرح وظيفة كل ملف.\n\n';
12: 
13: function walkDir(dir) {
14:     const files = fs.readdirSync(dir);
15:     
16:     files.forEach(file => {
17:         const filePath = path.join(dir, file);
18:         const stat = fs.statSync(filePath);
19:         
20:         if (stat.isDirectory()) {
21:             if (!excludeDirs.includes(file)) {
22:                 walkDir(filePath);
23:             }
24:         } else {
25:             const ext = path.extname(file);
26:             if (extensions.includes(ext) && !excludeFiles.includes(file)) {
27:                 console.log(`Processing: ${filePath}`);
28:                 const content = fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf8');
29:                 const relPath = path.relative(baseDir, filePath);
30:                 
31:                 output += `## File: ${relPath}\n\n`;
32:                 
33:                 let explanation = "الوصف:";
34:                 if (relPath.includes('services')) explanation += " خدمة خلفية (Service) للتعامل مع البيانات.";
35:                 if (relPath.includes('components')) explanation += " مكون واجهة مستخدم (Component).";
36:                 if (relPath.includes('contexts')) explanation += " سياق لإدارة الحالة (Context).";
37:                 if (relPath.includes('types')) explanation += " تعريفات لأنواع البيانات (Types).";
38:                 
39:                 output += `${explanation}\n\n`;
40:                 output += '```' + ext.slice(1) + '\n';
41:                 
42:                 // Add line numbers
43:                 const lines = content.split('\n');
44:                 lines.forEach((line, index) => {
45:                     output += `${index + 1}: ${line}\n`;
46:                 });
47:                 
48:                 output += '\n```\n\n---\n\n';
49:             }
50:         }
51:     });
52: }
53: 
54: try {
55:     walkDir(baseDir);
56:     fs.writeFileSync(outputFile, output);
57:     console.log(`Successfully generated ${outputFile}`);
58: } catch (err) {
59:     console.error('Error:', err);
60: }


======= consolidate_v6.js =======
1: const fs = require('fs');
2: const path = require('path');
3: 
4: const outputFile = 'c:\\Users\\asus\\Desktop\\REAL_V6.txt';
5: const logFile = 'c:\\Users\\asus\\Desktop\\DUMP_LOG_V6.txt';
6: 
7: function log(msg) {
8:     fs.appendFileSync(logFile, msg + '\n');
9:     console.log(msg);
10: }
11: 
12: const excludeDirs = ['node_modules', '.git', 'dist', 'build', '.next', '.vite'];
13: const extensions = ['.ts', '.tsx', '.css', '.html', '.json', '.js', '.jsx'];
14: 
15: function walkDir(dir, fileList = []) {
16:   const files = fs.readdirSync(dir);
17:   files.forEach(file => {
18:     const filePath = path.join(dir, file);
19:     const stat = fs.statSync(filePath);
20:     if (stat.isDirectory()) {
21:       if (!excludeDirs.includes(file)) {
22:         walkDir(filePath, fileList);
23:       }
24:     } else {
25:       if (extensions.includes(path.extname(file))) {
26:         fileList.push(filePath);
27:       }
28:     }
29:   });
30:   return fileList;
31: }
32: 
33: try {
34:     const rootDir = process.cwd();
35:     log(`Starting consolidation in ${rootDir}...`);
36:     const files = walkDir(rootDir);
37:     log(`Found ${files.length} files.`);
38: 
39:     if (fs.existsSync(outputFile)) fs.unlinkSync(outputFile);
40:     fs.writeFileSync(outputFile, '# THE REAL COMPLETE CODEBASE V6\n');
41: 
42:     files.forEach((file, index) => {
43:       const relativePath = path.relative(rootDir, file);
44:       if (relativePath.includes('REAL_V6') || relativePath.includes('DUMP_LOG')) return;
45:       
46:       log(`Processing: ${relativePath}`);
47:       const content = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8');
48:       fs.appendFileSync(outputFile, `\n\n--- FILE: ${relativePath} ---\n`);
49:       const lines = content.split('\n');
50:       lines.forEach((line, idx) => {
51:         fs.appendFileSync(outputFile, `${idx + 1}: ${line}\n`);
52:       });
53:     });
54:     log('DONE SUCCESSFULLY!');
55: } catch (err) {
56:     log('ERROR: ' + err.message);
57: }


======= dump_code.js =======
1: const fs = require('fs');
2: const path = require('path');
3: const baseDir = "c:\\Users\\asus\\Desktop\\ثابت\\منصة\\smart-product-search-platform";
4: const outFile = path.join(baseDir, "Full_Project_Codebase_Literal.md");

6: const excludeDirs = ['node_modules', '.git', 'dist', 'build', '.gemini'];

8: let stream = fs.createWriteStream(outFile, { encoding: 'utf8' });

10: 
11: function walk(dir) {
12:     let files = fs.readdirSync(dir);
13:     for (let f of files) {
14:         let fullPath = path.join(dir, f);
15:         if (fs.statSync(fullPath).isDirectory()) {
16:             if (!excludeDirs.includes(f)) {
17:                 walk(fullPath);
18:             }
19:         } else {
20:             if (exts.includes(path.extname(fullPath))) {
21:                 let relPath = path.relative(baseDir, fullPath);
22:                 stream.write(`\n\n## File: ${relPath}\n`);
23:                 stream.write('```' + (path.extname(fullPath) === '.tsx' ? 'tsx' : 'typescript') + '\n');
24:                 let content = fs.readFileSync(fullPath, 'utf8');
25:                 let lines = content.split('\n');
26:                 for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
27:                     stream.write(`${i + 1}: ${lines[i]}\n`);
28:                 }
29:                 stream.write('```\n---\n');
30:             }
31:         }
32:     }
33: }
34: try {
35:     walk(baseDir);
36:     stream.end();

======= extractor.js =======
1: const fs = require('fs');
2: const path = require('path');
3: 
4: const baseDir = process.cwd();
5: const outFile = path.join(baseDir, "The_Ultimate_Literal_Codebase.md");
6: const exts = ['.tsx', '.ts'];
7: const excludeDirs = ['node_modules', '.git', 'dist', 'build', '.gemini'];
8: 
9: // We do this completely synchronously to avoid missing anything
10: function walkSync(dir, fileList) {
11:   const files = fs.readdirSync(dir);
12:   for (const file of files) {
13:     const fullPath = path.join(dir, file);
14:     if (fs.statSync(fullPath).isDirectory()) {
15:       if (!excludeDirs.includes(file)) {
16:         walkSync(fullPath, fileList);
17:       }
18:     } else {
19:       if (exts.includes(path.extname(file))) {
20:         fileList.push(fullPath);
21:       }
22:     }
23:   }
24:   return fileList;
25: }
26: 
27: try {
28:   const allFiles = walkSync(baseDir, []);
29:   let content = '# The Ultimate Project Codebase\n\n';
30:   
31:   for (const file of allFiles) {
32:     const relPath = path.relative(baseDir, file);
33:     content += `\n\n## File: ${relPath}\n`;
34:     content += '```' + (path.extname(file) === '.tsx' ? 'tsx' : 'typescript') + '\n';
35:     
36:     const fileContent = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8');
37:     const lines = fileContent.split('\n');
38:     for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
39:         // Strip out carriage returns if present to avoid mixed line endings in the output
40:         content += `${i + 1}: ${lines[i].replace(/\r/g, '')}\n`;
41:     }
42:     content += '```\n---\n';
43:   }
44:   
45:   fs.writeFileSync(outFile, content, 'utf8');
46:   console.log(`Successfully wrote ${allFiles.length} files to ${outFile}`);
47: } catch (e) {
48:   console.error("Error generating codebase:", e);
49: }


======= final_consolidate.js =======
1: const fs = require('fs');
2: const path = require('path');
3: 
4: const outFile = 'THE_ULTIMATE_CODEBASE.md';
5: const baseDir = '.';
6: const excludes = ['node_modules', '.git', 'dist', 'build', '.gemini', '.agent'];
7: const extensions = ['.ts', '.tsx', '.css', '.html', '.json'];
8: 
9: // Clear/Create file
10: fs.writeFileSync(outFile, '# THE ULTIMATE PROJECT CODEBASE (LITERAL DUMP)\n\n');
11: fs.appendFileSync(outFile, '> This file contains the complete source code of the project, line by line, as requested.\n\n---\n');
12: 
13: function walk(dir) {
14:     const files = fs.readdirSync(dir);
15:     for (const file of files) {
16:         const fullPath = path.join(dir, file);
17:         const stats = fs.statSync(fullPath);
18: 
19:         if (stats.isDirectory()) {
20:             if (!excludes.includes(file)) {
21:                 walk(fullPath);
22:             }
23:         } else {
24:             const ext = path.extname(file);
25:             if (extensions.includes(ext) && !file.includes('package-lock.json') && !file.includes(outFile)) {
26:                 console.log(`Processing: ${fullPath}`);
27:                 const relativePath = path.relative(baseDir, fullPath);
28:                 const content = fs.readFileSync(fullPath, 'utf8');
29:                 const lines = content.split('\n');
30:                 
31:                 let fileHeader = `\n\n## 📄 File: ${relativePath}\n`;
32:                 fileHeader += `**Path:** \`${fullPath}\`  \n`;
33:                 fileHeader += `**Extension:** \`${ext}\`  \n`;
34:                 fileHeader += `**Lines:** ${lines.length}\n\n`;
35:                 fileHeader += '```' + (ext.slice(1) || 'text') + '\n';
36:                 
37:                 fs.appendFileSync(outFile, fileHeader);
38:                 
39:                 // Writing in chunks to avoid memory issues with very large files
40:                 const chunkedLines = [];
41:                 for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
42:                     chunkedLines.push(`${(i + 1).toString().padStart(4, ' ')} | ${lines[i]}`);
43:                     if (chunkedLines.length > 500) {
44:                         fs.appendFileSync(outFile, chunkedLines.join('\n') + '\n');
45:                         chunkedLines.length = 0;
46:                     }
47:                 }
48:                 if (chunkedLines.length > 0) {
49:                     fs.appendFileSync(outFile, chunkedLines.join('\n') + '\n');
50:                 }
51:                 
52:                 fs.appendFileSync(outFile, '```\n\n---\n');
53:             }
54:         }
55:     }
56: }
57: 
58: try {
59:     walk(baseDir);
60:     console.log(`\n✅ Done! Entire codebase dumped into: ${outFile}`);
61: } catch (err) {
62:     console.error(`\n❌ Error during consolidation:`, err);
63: }

======= components\EmployeeAttendance.tsx =======
1: // components/EmployeeAttendance.tsx
2: import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';

12: export const EmployeeAttendance: React.FC<EmployeeAttendanceProps> = ({ currentUser }) => {

14:   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
15:   const [message, setMessage] = useState<string>('');
16:   const [hasAttended, setHasAttended] = useState(false);
17:   const [timeLeft, setTimeLeft] = useState<number>(0);
18: 
19:   useEffect(() => {
20:     const unsubscribe = attendanceService.subscribeToActiveSession((session) => {
21:       setActiveSession(session);
22:       if (session) {
23:         checkIfAttended(session);
24:         startTimer(session);
25:       }
26:     });
27: 
28:     // تحميل الجلسة النشطة الحالية
29:     attendanceService.getActiveSession().then(session => {
30:       setActiveSession(session);
31:       if (session) {
32:         checkIfAttended(session);
33:         startTimer(session);
34:       }
35:     });
36: 
37:     return unsubscribe;
38:   }, []);
39: 
40:   const checkIfAttended = (session: AttendanceSession) => {
41:     const attended = session.attendees.includes(currentUser.id);
42:     setHasAttended(attended);
43:   };
44: 
45:   const startTimer = (session: AttendanceSession) => {
46:     const startTime = new Date(session.startTime).getTime();
47:     const endTime = startTime + (5 * 60 * 1000);
48:     
49:     const updateTimer = () => {
50:       const now = Date.now();
51:       const remaining = Math.max(0, endTime - now);
52:       setTimeLeft(Math.ceil(remaining / 1000));
53:       
54:       if (remaining > 0) {
55:         setTimeout(updateTimer, 1000);
56:       }
57:     };
58:     
59:     updateTimer();
60:   };
61: 
62:   const handleMarkAttendance = async () => {
63:     if (!activeSession) return;
64:     
65:     try {
66:       setLoading(true);
67:       setMessage('');
68:       
69:       await attendanceService.markAttendance(currentUser.id, activeSession.id);
70:       setHasAttended(true);
71:       setMessage('تم تسجيل حضورك بنجاح! +10 نقاط 🎉');
72:       
73:       setTimeout(() => setMessage(''), 5000);
74:     } catch (error: any) {
75:       setMessage(error.message || 'حدث خطأ أثناء تسجيل الحضور');
76:       setTimeout(() => setMessage(''), 5000);
77:     } finally {
78:       setLoading(false);
79:     }
80:   };
81: 
82:   const formatTime = (seconds: number) => {
83:     const minutes = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
84:     const remainingSeconds = seconds % 60;
85:     return `${minutes}:${remainingSeconds.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
86:   };
87: 
88:   if (!activeSession) {
89:     return (
90:       <div className="animate-fade-in">
91:         <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-6 text-gray-800 dark:text-gray-100">
92:           الحضور والغياب
93:         </h1>
94:         
95:         <div className="bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-2xl p-8 shadow-md border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 text-center">
96:           <div className="text-6xl mb-4">⏰</div>
97:           <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800 dark:text-gray-100 mb-4">
98:             لا توجد جلسة حضور نشطة
99:           </h2>
100:           <p className="text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 text-lg">
101:             انتظر حتى يبدأ المدير جلسة حضور جديدة
102:           </p>
103:         </div>
104:       </div>
105:     );
106:   }
107: 
108:   return (
109:     <div className="animate-fade-in">
110:       <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-6 text-gray-800 dark:text-gray-100">
111:         الحضور والغياب
112:       </h1>
113: 
114:       {/* جلسة الحضور النشطة */}
115:       <div className="bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-md border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 mb-6">
116:         <div className="text-center">
117:           <div className="text-4xl mb-4">📅</div>
118:           <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800 dark:text-gray-100 mb-2">
119:             جلسة حضور نشطة
120:           </h2>
121:           <p className="text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 mb-4">
122:             بدأت منذ {formatDistanceToNow(new Date(activeSession.startTime), { locale: ar, addSuffix: true })}
123:           </p>
124:

131:

135:                 ? 'bg-green-50 dark:bg-green-900/50 border border-green-200 dark:border-green-700 text-green-800 dark:text-green-200'
136:                 : 'bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-900/50 border border-red-200 dark:border-red-700 text-red-800 dark:text-red-200'
137:             }`}>
138:               {message}
139:             </div>
140:           )}

157:             >

======= components\EmployeeNotes.tsx =======

10: const NoteCard: React.FC<{ user: User; onSave: (userId: string, notes: string) => Promise<void> }> = ({ user, onSave }) => {
11:     const [notes, setNotes] = useState(user.notes || '');

13:     const [isDirty, setIsDirty] = useState(false);

16:         setNotes(user.notes || '');

18:     }, [user.notes]);
19:

21:         setIsSaving(true);
22:         try {
23:             await onSave(user.id, notes);

25:         } catch (error) {
26:             console.error("Error saving notes", error);
27:             alert("حدث خطأ أثناء حفظ الملاحظات");
28:         } finally {
29:             setIsSaving(false);
30:         }
31:     };
32: 
33:     const handleChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => {
34:         setNotes(e.target.value);
35:         setIsDirty(true);
36:     }
37: 
38:     return (
39:         <div className="bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-2xl shadow-md border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 p-6 flex flex-col h-full transition-all hover:shadow-lg">

42:                     {user.name.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}
43:                 </div>
44:                 <div>
45:                     <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-800 dark:text-gray-100">{user.name}</h3>
46:                     <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">{user.email}</p>
47:                 </div>
48:             </div>
49: 
50:             <div className="flex-grow">
51:                 <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 mb-2">
52:                     ملاحظات خاصة (سري)
53:                 </label>
54:                 <textarea
55:                     value={notes}
56:                     onChange={handleChange}
57:                     className="w-full h-40 p-3 border border-yellow-200 dark:border-yellow-900/50 rounded-lg bg-yellow-50/50 dark:bg-gray-900 text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-yellow-400 focus:border-transparent resize-none text-sm leading-relaxed shadow-inner"
58:                     placeholder="اكتب ملاحظاتك هنا..."
59:                 />
60:             </div>
61: 
62:             <div className="mt-4 flex justify-end">
63:                 <button
64:                     onClick={handleSave}
65:                     disabled={!isDirty || isSaving}
66:                     className={`px-6 py-2 rounded-lg font-bold transition-all shadow-sm flex items-center gap-2 ${
67:                         !isDirty 
68:                         ? 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-400 cursor-default dark:bg-gray-700 dark:text-gray-500' 
69:                         : 'bg-yellow-500 text-white hover:bg-yellow-600 hover:shadow-md'

======= components\EmployeePointsManagement.tsx =======
1: // components/EmployeePointsManagement.tsx

56:     []

62:   const [showGlobalSettingsModal, setShowGlobalSettingsModal] = useState(false);
63:

98:   const loadGlobalSettings = async () => {

112:     const stats: UserStats = {};
113: 
114:     for (const user of employees) {

116:         const endDate = new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0];
117:         const startDate = new Date();
118:         startDate.setDate(startDate.getDate() - 30);

129:           totalActivityPoints: history.reduce(

131:             0

136:           ),

143:           totalTaskPoints: 0,

181:         activityPoints: dailyPoints?.activityPoints || 0,
182:         taskPoints: dailyPoints?.taskPoints || 0,
183:       });
184:     } catch (error) {
185:       console.error("Error loading user data:", error);
186:     } finally {
187:       setLoading(false);
188:     }
189:   };
190:

192:     // ... (منطق تحميل بيانات جميع المستخدمين كما هو) ...

24: const formatTime = (seconds: number) => {
25:   const h = Math.floor(seconds / 3600)
26:     .toString()
27:     .padStart(2, "0");
28:   const m = Math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60)
29:     .toString()
30:     .padStart(2, "0");
31:   const s = (seconds % 60).toString().padStart(2, "0");
32:   return `${h}:${m}:${s}`;
33: };

66:         .then(() => {
67:           console.log('🔊 تم تشغيل الصوت بنجاح');
68:         })

======= components\LoadingSpinner.tsx =======
1: import React from 'react';
2: 
3: interface LoadingSpinnerProps {
4:   size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';
5:   showText?: boolean;
6: }
7: 
8: export const LoadingSpinner: React.FC<LoadingSpinnerProps> = ({ size = 'lg', showText = true }) => {
9:   const messages = [
10:     "Analyzing product image with AI...",
11:     "Extracting keywords...",
12:     "Searching Chinese marketplaces...",
13:     "Matching prices and results...",
14:     "Finalizing results..."
15:   ];
16:   const [messageIndex, setMessageIndex] = React.useState(0);
17: 
18:   React.useEffect(() => {
19:     if (!showText) return;
20:     const interval = setInterval(() => {
21:       setMessageIndex((prevIndex) => (prevIndex + 1) % messages.length);
22:     }, 2500);
23:     return () => clearInterval(interval);
24:   }, [messages.length, showText]);
25: 
26:   if (size === 'sm') {
27:     return (
28:       <div className="w-5 h-5 border-2 border-white border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin"></div>
29:     );
30:   }
31: 
32:   return (
33:     <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center p-10 bg-white/70 dark:bg-gray-800/70 backdrop-blur-sm rounded-2xl shadow-lg">
34:       <div className={`border-blue-500 border-dashed rounded-full animate-spin ${size === 'md' ? 'w-10 h-10 border-4' : 'w-16 h-16 border-4'}`}></div>
35:       {showText && (
36:         <>
37:           <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-200 mt-6">Searching for Products</h2>
38:           <p className="text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 mt-2 transition-opacity duration-500">{messages[messageIndex]}</p>
39:         </>
40:       )}
41:     </div>
42:   );
43: };

======= components\ProductCard.tsx =======
1: 
2: import React from 'react';
3: import { Product } from '../types';
4: 
5: interface ProductCardProps {
6:   product: Product;
7:   onPreview: (url: string) => void;
8: }
9: 
10: export const ProductCard: React.FC<ProductCardProps> = ({ product, onPreview }) => {
11:   const getSimilarityColor = (similarity: number) => {
12:     if (similarity >= 90) return 'bg-green-100 text-green-800 dark:bg-green-900/50 dark:text-green-300';
13:     if (similarity >= 75) return 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800 dark:bg-yellow-900/50 dark:text-yellow-300';
14:     return 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-800 dark:bg-orange-900/50 dark:text-orange-300';
15:   };
16:   
17:   return (
18:     <div className="bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-2xl border border-gray-200/80 dark:border-gray-700 shadow-sm overflow-hidden flex flex-col group transition-all duration-300 hover:shadow-lg hover:-translate-y-1">
19:       <div className="relative overflow-hidden">
20:         <img
21:           src={product.imageUrl}
22:           alt={product.name}
23:           className="w-full h-56 object-cover transition-transform duration-300 group-hover:scale-105"
24:         />
25:         <div className={`absolute top-3 right-3 text-xs font-bold px-2 py-1 rounded-full ${getSimilarityColor(product.similarity)}`}>
26:           {product.similarity}% Match
27:         </div>
28:       </div>
29:       <div className="p-5 flex flex-col flex-grow">
30:         <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-800 dark:text-gray-100 truncate" title={product.name}>
31:           {product.name}
32:         </h3>
33:         <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 mb-4">{product.store}</p>
34:         <div className="mt-auto flex justify-between items-center">
35:           <p className="text-2xl font-extrabold text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400">${product.price.toFixed(2)}</p>
36:           <button
37:             onClick={() => onPreview(product.url)}
38:             className="bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-900/50 dark:text-blue-300 font-semibold py-2 px-5 rounded-lg hover:bg-blue-100 dark:hover:bg-blue-900 transition-colors duration-300"
39:           >
40:             View
41:           </button>
42:         </div>
43:       </div>
44:     </div>
45:   );
46: };

28: // --- Constants ---
29: const PAGE_SIZE = 20;
30: 
31: const PublicGallery: React.FC = () => {
32:   // --- Upload State ---
33:   const [localFiles, setLocalFiles] = useState<LocalFile[]>([]);
34:   const [globalError, setGlobalError] = useState<string | null>(null);
35:   const [isUploading, setIsUploading] = useState(false);

41:   const [loadingImages, setLoadingImages] = useState(false);
42:   const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(1);
43:   const [totalPages, setTotalPages] = useState(1);
44:   const [totalItemsCount, setTotalItemsCount] = useState(0);
45: 
46:   // تخزين مؤشرات الصفحات للعودة للخلف (Cursor Pagination)
47:   const [pageCursors, setPageCursors] = useState<(QueryDocumentSnapshot | null)[]>([null]);
48: 
49:   // --- Initialization ---
50:   const initGallery = useCallback(async () => {
51:     setLoadingImages(true);
52:     try {
53:       // 1. جلب العدد الكلي
54:       const count = await getGalleryCount();
55:       setTotalItemsCount(count);
56:       setTotalPages(Math.ceil(count / PAGE_SIZE) || 1); // على الأقل صفحة واحدة
57:       
58:       // 2. إعادة تعيين المؤشرات والصفحة الحالية
59:       setPageCursors([null]);
60:       setCurrentPage(1);
61: 
62:       // 3. جلب الصفحة الأولى
63:       const { items, lastDoc } = await getGalleryChunk(null, PAGE_SIZE);
64:       setGalleryItems(items);
65:       
66:       // تخزين مؤشر الصفحة التالية
67:       if (lastDoc) {
68:         setPageCursors(prev => {
69:           const newCursors = [...prev];
70:           newCursors[1] = lastDoc; 
71:           return newCursors;
72:         });
73:       }
74:     } catch (error) {
75:       console.error("Error loading gallery:", error);
76:     } finally {
77:       setLoadingImages(false);
78:     }
79:   }, []);
80: 
81:   useEffect(() => {
82:     initGallery();
83:   }, [initGallery]);
84: 
85:   // --- Pagination Logic ---
86:   const fetchPage = async (pageTarget: number, cursor: QueryDocumentSnapshot | null) => {
87:     setLoadingImages(true);
88:     try {
89:       const { items, lastDoc } = await getGalleryChunk(cursor, PAGE_SIZE);
90:       setGalleryItems(items);
91:       
92:       // تحديث المؤشرات إذا كنا نتقدم لصفحة جديدة
93:       if (lastDoc) {
94:         setPageCursors(prev => {
95:           const newCursors = [...prev];
96:           newCursors[pageTarget] = lastDoc; // تخزين نهاية الصفحة الحالية كبداية للصفحة التالية
97:           return newCursors;
98:         });
99:       }
100:       
101:       setCurrentPage(pageTarget);
102:       // Scroll to top of gallery section
103:       window.scrollTo({ top: 400, behavior: 'smooth' });
104:     } catch (error) {
105:       console.error("Error fetching page:", error);
106:     } finally {
107:       setLoadingImages(false);
108:     }
109:   };
110: 
111:   const handleNextPage = () => {
112:     if (currentPage < totalPages) {
113:       const cursor = pageCursors[currentPage]; // مؤشر نهاية الصفحة الحالية
114:       fetchPage(currentPage + 1, cursor);
115:     }
116:   };
117: 
118:   const handlePrevPage = () => {
119:     if (currentPage > 1) {
120:       const cursor = pageCursors[currentPage - 2]; // مؤشر بداية الصفحة السابقة
121:       fetchPage(currentPage - 1, cursor);
122:     }
123:   };
124: 
125:   // --- File Processing Logic ---
126:   useEffect(() => {
127:     return () => {
128:       localFiles.forEach(f => URL.revokeObjectURL(f.preview));
129:     };
130:   }, [localFiles]);
131: 
132:   const processFiles = useCallback((files: FileList | File[]): void => {
133:     setGlobalError(null);
134:     if (!files || files.length === 0) return;
135: 
136:     const newFiles: LocalFile[] = [];
137:     Array.from(files).forEach((file) => {
138:       if (!file.type.startsWith('image/')) {
139:         setGlobalError(`الملف "${file.name}" ليس صورة. يرجى اختيار ملفات صور فقط.`);
140:         return;
141:       }
142:       newFiles.push({
143:         file,
144:         preview: URL.createObjectURL(file),
145:         description: '',
146:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
147:         status: 'ready'
148:       });
149:     });
150: 
151:     setLocalFiles(prev => [...prev, ...newFiles]);
152:   }, []);
153: 
154:   const handleFileChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
155:     processFiles(e.target.files as FileList);
156:     e.currentTarget.value = ''; 
157:   };
158: 
159:   const handleDescriptionChange = (id: string, value: string) => {
160:     setLocalFiles(prev => prev.map(f => f.id === id ? { ...f, description: value } : f));
161:   };
162: 
163:   const handleRemoveLocal = (id: string) => {
164:     setLocalFiles(prev => {
165:       const fileToRemove = prev.find(f => f.id === id);
166:       if (fileToRemove) URL.revokeObjectURL(fileToRemove.preview);
167:       return prev.filter(f => f.id !== id);
168:     });
169:   };
170: 
171:   // --- Drag & Drop / Paste ---
172:   const handleDragOver = useCallback((e: React.DragEvent) => { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); if (!isDragging) setIsDragging(true); }, [isDragging]);
173:   const handleDragLeave = useCallback((e: React.DragEvent) => { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); setIsDragging(false); }, []);
174:   const handleDrop = useCallback((e: React.DragEvent) => { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); setIsDragging(false); processFiles(e.dataTransfer.files); }, [processFiles]);
175:   
176:   const handlePaste = useCallback((e: React.ClipboardEvent) => {
177:     setGlobalError(null);
178:     const items = e.clipboardData?.items;
179:     if (!items) return;

181:     for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {

185:       }

188:   }, [processFiles]);
189:

194:     setGlobalError(null);
195: 
196:     const newLocalFiles = [...localFiles];
197:     let uploadCount = 0;
198: 
199:     for (let i = 0; i < newLocalFiles.length; i++) {
200:       if (newLocalFiles[i].status !== 'ready' && newLocalFiles[i].status !== 'error') continue;
201: 
202:       const lf = newLocalFiles[i];
203:       try {
204:         if (!lf.description.trim()) {
205:           newLocalFiles[i] = { ...lf, status: 'error', errorMessage: 'الوصف مطلوب' };
206:           setLocalFiles([...newLocalFiles]);
207:           continue;
208:         }
209: 
210:         newLocalFiles[i] = { ...lf, status: 'uploading', errorMessage: undefined };
211:         setLocalFiles([...newLocalFiles]);
212: 
213:         const url = await cloudinaryService.uploadImage(lf.file);
214: 
215:         await createGalleryItem({
216:           url,
217:           description: lf.description.trim(),
218:           createdAt: new Date().toISOString()
219:         });
220: 
221:         newLocalFiles[i] = { ...lf, status: 'done', errorMessage: undefined };
222:         setLocalFiles([...newLocalFiles]);
223:         uploadCount++;
224: 
225:       } catch (err: any) {
226:         console.error('Upload error', err);
227:         newLocalFiles[i] = { ...lf, status: 'error', errorMessage: err?.message || 'فشل الرفع' };
228:         setLocalFiles([...newLocalFiles]);
229:       }
230:     }
231: 
232:     setIsUploading(false);
233:     
234:     // إزالة الملفات المكتملة
235:     setTimeout(() => {
236:       setLocalFiles(prev => prev.filter(f => f.status !== 'done'));
237:       // تحديث المعرض إذا تم رفع ملف واحد على الأقل
238:       if (uploadCount > 0) {
239:         initGallery(); // إعادة تحميل الصفحة الأولى لرؤية الصور الجديدة
240:       }
241:     }, 1000);
242:   };
243: 
244:   const goToHome = () => { window.location.href = '/'; };
245: 
246:   // --- Render ---
247:   return (

249:         className="min-h-screen bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-900 text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-100 transition-colors duration-300"
250:         onPaste={handlePaste}
251:         tabIndex={0}
252:     >
253:       <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto p-4 sm:p-8">

1: import React, { useMemo } from 'react';
2: import { Task, User } from '../types';
3: import { BarChart } from './charts/BarChart';
4: 
5: interface ReportsProps {
6:   tasks: Task[];
7:   users: User[];
8: }
9: 
10: const formatTime = (seconds: number) => {
11:     const h = Math.floor(seconds / 3600);
12:     const m = Math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60);
13:     const s = Math.round(seconds % 60);
14:     let timeString = '';
15:     if (h > 0) timeString += `${h}س `;
16:     if (m > 0) timeString += `${m}د `;
17:     if (s > 0 || (h === 0 && m === 0)) timeString += `${s}ث`;
18:     return timeString.trim();
19: };
20: 
21: export const Reports: React.FC<ReportsProps> = ({ tasks, users }) => {
22: 
23:   const employeeTimeData = useMemo(() => {

25:     return employees.map(employee => {

27:       const totalTime = employeeTasks.reduce((acc, task) => acc + task.totalWorkTime, 0);
28:       return {

30:         totalTime, // in milliseconds

33:     });

66:                                     <td className="p-3 font-medium text-gray-800 dark:text-gray-100">{data.name}</td>

68:                                     <td className="p-3 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300 font-mono">{formatTime(data.totalTime / 1000)}</td>
69:                                 </tr>
70:                             ))}
71:                         </tbody>
72:                     </table>
73:                  </div>
74:             </div>
75: 
76:             <div className="bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-2xl shadow-md border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 p-6">
77:                 <h2 className="text-xl font-bold mb-4 text-gray-800 dark:text-gray-100">رسم بياني للوقت المستغرق (بالدقائق)</h2>
78:                 <BarChart data={chartData} />
79:             </div>
80:         </div>
81:     </div>
82:   );
83: };

======= components\ResultsPage.tsx =======

2: import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';

9: interface ResultsPageProps {

15: export const ResultsPage: React.FC<ResultsPageProps> = ({ products, onBack, isTaskActive }) => {

17:   const [maxPrice, setMaxPrice] = useState(() => {
18:     if (products.length === 0) return 1000;
19:     return Math.ceil(Math.max(...products.map(p => p.price)));
20:   });
21:   const [price, setPrice] = useState(maxPrice);
22:   const [sortBy, setSortBy] = useState('similarity');

25:

27:     return products
28:       .filter(product => product.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()))
29:       .filter(product => product.price <= price)
30:       .sort((a, b) => {
31:         if (sortBy === 'similarity') return b.similarity - a.similarity;
32:         if (sortBy === 'price_asc') return a.price - b.price;
33:         return b.price - a.price;
34:       });
35:   }, [products, searchTerm, price, sortBy]);
36: 
37:   return (
38:     <>
39:       <div className="bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-2xl shadow-lg border border-gray-100 dark:border-gray-700 p-4 sm:p-6 animate-fade-in h-full flex flex-col">

47:                   <div className="relative flex-grow md:flex-grow-0">
48:                       <input
49:                           type="text"
50:                           placeholder="تصفية النتائج..."
51:                           value={searchTerm}
52:                           onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
53:                           className="w-full md:w-64 pl-4 pr-10 py-2 border border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-600 rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-700 text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-200 text-sm"
54:                       />
55:                       <SearchIcon className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 h-4 w-4 text-gray-400"/>
56:                   </div>
57:                   
58:                   <button 
59:                     className="md:hidden p-2 bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-700 rounded-lg text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300"
60:                     onClick={() => setShowMobileFilters(!showMobileFilters)}
61:                   >
62:                     <FilterIcon className="h-5 w-5" />
63:                   </button>
64:

66:                       onClick={onBack}
67:                       className="bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white font-semibold py-2 px-4 rounded-lg text-sm transition ml-auto md:ml-0"
68:                   >
69:                       {isTaskActive ? 'بحث جديد' : 'إنهاء'}
70:                   </button>
71:               </div>
72:           </header>
73:

88:                           <input
89:                               type="range"
90:                               min="0"
91:                               max={maxPrice}
92:                               value={price}
93:                               onChange={(e) => setPrice(Number(e.target.value))}
94:                               className="w-full h-2 bg-gray-200 dark:bg-gray-600 rounded-lg appearance-none cursor-pointer accent-blue-600"
95:                           />
96:                           <div className="flex justify-between text-xs text-gray-500 mt-1">
97:                               <span>$0</span>
98:                               <span>${maxPrice}</span>
99:                           </div>
100:                       </div>
101:

103:                           <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 mb-2">الترتيب حسب</label>
104:                           <select
105:                               value={sortBy}
106:                               onChange={(e) => setSortBy(e.target.value)}
107:                               className="w-full p-2 text-sm border border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-600 rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-gray-700 text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-200"

======= components\SearchForm.tsx =======
1: 
2: import React, { useState, useCallback, useEffect } from 'react';
3: import { SearchQuery, Task } from '../types';
4: import { UploadIcon } from './icons/UploadIcon';
5: 
6: interface SearchFormProps {
7:   onSearch: (query: SearchQuery) => void;
8:   activeTask: Task | null;
9:   onBackToDashboard: () => void;
10: }
11: 
12: export const SearchForm: React.FC<SearchFormProps> = ({ onSearch, activeTask, onBackToDashboard }) => {
13:   const [image, setImage] = useState<File | null>(null);
14:   const [preview, setPreview] = useState<string | null>(null);
15:   const [description, setDescription] = useState('');
16:   const [targetPrice, setTargetPrice] = useState('');
17:   const [isDragging, setIsDragging] = useState(false);
18: 
19:   useEffect(() => {
20:     if (activeTask) {
21:         setDescription(activeTask.description);
22:         if (activeTask.targetPrice) {
23:             setTargetPrice(activeTask.targetPrice.toString());
24:         } else {
25:             const priceMatch = activeTask.description.match(/\$?(\d+(\.\d+)?)/);
26:             if (priceMatch) setTargetPrice(priceMatch[1]);
27:         }
28:     }
29:   }, [activeTask]);
30: 
31:   const handleFileChange = (files: FileList | null) => {
32:     if (files && files[0]) {
33:       const file = files[0];
34:       if (!['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp'].includes(file.type)) {
35:         alert('Unsupported file type.');
36:         return;
37:       }
38:       setImage(file);
39:       const reader = new FileReader();
40:       reader.onloadend = () => setPreview(reader.result as string);
41:       reader.readAsDataURL(file);
42:     }
43:   };
44: 
45:   const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
46:     e.preventDefault();
47:     if (image && description && targetPrice) {
48:       onSearch({ image, description, targetPrice: parseFloat(targetPrice) });
49:     } else {
50:       alert('يرجى تعبئة جميع الحقول ورفع صورة.');
51:     }
52:   };
53: 
54:   // Drag and Drop handlers...
55:   const handleDragEnter = useCallback((e: React.DragEvent) => { e.preventDefault(); setIsDragging(true); }, []);
56:   const handleDragLeave = useCallback((e: React.DragEvent) => { e.preventDefault(); setIsDragging(false); }, []);
57:   const handleDrop = useCallback((e: React.DragEvent) => { 
58:       e.preventDefault(); setIsDragging(false); 
59:       if(e.dataTransfer.files?.length) handleFileChange(e.dataTransfer.files); 
60:   }, []);
61: 
62:   return (
63:     <div className="max-w-5xl mx-auto bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-2xl shadow-lg border border-gray-100 dark:border-gray-700 animate-fade-in overflow-hidden">
64:         {/* Active Task Banner */}
65:         {activeTask && (
66:             <div className="bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-900/30 p-4 border-b border-blue-100 dark:border-blue-800 flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-start sm:items-center gap-2">
67:                 <div>
68:                     <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-blue-800 dark:text-blue-300 flex items-center gap-2">
69:                         <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-blue-500 animate-pulse"></span>
70:                         مهمة قيد التنفيذ: {activeTask.title}
71:                     </h3>
72:                     <p className="text-sm text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 mt-1">المواقع: {activeTask.allowedSites.join(', ')}</p>
73:                 </div>
74:             </div>
75:         )}
76: 
77:       <div className="p-4 sm:p-8">
78:           <div className="grid lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6 lg:gap-12 items-start">
79:             {/* Image Upload Area */}
80:             <div className="w-full">
81:                 <label className="block text-lg font-medium text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 mb-3">صورة المنتج</label>
82:                 <label
83:                     onDragEnter={handleDragEnter}
84:                     onDragLeave={handleDragLeave}
85:                     onDragOver={e => e.preventDefault()}
86:                     onDrop={handleDrop}
87:                     className={`w-full aspect-video sm:aspect-square lg:aspect-[4/3] border-2 border-dashed rounded-2xl flex flex-col items-center justify-center cursor-pointer transition-all duration-300 relative overflow-hidden group ${isDragging ? 'border-blue-500 bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-900/30' : 'border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-600 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-700/30 hover:bg-gray-100 dark:hover:bg-gray-700/50'}`}
88:                 >
89:                     <input type="file" className="hidden" accept="image/*" onChange={(e) => handleFileChange(e.target.files)} />
90:                     
91:                     {preview ? (
92:                     <>
93:                         <img src={preview} alt="Preview" className="w-full h-full object-contain p-4 z-10" />
94:                         <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/40 flex items-center justify-center opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity z-20">
95:                             <p className="text-white font-bold">تغيير الصورة</p>
96:                         </div>
97:                     </>
98:                     ) : (
99:                     <div className="text-center p-6">
100:                         <UploadIcon className="mx-auto h-12 w-12 text-gray-400 mb-3" />
101:                         <p className="text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300 font-medium">اضغط لرفع صورة</p>
102:                         <p className="text-sm text-gray-400 mt-1">أو اسحب الصورة هنا</p>
103:                     </div>
104:                     )}
105:                 </label>
106:             </div>
107: 
108:             {/* Form Fields */}
109:             <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-6 flex flex-col h-full justify-center">
110:                 <div>
111:                     <label htmlFor="description" className="block text-lg font-medium text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 mb-2">وصف المنتج</label>
112:                     <textarea
113:                         id="description"
114:                         value={description}
115:                         onChange={(e) => setDescription(e.target.value)}
116:                         className="w-full p-4 text-base bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-700 rounded-xl border-2 border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-600 focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-0 transition-colors min-h-[120px]"
117:                         placeholder="صف المنتج بدقة (اللون، المادة، الاستخدام...)"

124:                     <div className="relative">
125:                         <input
126:                             type="number"

130:                             className="w-full p-4 pl-12 text-base bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-700 rounded-xl border-2 border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-600 focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-0 transition-colors"

======= components\SettingsPage.tsx =======
1: 
2: import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
3: import { User } from '../types';
4: import { updateUserInDb } from '../services/firestoreService';
5: import { changeUserPassword } from '../services/authService';
6: 
7: interface SettingsPageProps {
8:   user: User;
9: }
10: 
11: export const SettingsPage: React.FC<SettingsPageProps> = ({ user }) => {
12:   const [profileForm, setProfileForm] = useState({
13:     name: user.name,
14:     phone: user.phone || '',
15:     address: user.address || '',
16:     educationLevel: user.educationLevel || '',
17:     experienceDescription: user.experienceDescription || ''
18:   });
19:   
20:   const [resumeFile, setResumeFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
21: 
22:   const [passwordForm, setPasswordForm] = useState({
23:     oldPassword: '',
24:     newPassword: '',
25:     confirmPassword: ''
26:   });
27: 
28:   const [message, setMessage] = useState<{ type: 'success' | 'error', text: string } | null>(null);
29:   const [loadingProfile, setLoadingProfile] = useState(false);
30:   const [loadingPassword, setLoadingPassword] = useState(false);
31: 
32:   useEffect(() => {
33:     setProfileForm({
34:         name: user.name,
35:         phone: user.phone || '',
36:         address: user.address || '',
37:         educationLevel: user.educationLevel || '',
38:         experienceDescription: user.experienceDescription || ''
39:     });
40:   }, [user]);
41: 
42:   const handleFileChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
43:     if (e.target.files && e.target.files[0]) {
44:         const file = e.target.files[0];
45:         if (file.size > 800 * 1024) {
46:             setMessage({ type: 'error', text: 'حجم الملف كبير جداً. الحد الأقصى 800 كيلوبايت.' });
47:             return;
48:         }
49:         setResumeFile(file);
50:         setMessage(null);
51:     }
52:   };
53: 
54:   const convertFileToBase64 = (file: File): Promise<string> => {
55:     return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
56:         const reader = new FileReader();
57:         reader.readAsDataURL(file);
58:         reader.onload = () => resolve(reader.result as string);
59:         reader.onerror = error => reject(error);
60:     });
61:   };
62: 
63:   const handleProfileUpdate = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
64:     e.preventDefault();
65:     setLoadingProfile(true);
66:     setMessage(null);
67:     try {
68:         const updates: any = {
69:             id: user.id,
70:             name: profileForm.name,
71:             phone: profileForm.phone,
72:             address: profileForm.address,
73:             educationLevel: profileForm.educationLevel,
74:             experienceDescription: profileForm.experienceDescription
75:         };
76: 
77:         if (resumeFile) {
78:             const base64Data = await convertFileToBase64(resumeFile);
79:             updates.resumeData = {
80:                 name: resumeFile.name,
81:                 type: resumeFile.type,
82:                 data: base64Data
83:             };
84:         }
85: 
86:         await updateUserInDb(updates);
87:         setMessage({ type: 'success', text: 'تم تحديث البيانات الشخصية بنجاح.' });
88:         setResumeFile(null); // Reset file input
89:     } catch (err) {
90:         console.error(err);
91:         setMessage({ type: 'error', text: 'حدث خطأ أثناء تحديث البيانات.' });
92:     } finally {
93:         setLoadingProfile(false);
94:     }
95:   };
96: 
97:   const handlePasswordChange = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
98:     e.preventDefault();
99:     setMessage(null);
100: 
101:     if (passwordForm.newPassword !== passwordForm.confirmPassword) {
102:         setMessage({ type: 'error', text: 'كلمة المرور الجديدة غير متطابقة.' });
103:         return;
104:     }
105: 
106:     if (passwordForm.newPassword.length < 6) {
107:         setMessage({ type: 'error', text: 'كلمة المرور يجب أن تكون 6 خانات على الأقل.' });
108:         return;
109:     }
110: 
111:     setLoadingPassword(true);
112:     try {
113:         await changeUserPassword(passwordForm.oldPassword, passwordForm.newPassword);
114:         setMessage({ type: 'success', text: 'تم تغيير كلمة المرور بنجاح.' });
115:         setPasswordForm({ oldPassword: '', newPassword: '', confirmPassword: '' });
116:     } catch (err: any) {
117:         console.error(err);
118:         if (err.code === 'auth/invalid-credential' || err.code === 'auth/wrong-password') {
119:             setMessage({ type: 'error', text: 'كلمة المرور الحالية غير صحيحة.' });
120:         } else {
121:             setMessage({ type: 'error', text: 'حدث خطأ. يرجى التأكد من كلمة المرور والمحاولة مرة أخرى.' });
122:         }
123:     } finally {
124:         setLoadingPassword(false);
125:     }
126:   };
127: 
128:   return (
129:     <div className="animate-fade-in max-w-4xl mx-auto space-y-8 pb-10">
130:       <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-gray-800 dark:text-gray-100 mb-6">الإعدادات</h1>
131: 
132:       {message && (
133:         <div className={`p-4 rounded-lg mb-4 text-center ${message.type === 'success' ? 'bg-green-100 text-green-700' : 'bg-red-100 text-red-700'}`}>
134:             {message.text}
135:         </div>
136:       )}
137: 
138:       {/* Profile Settings */}
139:       <div className="bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-2xl shadow-md border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 p-6 sm:p-8">
140:         <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-gray-800 dark:text-gray-100 mb-4 border-b pb-2 dark:border-gray-700">المعلومات الشخصية والمهنية</h2>
141:         <form onSubmit={handleProfileUpdate} className="space-y-4">
142:             {/* Personal Info Section */}
143:             <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
144:                 <div>
145:                     <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 mb-1">الاسم الكامل</label>
146:                     <input 
147:                         type="text" 
148:                         value={profileForm.name} 
149:                         onChange={e => setProfileForm({...profileForm, name: e.target.value})}
150:                         className="w-full p-3 border border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-600 rounded-lg bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-700 text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-200"
151:                         required
152:                     />
153:                 </div>
154:                 <div>
155:                     <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 mb-1">البريد الإلكتروني (للقراءة فقط)</label>
156:                     <input 
157:                         type="email" 
158:                         value={user.email} 
159:                         disabled
160:                         className="w-full p-3 border border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-600 rounded-lg bg-gray-200 dark:bg-gray-600 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 cursor-not-allowed"
161:                     />
162:                 </div>
163:                 <div>
164:                     <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 mb-1">رقم الهاتف</label>
165:                     <input 
166:                         type="tel"

12: interface SignupPageProps {

16: export const SignupPage: React.FC<SignupPageProps> = ({ onNavigateToLogin }) => {
17:   const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
18:     fullName: '',
19:     email: '',
20:     phone: '',
21:     city: '',
22:     village: '',
23:     street: '',
24:     password: '',
25:     confirmPassword: '',
26:     experienceDescription: '',
27:     educationLevel: ''
28:   });
29: 
30:   const [resumeFile, setResumeFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
31:   const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
32:   const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
33:   const [successMessage, setSuccessMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
34:   const [showTerms, setShowTerms] = useState(false);
35:   const [acceptedTerms, setAcceptedTerms] = useState(false);
36:   const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
37:   const [showConfirmPassword, setShowConfirmPassword] = useState(false);
38:   const [uploadProgress, setUploadProgress] = useState(0);
39:   const navigate = useNavigate();
40: 
41:   const handleChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement | HTMLTextAreaElement | HTMLSelectElement>) => {
42:     setFormData({ ...formData, [e.target.name]: e.target.value });
43:   };
44: 
45:   const handleFileChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
46:     if (e.target.files && e.target.files[0]) {
47:       const file = e.target.files[0];
48: 
49:       // محاكاة تقدم الرفع
50:       let progress = 0;
51:       const interval = setInterval(() => {
52:         progress += 10;
53:         setUploadProgress(progress);
54:         if (progress >= 100) {
55:           clearInterval(interval);
56:         }
57:       }, 50);
58: 
59:       if (!['application/pdf', 'application/msword', 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document'].includes(file.type)) {
60:         setError("نوع الملف غير مدعوم. يرجى رفع ملف PDF أو Word.");
61:         setResumeFile(null);
62:         return;
63:       }
64:       if (file.size > 800 * 1024) {
65:         setError("حجم الملف كبير جداً. الحد الأقصى 800 كيلوبايت.");
66:         setResumeFile(null);
67:         return;
68:       }
69:       setError(null);
70:       setResumeFile(file);
71:       setTimeout(() => setUploadProgress(100), 600);
72:     }
73:   };
74: 
75:   const convertFileToBase64 = (file: File): Promise<string> => {
76:     return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
77:       const reader = new FileReader();
78:       reader.readAsDataURL(file);
79:       reader.onload = () => resolve(reader.result as string);
80:       reader.onerror = error => reject(error);
81:     });
82:   };
83: 
84:   const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
85:     e.preventDefault();
86:     setError(null);
87:     setSuccessMessage(null);
88: 
89:     if (!acceptedTerms) {
90:       setError("يجب الموافقة على الشروط والأحكام أولاً.");
91:       return;
92:     }
93: 
94:     if (formData.password !== formData.confirmPassword) {
95:       setError("كلمات المرور غير متطابقة.");
96:       return;
97:     }
98: 
99:     if (formData.password.length < 6) {
100:       setError("يجب أن تكون كلمة المرور 6 أحرف على الأقل.");
101:       return;
102:     }
103: 
104:     if (!resumeFile) {
105:       setError("يرجى رفع السيرة الذاتية.");
106:       return;
107:     }
108: 
109:     setIsLoading(true);
110:     try {
111:       const base64Data = await convertFileToBase64(resumeFile);
112: 
113:       const fullAddress = `${formData.city} - ${formData.village} - ${formData.street}`;
114: 
115:       await signupUser({
116:         fullName: formData.fullName,
117:         email: formData.email,
118:         phone: formData.phone,
119:         address: fullAddress,

121:         experienceDescription: formData.experienceDescription,
122:         educationLevel: formData.educationLevel,
123:         resumeData: {
124:           name: resumeFile.name,
125:           type: resumeFile.type,
126:           url: base64Data
127:         }
128:       });
129: 
130:       setSuccessMessage("✨ تم إنشاء الحساب بنجاح! يرجى تفعيل بريدك الإلكتروني وانتظار موافقة الإدارة.");
131:       setTimeout(() => {
132:         onNavigateToLogin();
133:       }, 6000);
134:     } catch (err: any) {
135:       console.error(err);
136:       if (err.code === 'auth/email-already-in-use') {
137:         setError("⚠️ البريد الإلكتروني مستخدم بالفعل.");
138:       } else {
139:         setError("حدث خطأ أثناء إنشاء الحساب. " + err.message);
140:       }
141:     } finally {
142:       setIsLoading(false);
143:     }
144:   };
145:

147:     setAcceptedTerms(true);
148:     setShowTerms(false);
149:   };

155:   return (

157: 
158:       {/* خلفية زخرفية */}

173: // مكون الوقت المتبقي
174: const TimeRemaining: React.FC<{ dueDate: string }> = ({ dueDate }) => {
175:     const now = new Date();
176:     const due = new Date(dueDate);
177:     const diffTime = due.getTime() - now.getTime();
178:     const diffDays = Math.ceil(diffTime / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
179:     
180:     let text = '';
181:     let color = '';
182:     
183:     if (diffDays < 0) {
184:         text = 'متأخرة';
185:         color = 'text-red-600 dark:text-red-400';
186:     } else if (diffDays === 0) {
187:         text = 'تنتهي اليوم';
188:         color = 'text-orange-600 dark:text-orange-400';
189:     } else if (diffDays === 1) {
190:         text = 'غداً';
191:         color = 'text-yellow-600 dark:text-yellow-400';
192:     } else if (diffDays <= 3) {
193:         text = `${diffDays} أيام`;
194:         color = 'text-yellow-600 dark:text-yellow-400';
195:     } else {
196:         text = `${diffDays} يوم`;
197:         color = 'text-green-600 dark:text-green-400';
198:     }
199:     
200:     return (
201:         <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
202:             <span className="font-semibold text-gray-800 dark:text-gray-100">الوقت المتبقي:</span>
203:             <span className={`text-xs font-medium ${color}`}>
204:                 {text}
205:             </span>
206:         </div>
207:     );
208: };

======= components\TaskList.tsx =======
1: import React, { useState, useMemo, useEffect } from 'react';
2: import { Task, User, Category, getUserTaskStatus, getUserSubmissions } from '../types';
3: import { TaskCard } from './TaskCard';
4: import { getCategories } from '../services/firestoreService'; // استيراد دالة جلب الفئات
5: 
6: interface TaskListProps {
7:   user: User;
8:   tasks: Task[];
9:   categories?: Category[]; // إضافة prop للفئات
10:   onSelectTask: (task: Task) => void;
11: }
12: 
13: // أنواع الفلاتر
14: type StatusFilter = 'all' | 'not_started' | 'in_progress' | 'submitted' | 'completed' | 'rejected';
15: type CategoryFilter = 'all' | string;
16: 
17: export const TaskList: React.FC<TaskListProps> = ({ 
18:   user, 
19:   tasks, 
20:   categories: propCategories, 
21:   onSelectTask 
22: }) => {
23:   // حالة الفلاتر والبحث
24:   const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<StatusFilter>('all');
25:   const [categoryFilter, setCategoryFilter] = useState<CategoryFilter>('all');
26:   const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
27:   
28:   // حالة محلية للفئات إذا لم تكن ممررة
29:   const [localCategories, setLocalCategories] = useState<Category[]>([]);
30:   
31:   // دمج الفئات الممررة مع الفئات المحلية
32:   const categories = propCategories || localCategories;
33: 
34:   // جلب الفئات إذا لم تكن ممررة
35:   useEffect(() => {
36:     if (!propCategories) {
37:       const fetchCategories = async () => {
38:         try {
39:           const fetchedCategories = await getCategories();
40:           setLocalCategories(fetchedCategories);
41:         } catch (error) {
42:           console.error('Error fetching categories:', error);
43:         }
44:       };
45:       fetchCategories();
46:     }
47:   }, [propCategories]);
48: 
49:   // تصفية المهام المعينة للموظف الحالي
50:   const userTasks = useMemo(() => {
51:     return tasks.filter(task => {
52:       if (Array.isArray(task.assignedTo)) {
53:         return task.assignedTo.includes(user.id);
54:       }
55:       return task.assignedTo === user.id;
56:     });
57:   }, [tasks, user.id]);
58: 
59:   // الحصول على حالة الموظف الحالي في كل مهمة
60:   const getCurrentUserTaskStatus = (task: Task) => {
61:     // أولاً: التحقق من الحالة الفردية للموظف
62:     const userStatus = task.userStatuses?.[user.id];
63:     
64:     if (userStatus) {
65:       return {
66:         hasSubmission: userStatus.status === 'submitted' || userStatus.status === 'completed',
67:         status: userStatus.status,
68:         submissionCount: getUserSubmissions(task, user.id).length,
69:         userStatus: userStatus
70:       };
71:     }
72:     
73:     // إذا لم تكن هناك حالة فردية، نستخدم التسليمات
74:     const userSubmissions = getUserSubmissions(task, user.id);
75:     
76:     if (userSubmissions.length > 0) {
77:       const latestSubmission = userSubmissions[userSubmissions.length - 1];
78:       const submissionStatus = latestSubmission.status === 'approved' ? 'completed' : 
79:                               latestSubmission.status === 'rejected' ? 'rejected' : 'submitted';
80:       
81:       return {
82:         hasSubmission: true,
83:         status: submissionStatus,
84:         submissionCount: userSubmissions.length,
85:         userStatus: {
86:           status: submissionStatus,
87:           startedAt: userSubmissions[0]?.createdAt
88:         }
89:       };
90:     }
91:     
92:     return {
93:       hasSubmission: false,
94:       status: 'not_started',
95:       submissionCount: 0,
96:       userStatus: null
97:     };
98:   };
99: 
100:    const getCategoryName = (categoryId: string) => {
101:     const category = categories.find(c => c.id === categoryId);
102:     return category ? category.name : 'غير مصنف';
103:   };
104: 
105:   // المهام المصفاة بناءً على الفلاتر والبحث
106:   const filteredTasks = useMemo(() => {
107:     return userTasks.filter(task => {
108:       // فلتر البحث
109:       const matchesSearch = searchQuery === '' || 
110:         task.title.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
111:         task.description.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase());
112:       
113:       if (!matchesSearch) return false;
114: 
115:       // فلتر الفئة
116:       const matchesCategory = categoryFilter === 'all' || task.category === categoryFilter;
117:       if (!matchesCategory) return false;
118: 
119:       // فلتر الحالة
120:       if (statusFilter === 'all') return true;
121:       
122:       const userStatus = getCurrentUserTaskStatus(task);
123:       return userStatus.status === statusFilter;
124:     });
125:   }, [userTasks, statusFilter, categoryFilter, searchQuery, user.id]);
126: 
127:   // إحصائيات المهام
128:   const taskStats = useMemo(() => {
129:     const stats = {
130:       all: 0,

======= components\ThemeToggle.tsx =======
1: import React from 'react';
2: import { Theme } from '../types';
3: import { SunIcon } from './icons/SunIcon';
4: import { MoonIcon } from './icons/MoonIcon';
5: 
6: interface ThemeToggleProps {
7:   theme: Theme;
8:   toggleTheme: () => void;
9: }
10: 
11: export const ThemeToggle: React.FC<ThemeToggleProps> = ({ theme, toggleTheme }) => {
12:   return (
13:     <button
14:       onClick={toggleTheme}
15:       className="p-2 rounded-full bg-gray-200 dark:bg-gray-700 text-gray-800 dark:text-gray-200 hover:bg-gray-300 dark:hover:bg-gray-600 transition-colors"
16:       aria-label="Toggle theme"
17:     >
18:       {theme === 'light' ? <MoonIcon className="h-6 w-6" /> : <SunIcon className="h-6 w-6" />}
19:     </button>
20:   );
21: };

23: // دالة مساعدة لترجمة حالة التوظيف (لم تتغير)
24: const getEmploymentStatusText = (
25:   status: EmploymentStatus | undefined
26: ): string => {
27:   switch (status) {
28:     case "permanent":
29:       return "موظف ثابت";
30:     case "probation":
31:       return "تحت الاختبار";
32:     case "intern":
33:       return "متدرب";
34:     default:
35:       return "غير محدد";
36:   }
37: };

39: // دالة مساعدة لجلب لون حالة التوظيف (لم تتغير)
40: const getEmploymentStatusColor = (
41:   status: EmploymentStatus | undefined
42: ): string => {
43:   switch (status) {
44:     case "permanent":
45:       return "bg-green-100 text-green-800";
46:     case "probation":
47:       return "bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800";
48:     case "intern":
49:       return "bg-blue-100 text-blue-800";
50:     default:
51:       return "bg-gray-100 text-gray-800";
52:   }
53: };
54: 
55: // دالة مساعدة لحساب إذا كان المستخدم نشطاً حالياً (لم تتغير)
56: const calculateIsActive = (activityStatus?: ActivityStatus): boolean => {
57:   if (!activityStatus) {
58:     return false;
59:   }
60:   return activityStatus.isCurrentlyActive;
61: };
62: 
63: // دالة مساعدة للحصول على لون النقطة بناءً على الحالة (لم تتغير)
64: const getDotColor = (
65:   isActive: boolean,
66:   isApproved: boolean,
67:   activityStatus?: ActivityStatus
68: ): string => {
69:   if (!isApproved) {
70:     return "bg-gray-500";
71:   }
72:   if (!activityStatus) {
73:     return "bg-yellow-500";
74:   }
75:   return isActive ? "bg-green-500" : "bg-red-500";
76: };
77: 
78: // دالة مساعدة للحصول على نص حالة النشاط للتلميح (تم تبسيطها قليلاً)
79: const getActivityTooltipText = (
80:   user: User,
81:   activityStatus?: ActivityStatus
82: ): string => {
83:   if (!user.isApproved) return "غير مفعل";
84:   if (!activityStatus) return "مفعل - بيانات النشاط غير متاحة";
85:   if (!activityStatus.isCurrentlyActive) return "مفعل - غير نشط حالياً";
86: 
87:   const lastCheckIn = new Date(activityStatus.lastCheckIn);
88:   const minutesDiff = Math.floor((new Date().getTime() - lastCheckIn.getTime()) / (1000 * 60));
89: 
90:   if (minutesDiff < 1) return "نشط الآن";
91:   if (minutesDiff < 10) return `نشط (منذ ${minutesDiff} دقيقة)`;
92:   return "نشط (منذ أكثر من 10 دقائق)";
93: };

119:       (user) => user.role === "employee" || user.role === "procurement"

486:                           >
487:                             قبول
488:                           </button>
489:                         )}
490: 
491:                         <button
492:                           onClick={() => handleEditClick(user)}
493:                           className="text-gray-500 hover:text-blue-700 p-1"
494:                           title="تعديل"
495:                         >
496:                           <EditIcon className="h-5 w-5" />
497:                         </button>
498: 
499:                         <button
500:                           onClick={() => handleRejectUser(user.id)}
501:                           className="text-red-500 hover:text-red-700 p-1"
502:                           title={user.isApproved ? "حذف" : "رفض وحذف"}
503:                         >
504:                           <DeleteIcon className="h-5 w-5" />
505:                         </button>
506:                       </div>
507:                     </td>
508:                   </tr>
509:                 );
510:               })}
511:             </tbody>
512:           </table>
513:         </div>
514:       </div>
515: 
516:       {selectedUser && (
517:         <>
518:           <EditUserModal
519:             isOpen={isEditModalOpen}
520:             onClose={() => setIsEditModalOpen(false)}
521:             user={selectedUser}
522:             onSave={handleUpdate}
523:           />
524:           <EmployeeDetailsModal
525:             isOpen={isDetailsModalOpen}
526:             onClose={() => setIsDetailsModalOpen(false)}
527:             user={selectedUser}
528:             onApprove={handleApproveUser}
529:             onReject={handleRejectUser}
530:             onSaveNotes={handleSaveNotes}
531:           />
532:         </>
533:       )}
534:     </div>
535:   );
536: };

======= components\charts\BarChart.tsx =======

18:     const chartHeight = 300;
19:     const barWidth = 35;
20:     const barMargin = 15;
21:     const svgWidth = data.labels.length * (barWidth + barMargin);
22:

24:         <div className="w-full overflow-x-auto">
25:             <svg width={svgWidth} height={chartHeight} className="font-sans">
26:                 {data.datasets[0].data.map((value, index) => {
27:                     const barHeight = (value / maxValue) * (chartHeight - 40);
28:                     const x = index * (barWidth + barMargin);
29:                     const y = chartHeight - barHeight - 20;
30: 
31:                     return (
32:                         <g key={index}>
33:                             <rect
34:                                 x={x}
35:                                 y={y}
36:                                 width={barWidth}
37:                                 height={barHeight}
38:                                 fill={data.datasets[0].backgroundColor}
39:                                 rx="4"
40:                                 ry="4"
41:                             />
42:                             <text
43:                                 x={x + barWidth / 2}
44:                                 y={y - 5}
45:                                 textAnchor="middle"
46:                                 className="text-xs font-semibold fill-current text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-200"

48:                                 {value}
49:                             </text>
50:                             <text

======= components\common\SubmissionItemGallery.tsx =======
