======= components\common\SupplierModal.tsx =======
1: import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
2: import { Supplier } from '../../types';
3: import { suppliersService } from '../../services/firestoreService';
4: import { cloudinaryService } from '../../services/cloudinaryService';
5: import { LoadingSpinner } from '../LoadingSpinner';
6: import {
7:     X, Save, Building, User, MapPin, Wallet, ImageIcon, ArrowRight, Tag
8: } from 'lucide-react';
9: import { SUPPLIER_TYPES } from '../../constants/supplierConstants';
10: 
11: interface SupplierModalProps {
12:     isOpen: boolean;
13:     onClose: () => void;
14:     onSaveSuccess?: (supplier: Supplier) => void;
15:     editingSupplier?: Supplier | null;
16: 
17: }
18: 
19: export const SupplierModal: React.FC<SupplierModalProps> = ({
20:     isOpen,
21:     onClose,
22:     onSaveSuccess,
23:     editingSupplier
24: }) => {
25:     const [currentSupplier, setCurrentSupplier] = useState<Partial<Supplier>>({});
26:     const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
27:     const [uploadingLogo, setUploadingLogo] = useState(false);
28:     const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
29: 
30:     useEffect(() => {
31:         if (isOpen) {
32:             if (editingSupplier) {
33:                 setCurrentSupplier({ ...editingSupplier });
34:             } else {
35:                 // Return to default empty state
36:                 setCurrentSupplier({
37:                     tradeName: '',
38:                     email: '',
39:                     phone: '',
40:                     mobile: '',
41:                     salesRepName: '',
42:                     salesRepWechat: '',
43:                     salesRepPhone: '',
44:                     street: '',
45:                     city: '',
46:                     region: '',
47:                     postalCode: '',
48:                     country: '',
49:                     currency: 'ILS',
50:                     openingBalance: 0,
51:                     notes: '',
52:                     logoUrl: '',
53:                     balanceDate: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
54:                     type: 'factory'
55:                 });
56:             }
57:             setError(null);
58:         }
59:     }, [isOpen, editingSupplier]);
60: 
61:     if (!isOpen) return null;
62: 
63:     const handleSave = async () => {
64:         // 1. التحقق الأساسي (الاسم التجاري)
65:         if (!currentSupplier.tradeName?.trim()) {
66:             setError('الاسم التجاري مطلوب');
67:             return;
68:         }
69: 
70:         setSaving(true);
71:         setError(null);
72: 
73:         try {
74:             // ==========================================
75:             // 🛑 فحص التكرار (إيميل، هاتف، جوال)
76:             // ==========================================
77:             const uniquenessCheck = await suppliersService.checkSupplierUniqueness(
78:                 {
79:                     email: currentSupplier.email,
80:                     phone: currentSupplier.phone,
81:                     mobile: currentSupplier.mobile
82:                 },
83:                 editingSupplier?.id // تمرير المعرف في حالة التعديل لاستثنائه
84:             );
85: 
86:             if (!uniquenessCheck.isUnique) {
87:                 let errorMessage = 'هناك بيانات مكررة!';
88: 
89:                 switch (uniquenessCheck.field) {
90:                     case 'email':
91:                         errorMessage = `البريد الإلكتروني "${currentSupplier.email}" مستخدم بالفعل للمورد: ${uniquenessCheck.existingName}`;
92:                         break;
93:                     case 'phone':
94:                         errorMessage = `رقم الهاتف "${currentSupplier.phone}" مستخدم بالفعل للمورد: ${uniquenessCheck.existingName}`;
95:                         break;
96:                     case 'mobile':
97:                         errorMessage = `رقم الجوال "${currentSupplier.mobile}" مستخدم بالفعل للمورد: ${uniquenessCheck.existingName}`;
98:                         break;
99:                 }
100: 
101:                 setError(errorMessage);
102:                 setSaving(false);
103:                 return; // ⛔ إيقاف الحفظ
104:             }
105:             // ==========================================
106: 
107:             let savedSupplier: Supplier;
108: 
109:             if (editingSupplier) {
110:                 // Update Logic
111:                 const supplierToUpdate: Supplier = {
112:                     ...editingSupplier,
113:                     ...currentSupplier as Supplier,
114:                     updatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
115:                 };
116:                 await suppliersService.updateSupplierInDb(supplierToUpdate);
117:                 savedSupplier = supplierToUpdate;
118:             } else {
119:                 // Create Logic
120:                 const { id, supplierId, ...newSupplierData } = currentSupplier;
121:                 const createdSupplier = await suppliersService.addSupplierToDb(newSupplierData as any);
122:                 savedSupplier = createdSupplier;
123:             }
124: 
125:             if (onSaveSuccess) {
126:                 onSaveSuccess(savedSupplier);
127:             }
128:             onClose();
129:         } catch (error) {
130:             console.error("Error saving supplier:", error);
131:             setError('حدث خطأ أثناء الحفظ');
132:         } finally {
133:             setSaving(false);
134:         }
135:     };
136:     const handleLogoUpload = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
137:         if (!e.target.files || e.target.files.length === 0) return;
138:         setUploadingLogo(true);
139:         try {
140:             const url = await cloudinaryService.uploadImage(e.target.files[0]);
141:             setCurrentSupplier(prev => ({ ...prev, logoUrl: url }));
142:         } catch (error) {
143:             setError('فشل رفع الشعار');
144:         } finally {
145:             setUploadingLogo(false);
146:         }
147:     };
148: 
149:     return (
150:         <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm p-4 animate-in fade-in duration-200">
151:             <div className="bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-xl shadow-2xl w-full max-w-4xl max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700">
152: 
153:                 {/* Header */}
154:                 <div className="p-6 border-b border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 flex justify-between items-center sticky top-0 bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 z-10">
155:                     <div>
156:                         <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white flex items-center gap-2">
157:                             {editingSupplier ? <Edit2 className="w-5 h-5" /> : <Building className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-500" />}
158:                             {editingSupplier ? 'تعديل بيانات المورد' : 'إضافة مورد جديد'}
159:                         </h2>
160:                         <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 mt-1">
161:                             {editingSupplier ? 'قم بتعديل بيانات المورد الحالية' : 'أدخل بيانات المورد الأساسية وجهات الاتصال'}

40:     return (
41:         <div className="flex items-start gap-3 py-2 group">

======= components\common\TaskImagesGallery.tsx =======
1: // TaskImagesGallery.tsx
2: import React, { useState } from "react";
3: 
4: interface TaskImagesGalleryProps {
5:   images: string[];
6: }
7: 
8: export const TaskImagesGallery: React.FC<TaskImagesGalleryProps> = ({ images }) => {
9:   const [selectedImage, setSelectedImage] = useState<string | null>(null);
10: 
11:   if (!images || images.length === 0) {
12:     return null;
13:   }
14: 
15:   // المودال المخصص لعرض الصورة المكبرة (للتأكد من عدم تكرار الكود مع SubmissionItemGallery)
16:   const ImageModal = ({ imageUrl, onClose, currentIndex, totalImages }: { 
17:     imageUrl: string, 
18:     onClose: () => void,
19:     currentIndex: number,
20:     totalImages: number
21:   }) => (
22:     <div 
23:       className="fixed inset-0 bg-black bg-opacity-90 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 animate-fade-in"
24:       onClick={onClose}
25:     >
26:       <div className="relative max-w-4xl max-h-full" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
27:         <button
28:           onClick={onClose}
29:           className="absolute -top-12 left-0 text-white text-3xl hover:text-gray-300 z-10"
30:         >
31:           &times;
32:         </button>
33:         <img
34:           src={imageUrl}
35:           alt="صورة مكبرة"
36:           className="max-w-full max-h-[80vh] object-contain rounded-lg"
37:         />
38:         <div className="absolute bottom-4 left-1/2 transform -translate-x-1/2 text-white bg-black bg-opacity-50 px-3 py-1 rounded-lg text-sm">
39:           {currentIndex} / {totalImages}
40:         </div>
41:       </div>
42:     </div>
43:   );
44: 
45:   return (
46:     <>
47:       <div className="mt-4">
48:         <h4 className="font-semibold text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 mb-3">
49:           صور المهمة ({images.length})
50:         </h4>
51:         <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
52:           {images.map((imageUrl, index) => (
53:             <div
54:               key={index}
55:               className="relative group cursor-pointer"
56:               onClick={() => setSelectedImage(imageUrl)}
57:             >
58:               <img
59:                 src={imageUrl}
60:                 alt={`صورة المهمة ${index + 1}`}
61:                 className="w-full h-24 object-cover rounded-lg border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-600 hover:border-blue-500 transition-colors"
62:               />
63:               <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black bg-opacity-0 group-hover:bg-opacity-20 transition-all rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center">
64:                 <span className="text-white opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 text-2xl">
65:                   🔍
66:                 </span>
67:               </div>
68:             </div>
69:           ))}
70:         </div>
71:       </div>
72: 
73:       {/* مودال عرض الصورة بالحجم الكامل */}
74:       {selectedImage && (
75:         <ImageModal 
76:           imageUrl={selectedImage}
77:           onClose={() => setSelectedImage(null)}
78:           currentIndex={images.indexOf(selectedImage) + 1}
79:           totalImages={images.length}
80:         />
81:       )}
82:     </>
83:   );
84: };

======= components\dashboard\TasksDistributionChart.tsx =======
1: 
2: import React from 'react';
3: import { PieChart, Pie, Cell, ResponsiveContainer, Tooltip, Legend } from 'recharts';
4: import { Task } from '../../types';
5: 
6: interface TasksDistributionChartProps {
7:     tasks: Task[];
8: }
9: 
10: const COLORS = ['#0088FE', '#00C49F', '#FFBB28', '#FF8042', '#8884d8'];
11: const STATUS_NAMES: Record<string, string> = {
12:     'NEW': 'جديدة',
13:     'ACCEPTED': 'تم القبول',
14:     'IN_PROGRESS': 'قيد العمل',
15:     'WAITING_FOR_REVIEW': 'مراجعة',
16:     'COMPLETED': 'مكتملة',
17:     'REJECTED': 'مرفوضة'
18: };
19: 
20: export const TasksDistributionChart: React.FC<TasksDistributionChartProps> = ({ tasks }) => {
21:     const data = React.useMemo(() => {
22:         const counts: Record<string, number> = {};
23:         tasks.forEach(t => {
24:             counts[t.status] = (counts[t.status] || 0) + 1;
25:         });
26:         return Object.keys(counts).map(key => ({
27:             name: STATUS_NAMES[key] || key,
28:             value: counts[key]
29:         }));
30:     }, [tasks]);
31: 
32:     return (
33:         <div className="bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 p-6 h-[400px]">
34:             <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white mb-4">توزيع المهام</h3>
35:             <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
36:                 <PieChart>
37:                     <Pie
38:                         data={data}
39:                         cx="50%"
40:                         cy="50%"
41:                         innerRadius={60}
42:                         outerRadius={100}
43:                         fill="#8884d8"
44:                         paddingAngle={5}
45:                         dataKey="value"
46:                     >
47:                         {data.map((entry, index) => (
48:                             <Cell key={`cell-${index}`} fill={COLORS[index % COLORS.length]} />
49:                         ))}
50:                     </Pie>
51:                     <Tooltip
52:                         contentStyle={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9)', borderRadius: '8px', border: 'none', boxShadow: '0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)' }}
53:                     />
54:                     <Legend />
55:                 </PieChart>
56:             </ResponsiveContainer>
57:         </div>
58:     );
59: };

======= components\finance\modals\DepositModal.tsx =======
1: import React, { useState } from 'react';
2: import { X, ArrowDownLeft } from 'lucide-react';
3: import { cashBoxTransactionsService } from '../../../services/firestoreService';
4: import { CashBox } from '../../../types';
5: 
6: interface DepositModalProps {
7:     isOpen: boolean;
8:     onClose: () => void;
9:     cashBox: CashBox;
10: }
11: 
12: export const DepositModal: React.FC<DepositModalProps> = ({ isOpen, onClose, cashBox }) => {
13:     const [amount, setAmount] = useState<number | ''>('');
14:     const [description, setDescription] = useState('');
15:     const [reference, setReference] = useState('');
16:     const [date, setDate] = useState(new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]);
17:     const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
18: 
19:     if (!isOpen) return null;
20: 
21:     const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
22:         e.preventDefault();
23:         if (!amount || amount <= 0 || !description) return;
24: 
25:         setIsLoading(true);
26:         try {
27:             await cashBoxTransactionsService.addTransaction({
28:                 cashBoxId: cashBox.id,
29:                 type: 'deposit',
30:                 amount: Number(amount),
31:                 currency: cashBox.currency,
32:                 description,
33:                 reference,
34:                 date,
35:                 createdBy: 'manager', // TODO: Get actual user ID
36:             });
37:             onClose();

39:             setAmount('');

41:             setReference('');
42:             setDate(new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]);

46:         } finally {
47:             setIsLoading(false);
48:         }
49:     };
50:

70:                             type="number"

68:   const [transferDate, setTransferDate] = useState(new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]);

72:   const [transferFee, setTransferFee] = useState(0);

29:   const handleImageUpload = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
30:     if (!e.target.files || e.target.files.length === 0) return;
31:     setUploadingImages(true);
32: 
33:     const files = Array.from(e.target.files);
34:     const newUrls: string[] = [];
35: 
36:     try {
37:       for (const file of files) {
38:         const typedFile = file as File;
39:         if (!typedFile.type.startsWith('image/')) continue;
40:         // ✅ نستخدم الدالة الجديدة التي تقبل أي ملف
41:         const imageUrl = await cloudinaryService.uploadFile(typedFile);
42:         if (imageUrl) newUrls.push(imageUrl);
43:       }
44: 
45:       setData((prev: any) => ({
46:         ...prev,
47:         [imagesKey]: [...(prev[imagesKey] || []), ...newUrls]
48:       }));
49:     } catch (error) {
50:       console.error("Error uploading images:", error);
51:       alert("فشل رفع الصور");
52:     } finally {
53:       setUploadingImages(false);
54:       e.target.value = '';
55:     }
56:   };
57:

59:     if (!e.target.files || e.target.files.length === 0) return;
60:     setUploadingPdfs(true);
61: 
62:     const files = Array.from(e.target.files);
63:     const newPdfFiles: any[] = [];
64: 
65:     try {

67:         const typedFile = file as File;
68:         if (typedFile.type !== 'application/pdf') {
69:           alert(`الملف ${typedFile.name} ليس PDF.`);
70:           continue;
71:         }
72:

83:           });

85:       }

95:       setUploadingPdfs(false);

======= components\forms\shared\BasicInfoSection.tsx =======

32: export const BasicInfoSection: React.FC<BasicInfoProps> = ({
33:   data,
34:   setData,
35:   suppliers,
36:   readOnly,
37:   isDeal,
38:   onStatusChangeRequest,
39:   onSupplierAdded,
40:   onAddSupplier,
41:   items = [],
42: }) => {

44:   const [showSupplierModal, setShowSupplierModal] = useState(false);

47:   const [supplierToEdit, setSupplierToEdit] = useState<Supplier | null>(null);
48:

50:   const [showDetails, setShowDetails] = useState(true);

57:   const handleViewSupplier = (supplierId: string) => {
58:     setViewingSupplierId(supplierId);
59:   };
60: 
61:   // دالة التعامل مع طلب تعديل المورد (سواء من البحث أو من مودال العرض)
62:   const handleEditSupplierRequest = (supplier: Supplier) => {
63:     // 1. أغلق مودال العرض إذا كان مفتوحاً
64:     setViewingSupplierId(null);
65: 
66:     // 2. جهز البيانات للتعديل
67:     setSupplierToEdit(supplier);
68: 
69:     // 3. افتح مودال التعديل
70:     setShowSupplierModal(true);
71:   };
72: 
73:   // دالة إضافة مورد جديد
74:   const handleAddNewSupplier = () => {
75:     setSupplierToEdit(null); // تصفير البيانات
76:     if (onAddSupplier) {
77:       onAddSupplier();
78:     } else {
79:       setShowSupplierModal(true);
80:     }
81:   };
82: 
83:   // --- الحسابات (نفس الكود السابق) ---
84:   const calculateGrandTotal = () => {
85:     if (data.totalAmount !== undefined && data.totalAmount > 0) {
86:       return data.totalAmount;
87:     }
88: 
89:     let subtotal = 0;
90:     const currentItems = items.length > 0 ? items : (data.items || []);
91: 
92:     if (currentItems.length > 0) {
93:       subtotal = currentItems.reduce((sum: number, item: any) => {
94:         const qty = parseFloat(item.quantity) || 0;
95:         const price = parseFloat(item.unitPrice) || 0;
96:         const itemDiscount = parseFloat(item.itemDiscount) || 0;
97:         const itemTotal = Math.max(0, (qty * price) - itemDiscount);
98:         return sum + itemTotal;
99:       }, 0);
100:     } else {
101:       subtotal = parseFloat(data.subtotal) || 0;
102:     }
103: 
104:     const discountAmount = parseFloat(data.discountAmount) || 0;
105:     const shippingCost = data.shippingIncluded ? 0 : (parseFloat(data.shippingCost) || 0);
106:     const netAfterDiscount = Math.max(0, subtotal - discountAmount);
107: 
108:     let taxAmount = 0;
109:     if (data.taxType === 'amount') {
110:       taxAmount = parseFloat(data.taxAmount) || 0;
111:     } else {
112:       const taxRate = parseFloat(data.taxRate) || 0;
113:       taxAmount = netAfterDiscount * (taxRate / 100);
114:     }
115: 
116:     return netAfterDiscount + taxAmount + shippingCost;
117:   };
118: 
119:   const grandTotal = calculateGrandTotal();
120: 
121:   const handleSelectSupplier = (id: string) => {
122:     const supplier = suppliers.find(s => s.id === id);
123:     setData((prev: any) => ({
124:       ...prev,
125:       supplierId: id,
126:       factoryName: supplier?.tradeName || ''
127:     }));
128:     setSupplierSearch('');
129:   };
130:

132:     if (supplier.salesRepName && supplier.salesRepName.trim() !== '') {
133:       return supplier.salesRepName;
134:     }
135:     if (supplier.tradeName && supplier.tradeName.trim() !== '') {
136:       return supplier.tradeName;
137:     }
138:     return supplier.salesRepName || '';
139:   };
140: 
141:   const enhancedSuppliers = suppliers.map(supplier => ({
142:     ...supplier,
143:     displayName: getSupplierDisplayName(supplier)
144:   }));
145: 
146:   return (
147:     <div className="space-y-4">

76:             >

86:               onChange={e => onUpdate('warrantyDuration', parseFloat(e.target.value))}

116:                 }}

131:               disabled={readOnly || data.shippingIncluded}
132:               className={`w-full h-8 pl-8 pr-2 text-sm border rounded-lg ${data.shippingIncluded
133:                 ? 'bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-800 text-gray-400 border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700'
134:                 : 'bg-white dark:bg-gray-700 border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-600'
135:                 }`}

150:               className="w-full h-8 px-2 text-sm border border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-600 rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-gray-700"

171:           placeholder="ملاحظات شحن..."
172:           disabled={readOnly}
173:         />
174:       </div>
175:     </div>

179: // ─── 2. المدفوعات المحلية ───
180: interface LocalPaymentsCardProps {
181:   data: any;
182:   readOnly?: boolean;
183:   onUpdate: (field: string, value: any) => void;
184:   totalLocalPayments: number;
185: }
186: 
187: const LocalPaymentsCard: React.FC<LocalPaymentsCardProps> = ({
188:   data,
189:   readOnly,
190:   onUpdate,
191:   totalLocalPayments
192: }) => {
193:   const handleUpdate = (field: string, value: any) => {
194:     const updatedData = { ...data, [field]: value };
195:     if (field === 'calculationMethod') {
196:       if (value === 'lump_sum') {
197:         updatedData.customsClearanceFees = 0;
198:         updatedData.customsDuties = 0;
199:         updatedData.portFees = 0;
200:         updatedData.internalShippingFees = 0;
201:       } else {
202:         updatedData.lumpSumAmount = 0;
203:       }
204:     }
205:     onUpdate('localPayments', updatedData);
206:   };
207: 
208:   return (
209:     <div className="bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 overflow-hidden h-full">
210:       <div className="p-3 bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-50 to-purple-50 dark:from-indigo-900/20 dark:to-purple-900/20 border-b">
211:         <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
212:           <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
213:             <div className="p-1.5 bg-indigo-500 rounded-lg">
214:               <CreditCard className="w-4 h-4 text-white" />
215:             </div>
216:             <h3 className="font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-white text-sm">المدفوعات المحلية</h3>
217:           </div>
218:           <button
219:             onClick={() => !readOnly && handleUpdate('includedInPrice', !data.includedInPrice)}
220:             disabled={readOnly}
221:             className={`text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded-full transition-colors ${data.includedInPrice
222:               ? 'bg-green-100 dark:bg-green-900/40 text-green-700 dark:text-green-300'
223:               : 'bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-700 text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300'
224:               }`}
225:           >
226:             {data.includedInPrice ? 'مشمولة' : 'غير مشمولة'}
227:           </button>
228:         </div>
229:       </div>
230: 
231:       <div className="p-3 space-y-3">
232:         {!data.includedInPrice && (
233:           <>
234:             <div className="flex gap-1 p-1 bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-700/50 rounded-lg">
235:               <button
236:                 onClick={() => handleUpdate('calculationMethod', 'detailed')}
237:                 disabled={readOnly}
238:                 className={`flex-1 py-1.5 text-xs rounded transition-colors ${data.calculationMethod === 'detailed'
239:                   ? 'bg-white dark:bg-gray-600 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-300 font-medium'
240:                   : 'text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400'
241:                   }`}
242:               >
243:                 تفصيلي
244:               </button>
245:               <button
246:                 onClick={() => handleUpdate('calculationMethod', 'lump_sum')}
247:                 disabled={readOnly}
248:                 className={`flex-1 py-1.5 text-xs rounded transition-colors ${data.calculationMethod === 'lump_sum'
249:                   ? 'bg-white dark:bg-gray-600 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-300 font-medium'
250:                   : 'text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400'
251:                   }`}
252:               >
253:                 مبلغ شامل
254:               </button>
255:             </div>
256: 
257:             {data.calculationMethod === 'detailed' ? (
258:               <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
259:                 <div>
260:                   <label className="text-xs text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 block mb-1">مخلص جمركي</label>
261:                   <input
262:                     type="number"
263:                     value={data.customsClearanceFees || ''}
264:                     onChange={(e) => handleUpdate('customsClearanceFees', parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0)}
265:                     disabled={readOnly}
266:                     className="w-full h-8 px-2 text-sm border border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-600 rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-gray-700"
267:                     placeholder="0.00"
268:                   />
269:                 </div>
270:                 <div>
271:                   <label className="text-xs text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 block mb-1">جمارك</label>
272:                   <input
273:                     type="number"
274:                     value={data.customsDuties || ''}
275:                     onChange={(e) => handleUpdate('customsDuties', parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0)}
276:                     disabled={readOnly}
277:                     className="w-full h-8 px-2 text-sm border border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-600 rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-gray-700"
278:                     placeholder="0.00"
279:                   />
280:                 </div>
281:                 <div>
282:                   <label className="text-xs text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 block mb-1">رسوم ميناء</label>
283:                   <input
284:                     type="number"
285:                     value={data.portFees || ''}
286:                     onChange={(e) => handleUpdate('portFees', parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0)}
287:                     disabled={readOnly}
288:                     className="w-full h-8 px-2 text-sm border border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-600 rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-gray-700"
289:                     placeholder="0.00"
290:                   />
291:                 </div>
292:                 <div>
293:                   <label className="text-xs text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 block mb-1">شحن داخلي</label>
294:                   <input
295:                     type="number"
296:                     value={data.internalShippingFees || ''}
297:                     onChange={(e) => handleUpdate('internalShippingFees', parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0)}
298:                     disabled={readOnly}
299:                     className="w-full h-8 px-2 text-sm border border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-600 rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-gray-700"
300:                     placeholder="0.00"
301:                   />
302:                 </div>
303:               </div>
304:             ) : (
305:               <div>
306:                 <label className="text-xs text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 block mb-1">المبلغ الإجمالي الشامل</label>
307:                 <div className="relative">
308:                   <input
309:                     type="number"
310:                     value={data.lumpSumAmount || ''}
311:                     onChange={(e) => handleUpdate('lumpSumAmount', parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0)}
312:                     disabled={readOnly}
313:                     className="w-full h-8 pl-8 px-2 text-sm border border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-600 rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-gray-700 font-bold"
314:                     placeholder="0.00"
315:                   />
316:                   <span className="text-gray-500 absolute left-2 top-2 text-xs font-bold leading-none">
317:                     {data.currency === 'ILS' ? '₪' : '$'}
318:                   </span>
319:                 </div>
320:               </div>
321:             )}
322:           </>
323:         )}
324: 
325:         <div className="pt-2 border-t border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 flex justify-between items-center">
326:           <span className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">الإجمالي:</span>
327:           <span className="font-bold text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 text-lg">
328:             ${totalLocalPayments.toLocaleString()}
329:           </span>
330:         </div>
331:       </div>
332:     </div>
333:   );
334: };

336: // ─── 3. الملخص المالي ───
337: interface FinancialSummaryCardProps {
338:   subtotal: number;
339:   discountAmount: number;
340:   taxRate: number;
341:   taxAmount: number;
342:   shippingCost: number;
343:   shippingIncluded: boolean;
344:   totalLocalPayments: number;
345:   localPaymentsIncluded: boolean;
346:   grandTotal: number;
347:   paidAmount: number;
348:   remainingAmount: number;
349:   readOnly?: boolean;
350:   onUpdateTax: (value: number) => void;
351:   onUpdateDiscount: (value: number) => void;
352:   taxInputMode: 'percentage' | 'amount';
353:   setTaxInputMode: (mode: 'percentage' | 'amount') => void;
354:   discountInput: string;
355:   setDiscountInput: (value: string) => void;
356:   taxInput: string;
357:   setTaxInput: (value: string) => void;
358:   showLocalPayments?: boolean;
359:   currency?: 'USD' | 'ILS';
360: }
361: 
362: const FinancialSummaryCard: React.FC<FinancialSummaryCardProps> = ({
363:   subtotal,
364:   discountAmount,
365:   taxRate,
366:   taxAmount,
367:   shippingCost,
368:   shippingIncluded,
369:   totalLocalPayments,
370:   localPaymentsIncluded,
371:   grandTotal,
372:   paidAmount,
373:   remainingAmount,
374:   readOnly,
375:   onUpdateTax,
376:   onUpdateDiscount,
377:   taxInputMode,
378:   setTaxInputMode,
379:   discountInput,
380:   setDiscountInput,
381:   taxInput,
382:   setTaxInput,
383:   showLocalPayments = true,
384:   currency = 'USD',
385: }) => {
386:   const symbol = currency === 'ILS' ? '₪' : '$';
387:   const handleDiscountUpdate = () => {
388:     const value = Math.min(subtotal, Math.max(0, parseFloat(discountInput) || 0));
389:     onUpdateDiscount(value);
390:   };
391: 
392:   const handleTaxUpdate = () => {
393:     const value = parseFloat(taxInput) || 0;
394:     onUpdateTax(value);
395:   };
396: 
397:   return (
398:     <div className="bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 overflow-hidden h-full">
399:       <div className="p-3 bg-gradient-to-r from-green-50 to-emerald-50 dark:from-green-900/20 dark:to-emerald-900/20 border-b">
400:         <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
401:           <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
402:             <div className="p-1.5 bg-green-500 rounded-lg">
403:               <DollarSign className="w-4 h-4 text-white" />
404:             </div>
405:             <h3 className="font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-white text-sm">الملخص المالي</h3>
406:           </div>
407:           <div className="text-lg font-bold text-green-600 dark:text-green-400">
408:             {symbol}{grandTotal.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}
409:           </div>
410:         </div>
411:       </div>
412: 
413:       <div className="p-3 space-y-3">
414:         {/* سعر المنتجات */}
415:         <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
416:           <span className="text-sm text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">سعر المنتجات</span>
417:           <span className="font-medium text-gray-900 dark:text-white">{symbol}{subtotal.toLocaleString()}</span>
418:         </div>
419: 
420:         {/* الخصم */}
421:         <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
422:           <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">
423:             <Tag className="w-3 h-3 text-red-500" />
424:             <span>الخصم</span>
425:             {!readOnly && (
426:               <button
427:                 onClick={() => setDiscountInput(discountAmount.toString())}
428:                 className="text-xs text-blue-500 hover:text-blue-700"
429:               >
430:                 ✏️
431:               </button>
432:             )}
433:           </div>
434:           <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
435:             {!readOnly ? (
436:               <input
437:                 type="number"
438:                 value={discountInput}
439:                 onChange={(e) => setDiscountInput(e.target.value)}
440:                 onBlur={handleDiscountUpdate}
441:                 onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && handleDiscountUpdate()}
442:                 className="w-20 px-2 py-1 text-sm border border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-600 rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-gray-700"
443:               />
444:             ) : (
445:               <span className={discountAmount > 0 ? "text-red-600 font-medium" : "text-gray-400"}>
446:                 {discountAmount > 0 ? `-${symbol}${discountAmount.toLocaleString()}` : '-'}
447:               </span>
448:             )}
449:           </div>
450:         </div>
451: 
452:         {/* الضريبة */}
453:         <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
454:           <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">
455:             <Percent className="w-3 h-3" />
456:             <span>الضريبة</span>
457:             {!readOnly && (
458:               <div className="flex gap-1">
459:                 <button
460:                   onClick={() => setTaxInputMode('percentage')}
461:                   disabled={readOnly}
462:                   className={`text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded ${taxInputMode === 'percentage' ? 'bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-900 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-300' : 'text-gray-500'}`}
463:                 >
464:                   %
465:                 </button>
466:                 <button
467:                   onClick={() => setTaxInputMode('amount')}
468:                   disabled={readOnly}
469:                   className={`text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded ${taxInputMode === 'amount' ? 'bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-900 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-300' : 'text-gray-500'}`}
470:                 >
471:                   {symbol}
472:                 </button>
473:               </div>
474:             )}
475:           </div>
476:           <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
477:             {!readOnly ? (
478:               <input
479:                 type="number"
480:                 value={taxInput}
481:                 onChange={(e) => setTaxInput(e.target.value)}
482:                 onBlur={handleTaxUpdate}
483:                 onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && handleTaxUpdate()}
484:                 className="w-20 px-2 py-1 text-sm border border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-600 rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-gray-700"
485:               />
486:             ) : (
487:               <span className="font-medium text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
488:                 {taxInputMode === 'percentage'
489:                   ? `${symbol}${taxAmount.toFixed(2)} (${taxRate}%)`
490:                   : `${symbol}${taxAmount.toFixed(2)}`
491:                 }
492:               </span>
493:             )}
494:           </div>
495:         </div>
496: 
497:         {/* الشحن */}
498:         {(shippingCost > 0 || shippingIncluded) && (
499:           <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
500:             <span className="text-sm text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">الشحن</span>
501:             <span className="font-medium">
502:               {shippingIncluded ? (
503:                 <span className="text-xs text-green-600">متضمن</span>
504:               ) : `${symbol}${shippingCost.toLocaleString()}`}
505:             </span>
506:           </div>
507:         )}
508: 
509:         {/* المدفوعات المحلية */}
510:         {showLocalPayments && (totalLocalPayments > 0 || localPaymentsIncluded) && (
511:           <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
512:             <span className="text-sm text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">مدفوعات محلية</span>
513:             <span className="font-medium">
514:               {localPaymentsIncluded ? (
515:                 <span className="text-xs text-green-600">مشمولة</span>
516:               ) : `+${symbol}${totalLocalPayments.toLocaleString()}`}
517:             </span>
518:           </div>
519:         )}
520: 
521:         <div className="border-t border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 my-2"></div>
522: 
523:         {/* الإجمالي */}
524:         <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
525:           <span className="font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">الإجمالي</span>
526:           <span className="text-xl font-bold text-green-600 dark:text-green-400">
527:             {symbol}{grandTotal.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}
528:           </span>
529:         </div>
530: 
531:         <div className="border-t border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 my-2"></div>
532: 
533:         {/* المدفوع والمتبقي */}
534:         <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-sm">
535:           <span className="text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">المدفوع</span>
536:           <span className="font-medium text-green-600 dark:text-green-400">{symbol}{paidAmount.toLocaleString()}</span>
537:         </div>
538:         <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-sm">
539:           <span className="text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">المتبقي</span>
540:           <span className="font-medium text-orange-600 dark:text-orange-400">{symbol}{remainingAmount.toLocaleString()}</span>
541:         </div>
542: 
543:         {/* تقدم الدفع */}
544:         {grandTotal > 0 && (
545:           <div className="pt-2 border-t border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700">
546:             <div className="flex justify-between text-xs text-gray-500 mb-1">
547:               <span>تقدم الدفع</span>
548:               <span>{Math.round((paidAmount / grandTotal) * 100)}%</span>
549:             </div>
550:             <div className="h-1.5 bg-gray-200 dark:bg-gray-700 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
551:               <div
552:                 className="h-full bg-green-500 transition-all"

======= components\items\ItemForm.tsx =======
1: import React, { useState } from 'react';
2: import { Item, Category, SubCategory, Brand, User } from '@/types';
3: import { itemsService } from '@/services/firestoreService';
4: import { cloudinaryService } from '@/services/cloudinaryService';
5: 
6: import { ArrowRight, Plus, Shield, Save, Upload, X, Loader2, ShoppingBag, StoreIcon } from 'lucide-react';
7: 
8: interface ItemFormProps {
9:     initialItem: Partial<Item>;
10:     categories: Category[];
11:     subCategories: SubCategory[];
12:     brands: Brand[];
13:     user: User;
14:     onCancel: () => void;
15:     onSave: () => void;
16:     onOpenCategoryModal: () => void;
17:     onOpenSubCategoryModal: () => void;
18:     onOpenBrandModal: () => void;
19: }
20: 
21: export const ItemForm: React.FC<ItemFormProps> = ({
22:     initialItem, categories, subCategories, brands, user,
23:     onCancel, onSave, onOpenCategoryModal, onOpenSubCategoryModal, onOpenBrandModal
24: }) => {
25:     const [currentItem, setCurrentItem] = useState<Partial<Item>>(initialItem);
26:     const [uploadingImages, setUploadingImages] = useState<boolean[]>([false, false, false]);
27: 
28:     const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'details' | 'store'>('details');
29: 
30: 
31:     // التحقق من صلاحيات المستخدم للرمز الجمركي
32:     const canEditHSCode = user.role === 'manager' || user.role === 'procurement';
33: 
34:     // 🟢 فلترة الفئات الفرعية بناءً على الفئة الرئيسية المختارة
35:     const filteredSubCategories = subCategories.filter(
36:         sub => sub.categoryId === currentItem.categoryId
37:     );
38: 
39:     const handleSave = async () => {
40:         if (!currentItem.name || !currentItem.categoryId) {
41:             alert('يرجى تعبئة الحقول الأساسية (الاسم والتصنيف)');
42:             return;
43:         }
44: 
45:         const selectedCat = categories.find(c => c.id === currentItem.categoryId);
46:         const selectedSubCat = subCategories.find(s => s.id === currentItem.subCategoryId);
47:         const selectedBrand = brands.find(b => b.id === currentItem.brandId);
48: 
49:         const itemData: any = {
50:             ...currentItem,
51:             id: currentItem.id || crypto.randomUUID(),
52:             categoryName: selectedCat?.name || '',
53:             subCategoryName: selectedSubCat?.name || '', // حفظ اسم الفئة الفرعية
54:             brandName: selectedBrand?.name || '',
55:             specifications: currentItem.specifications || '', // إضافة المواصفات
56:             imageUrls: (currentItem.imageUrls || []).filter(url => url && url.trim() !== ''),
57:             quantity: currentItem.quantity ?? 0,
58:             hsCodePrimary: currentItem.hsCodePrimary || '',
59:             hsCodeAlternative: currentItem.hsCodeAlternative || '', // حفظ HS Code الاحتياطي
60:             createdAt: currentItem.createdAt || new Date().toISOString(),
61:             updatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
62:         };
63: 
64:         try {
65:             if (currentItem.id) {
66:                 await itemsService.updateItemInDb(itemData);
67:             } else {
68:                 await itemsService.addItemToDb(itemData);
69:             }
70:             onSave();
71:         } catch (error) {
72:             console.error("Error saving item:", error);
73:             alert("حدث خطأ أثناء الحفظ");
74:         }
75:     };
76: 
77:     const handleImageUpload = async (index: number, e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
78:         if (!e.target.files || e.target.files.length === 0) return;
79:         const newUploading = [...uploadingImages];
80:         newUploading[index] = true;
81:         setUploadingImages(newUploading);
82: 
83:         try {
84:             const url = await cloudinaryService.uploadImage(e.target.files[0]);
85:             const newImages = [...(currentItem.imageUrls || ['', '', ''])];
86:             newImages[index] = url;
87:             setCurrentItem(prev => ({ ...prev, imageUrls: newImages }));
88:         } catch (error) {
89:             alert("فشل رفع الصورة");
90:         } finally {
91:             newUploading[index] = false;
92:             setUploadingImages(newUploading);
93:         }
94:     };
95: 
96:     return (
97:         <div className="bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-xl shadow-sm h-full flex flex-col">
98:             {/* Header */}
99:             <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-6 py-4 border-b border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700">
100:                 <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
101:                     <button onClick={onCancel} className="p-2 hover:bg-gray-100 dark:hover:bg-gray-700 rounded-full transition-colors">
102:                         <ArrowRight className="w-5 h-5 text-gray-500" />
103:                     </button>
104:                     <div>
105:                         <h1 className="text-xl font-bold dark:text-white">
106:                             {currentItem.id ? 'تعديل الصنف' : 'إضافة صنف جديد'}
107:                         </h1>
108:                         <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
109:                             {activeTab === 'details' ? 'بيانات التوريد والمواصفات' : 'بيانات العرض في المتجر'}
110:                         </p>
111:                     </div>
112:                 </div>
113: 
114:                 {/* Tabs Switcher - Compact */}
115:                 <div className="bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-900 p-1 rounded-lg flex text-sm">
116:                     <button
117:                         onClick={() => setActiveTab('details')}
118:                         className={`px-4 py-1.5 rounded-md flex items-center gap-2 transition-all ${activeTab === 'details'
119:                             ? 'bg-white dark:bg-gray-700 shadow text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 font-medium'
120:                             : 'text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-400'
121:                             }`}
122:                     >
123:                         <ShoppingBag className="w-4 h-4" /> المشتريات
124:                     </button>
125:                     <button
126:                         onClick={() => setActiveTab('store')}
127:                         className={`px-4 py-1.5 rounded-md flex items-center gap-2 transition-all ${activeTab === 'store'
128:                             ? 'bg-white dark:bg-gray-700 shadow text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400 font-medium'
129:                             : 'text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-400'
130:                             }`}
131:                     >
132:                         <StoreIcon className="w-4 h-4" /> المتجر
133:                     </button>
134:                 </div>
135:             </div>
136: 
137:             <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-6">
138:                 <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
139: 
140:                     {/* 📷 Shared Section: Images (Always Visible) */}
141:                     <div className="lg:col-span-3 space-y-4">
142:                         <label className="block text-sm font-medium mb-2 dark:text-gray-300">صور الصنف</label>
143:                         <div className="space-y-3">
144:                             {(currentItem.imageUrls || ['', '', '']).map((url, index) => (
145:                                 <div key={index} className="relative aspect-square bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-900 rounded-lg border border-dashed border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-600 overflow-hidden hover:border-blue-400 transition-colors group">
146:                                     {url ? (
147:                                         <>
148:                                             <img src={url} alt="" className="w-full h-full object-cover" />
149:                                             <button
150:                                                 onClick={() => {
151:                                                     const newImages = [...(currentItem.imageUrls || [])];
152:                                                     newImages[index] = '';
153:                                                     setCurrentItem({ ...currentItem, imageUrls: newImages });
154:                                                 }}
155:                                                 className="absolute top-1 right-1 p-1 bg-red-500 text-white rounded shadow-sm opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity"
156:                                             >
157:                                                 <X className="w-3 h-3" />
158:                                             </button>
159:                                         </>
160:                                     ) : (
161:                                         <label className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center w-full h-full cursor-pointer">
162:                                             {uploadingImages[index] ? <Loader2 className="animate-spin text-blue-500" /> : <Upload className="w-6 h-6 text-gray-400" />}
163:                                             <span className="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-2">صورة {index + 1}</span>
164:                                             <input type="file" accept="image/*" className="hidden" onChange={(e) => handleImageUpload(index, e)} />
165:                                         </label>
166:                                     )}
167:                                 </div>
168:                             ))}
169:                         </div>
170:                     </div>
171: 
172:                     {/* 📝 Form Content Area */}
173:                     <div className="lg:col-span-9">
174: 
175:                         {/* Tab 1: Procurement & Basic Info */}
176:                         {activeTab === 'details' && (
177:                             <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4 animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-bottom-2 duration-300">
178:                                 {/* Basic Info Group */}
179:                                 <div className="md:col-span-2 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-900/50 p-4 rounded-lg border border-gray-100 dark:border-gray-700">
180:                                     <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white mb-3">البيانات الأساسية</h3>
181:                                     <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
182:                                         <div>
183:                                             <label className="block text-xs font-medium mb-1 dark:text-gray-400">اسم الصنف (مشتريات) *</label>
184:                                             <input
185:                                                 type="text"
186:                                                 value={currentItem.name || ''}
187:                                                 onChange={(e) => setCurrentItem({ ...currentItem, name: e.target.value })}
188:                                                 className="w-full px-3 py-2 text-sm rounded-lg border dark:bg-gray-700 dark:border-gray-600 dark:text-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500"
189:                                             />
190:                                         </div>
191:                                         <div>
192:                                             <label className="block text-xs font-medium mb-1 dark:text-gray-400">رقم الموديل</label>
193:                                             <input
194:                                                 type="text"
195:                                                 value={currentItem.modelNumber || ''}
196:                                                 onChange={(e) => setCurrentItem({ ...currentItem, modelNumber: e.target.value })}
197:                                                 className="w-full px-3 py-2 text-sm rounded-lg border dark:bg-gray-700 dark:border-gray-600 dark:text-white dir-ltr text-right"
198:                                             />
199:                                         </div>
200:                                     </div>
201:                                 </div>
202: 
203:                                 {/* Categorization Group */}
204:                                 <div className="md:col-span-2 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-900/50 p-4 rounded-lg border border-gray-100 dark:border-gray-700">
205:                                     <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white mb-3">التصنيف والماركة</h3>
206:                                     <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
207:                                         <div>
208:                                             <label className="block text-xs font-medium mb-1 dark:text-gray-400">التصنيف الرئيسي *</label>
209:                                             <div className="flex gap-1">
210:                                                 <select
211:                                                     value={currentItem.categoryId || ''}
212:                                                     onChange={(e) => setCurrentItem({ ...currentItem, categoryId: e.target.value, subCategoryId: '' })}
213:                                                     className="flex-1 px-2 py-2 text-sm rounded-lg border dark:bg-gray-700 dark:border-gray-600 dark:text-white"
214:                                                 >
215:                                                     <option value="">اختر...</option>
216:                                                     {categories.map(cat => <option key={cat.id} value={cat.id}>{cat.name}</option>)}
217:                                                 </select>
218:                                                 <button type="button" onClick={onOpenCategoryModal} className="p-2 bg-gray-200 dark:bg-gray-600 rounded"><Plus className="w-4 h-4" /></button>
219:                                             </div>
220:                                         </div>
221: 
222:                                         <div>
223:                                             <label className="block text-xs font-medium mb-1 dark:text-gray-400">التصنيف الفرعي</label>
224:                                             <div className="flex gap-1">
225:                                                 <select

227:                                                     onChange={(e) => setCurrentItem({ ...currentItem, subCategoryId: e.target.value })}
228:                                                     disabled={!currentItem.categoryId}
229:                                                     className="flex-1 px-2 py-2 text-sm rounded-lg border dark:bg-gray-700 dark:border-gray-600 dark:text-white disabled:opacity-50"

231:                                                     <option value="">اختر...</option>
232:                                                     {filteredSubCategories.map(sub => <option key={sub.id} value={sub.id}>{sub.name}</option>)}

234:                                                 <button type="button" onClick={onOpenSubCategoryModal} disabled={!currentItem.categoryId} className="p-2 bg-gray-200 dark:bg-gray-600 rounded disabled:opacity-50"><Plus className="w-4 h-4" /></button>
235:                                             </div>
236:                                         </div>
237:

239:                                             <label className="block text-xs font-medium mb-1 dark:text-gray-400">الماركة</label>

======= components\modals\EditUserModal.tsx =======
1: import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
2: import { User, UserRole } from '../../types';
3: 
4: // تحديد نوع حالة التوظيف
5: type EmploymentStatus = 'probation' | 'permanent' | 'intern';
6: 
7: interface EditUserModalProps {
8:     isOpen: boolean;
9:     onClose: () => void;
10:     user: User;
11:     onSave: (user: User) => void;
12: }
13: 
14: export const EditUserModal: React.FC<EditUserModalProps> = ({ isOpen, onClose, user, onSave }) => {
15:     const [name, setName] = useState(user.name);
16:     const [role, setRole] = useState<UserRole>(user.role);
17:     // إضافة حالة لحالة التوظيف، مع افتراض أن الحقل موجود في واجهة User
18:     const [employmentStatus, setEmploymentStatus] = useState<EmploymentStatus>(
19:         (user.employmentStatus as EmploymentStatus) || 'probation' 
20:     ); 
21: 
22:     useEffect(() => {
23:         setName(user.name);
24:         setRole(user.role);
25:         setEmploymentStatus((user.employmentStatus as EmploymentStatus) || 'probation');
26:     }, [user]);
27: 
28:     if (!isOpen) return null;
29: 
30:     const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
31:         e.preventDefault();
32:         onSave({ 
33:             ...user, 
34:             name, 
35:             role,
36:             employmentStatus // حفظ الحالة الجديدة
37:         });
38:     };
39: 
40:     return (
41:         <div 
42:             className="fixed inset-0 bg-black bg-opacity-50 z-40 flex items-center justify-center p-4 animate-fade-in"
43:             onClick={onClose}
44:         >
45:             <div 
46:                 className="bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-2xl shadow-xl w-full max-w-md p-8 space-y-6 transform transition-all"
47:                 onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}
48:             >
49:                 <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
50:                     <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800 dark:text-gray-100">تعديل المستخدم</h2>
51:                     <button onClick={onClose} className="text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 dark:hover:text-gray-200 text-3xl">&times;</button>
52:                 </div>
53:                
54:                 <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
55:                     <div>
56:                         <label htmlFor="userName" className="block text-md font-medium text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 mb-1">اسم المستخدم</label>
57:                         <input 
58:                             type="text" 
59:                             id="userName" 
60:                             value={name} 
61:                             onChange={e => setName(e.target.value)} 
62:                             className="w-full p-2 border border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-600 rounded-lg bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-700 text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-200" 
63:                             required 
64:                         />
65:                     </div>
66:                     {/* حقل حالة التوظيف الجديد */}
67:                     <div>
68:                         <label htmlFor="employmentStatus" className="block text-md font-medium text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 mb-1">الحالة الوظيفية</label>
69:                         <select 
70:                             id="employmentStatus" 
71:                             value={employmentStatus} 
72:                             onChange={e => setEmploymentStatus(e.target.value as EmploymentStatus)} 
73:                             className="w-full p-2 border border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-600 rounded-lg bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-700 text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-200"
74:                         >
75:                             <option value="probation">تحت الاختبار</option>

77:                             <option value="intern">متدرب</option>
78:                         </select>

======= components\modals\EmployeeDetailsModal.tsx =======
1: import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
2: import { User } from '../../types';
3: 
4: interface EmployeeDetailsModalProps {
5:     isOpen: boolean;
6:     onClose: () => void;
7:     user: User;
8:     onApprove: (user: User) => void;
9:     onReject: (userId: string) => void;
10:     onSaveNotes: (userId: string, notes: string) => Promise<void>; // New prop
11: }
12: 
13: export const EmployeeDetailsModal: React.FC<EmployeeDetailsModalProps> = ({ 
14:     isOpen, 
15:     onClose, 
16:     user, 
17:     onApprove, 
18:     onReject,
19:     onSaveNotes
20: }) => {
21:     const [notes, setNotes] = useState(user.notes || '');
22:     const [isSavingNotes, setIsSavingNotes] = useState(false);
23: 
24:     // Update local state when user prop changes
25:     useEffect(() => {
26:         setNotes(user.notes || '');
27:     }, [user]);
28: 
29:     if (!isOpen) return null;
30: 
31:     const handleSaveNotesClick = async () => {
32:         setIsSavingNotes(true);
33:         try {
34:             await onSaveNotes(user.id, notes);
35:             // Optional: Show success indication visually if needed
36:         } catch (error) {
37:             console.error("Failed to save notes", error);
38:             alert("فشل حفظ الملاحظات");
39:         } finally {
40:             setIsSavingNotes(false);
41:         }
42:     };
43:

======= components\modals\SubmissionForm.tsx =======
1: import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
2: import { Submission, SubmissionItem } from "../../types";
3: import { DeleteIcon } from "../icons/DeleteIcon";
4: import { cloudinaryService } from "../../services/cloudinaryService";
5: 
6: interface SubmissionFormProps {
7:   initialData?: Submission;
8:   onSubmit: (data: any) => void;
9:   onCancel: () => void;
10:   isEditMode?: boolean;
11:   userRole: string;
12:   taskId?: string;
13:   userId?: string;
14: }
15: 
16: const SubmissionForm: React.FC<SubmissionFormProps> = ({
17:   initialData,
18:   onSubmit,
19:   onCancel,
20:   isEditMode = false,
21:   userRole,
22:   taskId,
23:   userId,
24: }) => {
25:   const [items, setItems] = useState<SubmissionItem[]>([]);
26:   const [currentLink, setCurrentLink] = useState("");
27:   const [currentPrice, setCurrentPrice] = useState("");
28:   const [currentNotes, setCurrentNotes] = useState("");
29:   const [currentAttachment, setCurrentAttachment] = useState<{
30:     name: string;
31:     url: string;
32:     type: "file" | "images";
33:   } | null>(null);
34:   const [selectedImages, setSelectedImages] = useState<File[]>([]);
35:   const [imagePreviews, setImagePreviews] = useState<string[]>([]);
36:   const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);
37:   const [showConfirmDialog, setShowConfirmDialog] = useState(false);
38: 
39:   const storageKey =
40:     taskId && userId ? `submission_draft_${taskId}_${userId}` : null;
41: 
42:   useEffect(() => {
43:     let initialItems: SubmissionItem[] = [];
44:     if (storageKey) {
45:       const savedData = localStorage.getItem(storageKey);
46:       if (savedData) {
47:         try {
48:           const parsedData = JSON.parse(savedData);
49:           if (parsedData.items && Array.isArray(parsedData.items)) {
50:             initialItems = parsedData.items;
51:           }
52:         } catch (error) {
53:           console.error("Error loading saved data", error);
54:         }
55:       }
56:     }
57: 
58:     if (initialItems.length === 0 && initialData?.items) {
59:       initialItems = initialData.items.map((item) => ({
60:         ...item,
61:         isNew: false,
62:       }));
63:     }
64:     setItems(initialItems);
65:   }, [initialData, storageKey]);
66: 
67:   useEffect(() => {
68:     if (storageKey && items.length > 0) {
69:       const saveData = {
70:         items: items,
71:         timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
72:       };
73:       localStorage.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify(saveData));
74:     }
75:   }, [items, storageKey]);
76: 
77:   // معالجة اختيار ملف PDF أو Word
78:   const handleFileChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
79:     if (e.target.files && e.target.files[0]) {
80:       const file = e.target.files[0];
81: 
82:       // التحقق من نوع الملف
83:       const allowedTypes = [
84:         "application/pdf",
85:         "application/msword",
86:         "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document",
87:       ];
88:       if (!allowedTypes.includes(file.type)) {
89:         alert("يُسمح فقط بملفات PDF و Word");
90:         return;
91:       }
92: 
93:       // التحقق من حجم الملف (10MB كحد أقصى)
94:       if (file.size > 10 * 1024 * 1024) {
95:         alert("حجم الملف كبير جداً. الحد الأقصى 10MB");
96:         return;
97:       }
98: 
99:       const reader = new FileReader();
100:       reader.onloadend = () => {
101:         setCurrentAttachment({
102:           name: file.name,
103:           url: reader.result as string,
104:           type: "file",
105:         });
106:         // مسح الصور إذا كان هناك ملف
107:         setSelectedImages([]);
108:         setImagePreviews([]);
109:       };
110:       reader.readAsDataURL(file);
111:     }
112:   };
113: 
114:   // معالجة اختيار الصور
115:   const handleImageSelect = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
116:     const files = e.target.files;
117:     if (!files) return;
118: 
119:     const newFiles = Array.from(files);
120: 
121:     // التحقق من عدد الصور
122:     if (selectedImages.length + newFiles.length > 3) {
123:       alert("يمكنك رفع最多 3 صور فقط");
124:       return;
125:     }
126: 
127:     // التحقق من أنواع الملفات
128:     const validFiles = newFiles.filter((file: File) => {
129:       const isValidType = file.type.startsWith("image/");
130:       if (!isValidType) {
131:         alert(`الملف ${file.name} ليس صورة`);
132:       }
133:       return isValidType;
134:     });
135: 
136:     setSelectedImages((prev) => [...prev, ...validFiles]);
137: 
138:     // إنشاء معاينات للصور
139:     validFiles.forEach((file: File) => {
140:       const reader = new FileReader();
141:       reader.onload = (event: ProgressEvent<FileReader>) => {
142:         const target = event.target;
143:         if (target && target.result && typeof target.result === "string") {
144:           setImagePreviews((prev) => [...prev, target.result]);
145:         }
146:       };
147:       reader.readAsDataURL(file);
148:     });
149: 
150:     // مسح الملف إذا كانت هناك صور
151:     setCurrentAttachment(null);
152: 
153:     // إعادة تعيين حقل الإدخال
154:     const fileInput = document.getElementById(
155:       "submission-images-input"
156:     ) as HTMLInputElement;
157:     if (fileInput) fileInput.value = "";
158:   };
159: 
160:   // حذف صورة محددة
161:   const removeImage = (index: number) => {
162:     setSelectedImages((prev) => prev.filter((_, i) => i !== index));
163:     setImagePreviews((prev) => prev.filter((_, i) => i !== index));
164:   };
165: 
166:   const handleAddItem = async () => {
167:     if (!currentLink.trim()) {
168:       alert("رابط المنتج مطلوب");
169:       return;
170:     }
171:     if (!currentPrice.trim()) {
172:       alert("سعر المنتج مطلوب");
173:       return;
174:     }
175: 
176:     setUploading(true);
177: 
178:     try {
179:       let imageUrls: string[] = [];
180: 
181:       // رفع الصور إلى Cloudinary إذا كانت موجودة
182:       if (selectedImages.length > 0) {
183:         imageUrls = await cloudinaryService.uploadMultipleImages(
184:           selectedImages
185:         );
186:       }
187: 
188:       const newItem: SubmissionItem = {
189:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
190:         productLink: currentLink.trim(),
191:         productPrice: parseFloat(currentPrice),
192:         notes: currentNotes.trim(),
193:         attachmentName: currentAttachment?.name,
194:         attachmentUrl: currentAttachment?.url,
195:         images: imageUrls,
196:         attachmentType:
197:           selectedImages.length > 0
198:             ? "images"
199:             : currentAttachment?.type || undefined,
200:         isNew: true,
201:         createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
202:       };
203: 
204:       const updatedItems = [...items, newItem];
205:       setItems(updatedItems);
206: 
207:       if (storageKey) {
208:         const saveData = {
209:           items: updatedItems,
210:           timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
211:         };
212:         localStorage.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify(saveData));
213:       }
214: 
215:       resetCurrentItem();
216:     } catch (error) {
217:       console.error("Error uploading images:", error);
218:       alert("حدث خطأ أثناء رفع الصور. يرجى المحاولة مرة أخرى.");
219:     } finally {
220:       setUploading(false);
221:     }
222:   };
223: 
224:   const resetCurrentItem = () => {
225:     setCurrentLink("");
226:     setCurrentPrice("");
227:     setCurrentNotes("");
228:     setCurrentAttachment(null);
229:     setSelectedImages([]);
230:     setImagePreviews([]);
231: 
232:     // إعادة تعيين حقول الإدخال
233:     const fileInput = document.getElementById(
234:       "submission-file-input"
235:     ) as HTMLInputElement;
236:     if (fileInput) fileInput.value = "";
237: 
238:     const imageInput = document.getElementById(
239:       "submission-images-input"
240:     ) as HTMLInputElement;
241:     if (imageInput) imageInput.value = "";
242:   };
243: 
244:   const handleRemoveItem = (id: string) => {
245:     const itemToRemove = items.find((item) => item.id === id);
246:     if (itemToRemove?.isNew) {
247:       const updatedItems = items.filter((item) => item.id !== id);
248:       setItems(updatedItems);
249:       if (storageKey) {
250:         const saveData = {
251:           items: updatedItems,
252:           timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
253:         };
254:         localStorage.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify(saveData));
255:       }
256:     }
257:   };
258: 
259:   const canAddNewItems = () => {
260:     if (!isEditMode) return true;
261:     if (initialData?.status === "approved") {
262:       return false;
263:     }
264:     return true;
265:   };
266: 
267:   const getNewItems = () => items.filter((item) => item.isNew);
268:   const getExistingItems = () => items.filter((item) => !item.isNew);
269: 
270:   const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
271:     e.preventDefault();
272:     const totalItems = items.length;
273:     const newItemsCount = getNewItems().length;
274: 
275:     if (totalItems === 0) {
276:       alert("لا يمكنك تسليم المهمة بدون إضافة بند واحد على الأقل.");
277:       return;

======= components\notifications\NotificationCenter.tsx =======
1: import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
2: import { AppNotification, AppView } from '../../types';
3: import { notificationsService } from '../../services/notificationsService';
4: import { Bell, Check, ExternalLink, Inbox, X } from 'lucide-react';
5: 
6: interface NotificationCenterProps {
7:     currentUserId: string;
8:     onNavigate: (view: AppView, targetId?: string) => void;
9: }
10: 
11: export const NotificationCenter: React.FC<NotificationCenterProps> = ({ currentUserId, onNavigate }) => {
12:     const [notifications, setNotifications] = useState<AppNotification[]>([]);
13:     const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
14:     const dropdownRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
15: 
16:     useEffect(() => {
17:         // Subscribe to notifications for this user (or "all_managers" as a broadcast)
18:         // For now, let's assume we subscribe to both
19:         const unsubscribe = notificationsService.subscribeToNotifications(currentUserId, (newNotifications) => {
20:             setNotifications(newNotifications);
21:         });
22: 
23:         const handleClickOutside = (event: MouseEvent) => {
24:             if (dropdownRef.current && !dropdownRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {
25:                 setIsOpen(false);
26:             }
27:         };
28: 
29:         document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
30:         return () => {
31:             unsubscribe();
32:             document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
33:         };
34:     }, [currentUserId]);
35: 
36:     const unreadCount = notifications.filter(n => !n.isRead).length;
37: 
38:     const handleNotificationClick = async (notification: AppNotification) => {
39:         if (!notification.isRead) {
40:             await notificationsService.markAsRead(notification.id);
41:         }
42: 
43:         if (notification.targetView) {
44:             onNavigate(notification.targetView, notification.targetId);
45:             setIsOpen(false);
46:         }
47:     };
48: 
49:     const markAllAsRead = async () => {
50:         const unreadIds = notifications.filter(n => !n.isRead).map(n => n.id);
51:         for (const id of unreadIds) {
52:             await notificationsService.markAsRead(id);
53:         }
54:     };
55: 
56:     return (
57:         <div className="relative" ref={dropdownRef}>
58:             <button
59:                 onClick={() => setIsOpen(!isOpen)}
60:                 className="relative p-2 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 hover:bg-gray-100 dark:hover:bg-gray-700 rounded-full transition-all"
61:             >
62:                 <Bell className="w-6 h-6" />
63:                 {unreadCount > 0 && (
64:                     <span className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-5 h-5 bg-red-500 text-white text-[10px] font-bold flex items-center justify-center rounded-full border-2 border-white dark:border-gray-800">
65:                         {unreadCount > 9 ? '+9' : unreadCount}
66:                     </span>
67:                 )}
68:             </button>
69: 
70:             {isOpen && (
71:                 <div className="absolute left-0 mt-2 w-80 sm:w-96 bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl border border-gray-100 dark:border-gray-700 z-50 overflow-hidden animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-top-2">
72:                     <div className="p-4 border-b border-gray-100 dark:border-gray-700 flex justify-between items-center bg-gray-50/50 dark:bg-gray-900/50">
73:                         <h3 className="font-bold dark:text-white flex items-center gap-2">
74:                             <Inbox className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-500" />
75:                             الإشعارات
76:                         </h3>
77:                         {unreadCount > 0 && (
78:                             <button
79:                                 onClick={markAllAsRead}
80:                                 className="text-xs text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 hover:underline flex items-center gap-1"
81:                             >
82:                                 <Check className="w-3 h-3" />
83:                                 تحديد الكل كمقروء
84:                             </button>
85:                         )}
86:                     </div>
87: 
88:                     <div className="max-h-[400px] overflow-y-auto">
89:                         {notifications.length > 0 ? (
90:                             <div className="divide-y divide-gray-100 dark:divide-gray-700">
91:                                 {notifications.map((n) => (
92:                                     <div
93:                                         key={n.id}
94:                                         onClick={() => handleNotificationClick(n)}
95:                                         className={`p-4 hover:bg-gray-50 dark:hover:bg-gray-700/50 cursor-pointer transition-colors relative group ${!n.isRead ? 'bg-blue-50/30 dark:bg-blue-900/10' : ''}`}
96:                                     >
97:                                         {!n.isRead && (
98:                                             <div className="absolute right-2 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-1.5 h-1.5 bg-blue-500 rounded-full" />
99:                                         )}
100:                                         <div className="mr-3">
101:                                             <div className="flex justify-between items-start mb-1">
102:                                                 <h4 className={`text-sm font-bold ${!n.isRead ? 'text-blue-900 dark:text-blue-100' : 'text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-100'}`}>
103:                                                     {n.title}
104:                                                 </h4>
105:                                                 <span className="text-[10px] text-gray-400">
106:                                                     {new Date(n.createdAt).toLocaleTimeString('ar-EG', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })}
107:                                                 </span>
108:                                             </div>
109:                                             <p className="text-xs text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 line-clamp-2 mb-2">
110:                                                 {n.message}
111:                                             </p>
112:                                             {n.targetView && (
113:                                                 <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 font-medium">
114:                                                     <ExternalLink className="w-3 h-3" />
115:                                                     عرض التفاصيل
116:                                                 </div>
117:                                             )}
118:                                         </div>
119:                                     </div>
120:                                 ))}
121:                             </div>
122:                         ) : (
123:                             <div className="p-12 text-center text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
124:                                 <Inbox className="w-12 h-12 mx-auto mb-3 opacity-20" />
125:                                 <p className="text-sm">لا توجد إشعارات جديدة</p>
126:                             </div>
127:                         )}
128:                     </div>
129: 
130:                     <div className="p-3 border-t border-gray-100 dark:border-gray-700 bg-gray-50/50 dark:bg-gray-900/50 text-center">
131:                         <button
132:                             onClick={() => setIsOpen(false)}
133:                             className="text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-700 transition-colors"
134:                         >
135:                             إغلاق
136:                         </button>
137:                     </div>
138:                 </div>
139:             )}
140:         </div>
141:     );
142: };

1: import { departments } from '@/data/departments';
2: import React, { useEffect } from 'react';
3: import { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
4: 
5: const DepartmentModal: React.FC = () => {
6:   const { departmentId } = useParams();
7:   const navigate = useNavigate();
8: 
9:   // Find the specific department based on URL param
10:   const department = departments.find((d) => d.id === departmentId);
11: 
12:   // Close handler: Navigate back to the main contact page
13:   const handleClose = () => {
14:     navigate('/contact');
15:   };
16: 
17:   // Close on Escape key
18:   useEffect(() => {
19:     const handleEsc = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
20:       if (e.key === 'Escape') handleClose();
21:     };
22:     window.addEventListener('keydown', handleEsc);
23:     return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleEsc);
24:   }, []);
25: 
26:   if (!department) return null;
27: 
28:   return (
29:     <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">

33:         onClick={handleClose}
34:       />
35: 
36:       {/* Modal Content */}

457:           newStatus={newStatusTarget}

461:     </div>

146:   // التحقق من صحة نظام الدفعات
147:   const validateInstallments = (): boolean => {
148:     if (!installmentPlanEnabled) {
149:       setInstallmentValidationError("");
150:       return true;
151:     }
152: 
153:     if (installments.length === 0) {
154:       setInstallmentValidationError("❌ يجب إضافة دفعة واحدة على الأقل");
155:       return false;
156:     }
157: 
158:     const totalPercentage = installments.reduce((sum, installment) => {
159:       return sum + (installment.percentage || 0);
160:     }, 0);
161: 
162:     if (Math.abs(totalPercentage - 100) > 0.01) {
163:       setInstallmentValidationError(`❌ مجموع النسب يجب أن يكون 100%، الحالي: ${totalPercentage.toFixed(2)}%`);
164:       return false;
165:     }
166: 
167:     const hasZeroPercentage = installments.some(installment => (installment.percentage || 0) <= 0);
168:     if (hasZeroPercentage) {
169:       setInstallmentValidationError("❌ جميع الدفعات يجب أن يكون لها نسبة أكبر من 0%");
170:       return false;
171:     }
172: 
173:     const grandTotal = calculateGrandTotal();
174:     const hasMismatchedAmounts = installments.some(installment => {
175:       const expectedAmount = ((installment.percentage || 0) / 100) * grandTotal;
176:       const actualAmount = installment.amount || 0;
177:       return Math.abs(expectedAmount - actualAmount) > 0.01;
178:     });
179: 
180:     if (hasMismatchedAmounts) {
181:       setInstallmentValidationError("❌ عدم تطابق بين النسب والمبالغ");
182:       return false;
183:     }
184: 
185:     setInstallmentValidationError("");
186:     return true;
187:   };
188:

190:   useEffect(() => {
191:     if (installmentPlanEnabled && installments.length > 0) {
192:       const grandTotal = calculateGrandTotal();
193:       const updatedInstallments = installments.map(installment => ({
194:         ...installment,
195:         amount: Math.round(((installment.percentage || 0) / 100) * grandTotal * 100) / 100
196:       }));
197:       setInstallments(updatedInstallments);
198:     }
199:   }, [formData.totalAmount, formData.subtotal, formData.discountAmount, formData.taxRate, formData.shippingCost]);
