277:   // --- Recalculate Logic ---
278:   const recalculateTotals = (
279:     newItems: DealItem[] = items,
280:     updatedFields: Partial<Deal> = {}
281:   ) => {
282:     const currentData = { ...formData, ...updatedFields };
283:     const itemsSubtotal = newItems.reduce(
284:       (sum, item) => sum + (item.totalPrice || 0),
285:       0
286:     );
287:     const validShipping = currentData.shippingIncluded
288:       ? 0
289:       : currentData.shippingCost || 0;
290:     const afterDiscount = Math.max(
291:       0,
292:       itemsSubtotal - (currentData.discountAmount || 0)
293:     );
294:     const taxableBase = afterDiscount + validShipping;
295: 
296:     let taxAmount = 0;
297:     if (currentData.taxType === 'amount') {
298:       taxAmount = currentData.taxAmount || 0;
299:     } else {
300:       taxAmount = taxableBase * ((currentData.taxRate || 0) / 100);
301:     }
302: 
303:     const grandTotal = taxableBase + taxAmount;
304: 
305:     setItems(newItems);
306:     setFormData((prev) => ({
307:       ...prev,
308:       ...updatedFields,
309:       items: newItems,
310:       subtotal: itemsSubtotal,
311:       taxAmount,
312:       totalAmount: grandTotal,
313:     }));
314:   };

354:   // Payment Handlers
355:   const handlePaymentOperation = async (
356:     operation: "claim" | "swift" | "add" | "confirm" | "cancel",
357:     paymentType: string,
358:     data: any,
359:     paymentId?: string
360:   ) => {
361:     if (!formData.id) {
362:       alert("يرجى حفظ الصفقة أولاً");
363:       return;
364:     }
365: 
366:     try {
367:       setLoading(true);
368: 
369:       try {
370:         const updateData: Partial<Deal> = {
371:           items,
372:           installments: installmentPlanEnabled ? installments : [],
373:           installmentPlanEnabled,
374:           totalAmount: formData.totalAmount,
375:           subtotal: formData.subtotal,
376:           taxAmount: formData.taxAmount,
377:           discountAmount: formData.discountAmount,
378:           shippingCost: formData.shippingCost,
379:           shippingIncluded: formData.shippingIncluded,
380:         };
381: 
382:         await dealsService.updateDeal(
383:           formData.id,
384:           updateData,
385:           currentUser.id,
386:           currentUser.name,
387:           currentUser.role || "user",
388:           "",
389:           ""
390:         );
391:       } catch (err) {
392:         console.error("Auto-save failed:", err);
393:       }
394: 
395:       const cleanData = (data: any): any => {
396:         return Object.fromEntries(
397:           Object.entries(data).filter(([_, v]) => v !== undefined)
398:         );
399:       };
400: 
401:       switch (operation) {
402:         case "add":
403:           await dealsService.addPayment(
404:             formData.id,
405:             {
406:               ...cleanData(data),
407:               type: paymentType,
408:               id: `payment_${Date.now()}`,
409:               paymentDate: new Date().toISOString(),
410:               confirmedBySupplier: false,
411:             },
412:             currentUser.id,
413:             currentUser.name,
414:             currentUser.role || "user"
415:           );
416:           break;
417: 
418:         case "claim":
419:           await dealsService.addPayment(
420:             formData.id,
421:             {
422:               ...cleanData(data),
423:               type: paymentType,
424:               id: `payment_${Date.now()}`,
425:               paymentDate: new Date().toISOString(),
426:               confirmedBySupplier: false,
427:             },
428:             currentUser.id,
429:             currentUser.name,
430:             currentUser.role || "user"
431:           );
432:           break;
433: 
434:         case "swift":
435:           const payment = formData.payments?.find(
436:             (p) => p.type === paymentType
437:           );
438:           if (payment) {
439:             paymentId = payment.id;
440:           } else {
441:             alert("لا توجد دفعة لهذا النوع");
442:             return;
443:           }
444: 
445:           if (!data.cashBoxId) {
446:             alert("يجب اختيار صندوق مالي لتنفيذ عملية الدفع");
447:             return;
448:           }
449: 
450:           if (!data.bankSwiftImage) {
451:             alert("يجب رفع صورة السليب أولاً");
452:             return;
453:           }
454: 
455:           const totalPayment = (data.amount || 0) + (data.transferCost || 0);
456:           const confirmMessage = `هل أنت متأكد من خصم ${totalPayment.toLocaleString()} من الصندوق المحدد؟`;
457: 
458:           if (!window.confirm(confirmMessage)) {
459:             setLoading(false);
460:             return;
461:           }
462: 
463:           try {
464:             await dealsService.updatePaymentWithSwift(
465:               formData.id,
466:               paymentId!,
467:               cleanData({
468:                 ...data,
469:                 dealNumber: formData.dealNumber
470:               }),
471:               currentUser.id,
472:               currentUser.name,
473:               currentUser.role || "user",
474:               data.cashBoxId
475:             );
476:           } catch (error: any) {
477:             if (error.message.includes('الرصيد غير كافي')) {
478:               alert(`❌ ${error.message}`);
479:               throw error;
480:             }
481:             throw error;
482:           }
483:           break;
484: 
485:         case "confirm":
486:           if (paymentId) {
487:             const paymentToConfirm = formData.payments?.find(p => p.id === paymentId);
488: 
489:             if (paymentToConfirm) {
490:               if (paymentToConfirm.bankSwiftImage && !paymentToConfirm.cashBoxId) {
491:                 alert("⚠️ هذه الدفعة تحتوي على سليب ولكن لم يتم خصمها من الصندوق بعد");
492:                 setLoading(false);
493:                 return;
494:               }
495: 
496:               if (paymentToConfirm.cashBoxId && !paymentToConfirm.bankSwiftImage) {
497:                 alert("⚠️ تم خصم المبلغ من الصندوق ولكن لم يتم رفع صورة السليب");
498:                 setLoading(false);
499:                 return;
500:               }
501:             }
502: 
503:             await dealsService.confirmPayment(
504:               formData.id,
505:               paymentId,
506:               currentUser.id,
507:               currentUser.name,
508:               currentUser.role || "user",
509:               data.supplierConfirmationImage,
510:               data.supplierNotes,
511:               data.paymentConfirmationDate,
512:               data.cashBoxId
513:             );
514:           }
515:           break;
516: 
517:         case "cancel":
518:           if (paymentId) {
519:             const paymentToCancel = formData.payments?.find(p => p.id === paymentId);
520: 
521:             if (paymentToCancel?.cashBoxWithdrawalAt) {
522:               const confirmCancel = window.confirm(
523:                 "⚠️ هذه الدفعة تم خصمها بالفعل من الصندوق. هل تريد حقاً إلغاءها؟"
524:               );
525:               if (!confirmCancel) {
526:                 setLoading(false);
527:                 return;
528:               }
529:             }
530: 
531:             await dealsService.cancelPayment(
532:               formData.id,
533:               paymentId,
534:               currentUser.id,
535:               currentUser.name,
536:               currentUser.role || "user"
537:             );
538:           }
539:           break;
540:       }
541: 
542:       const updatedDeal = await dealsService.getDeal(formData.id);
543:       setFormData(updatedDeal);
544:       await loadActivities();
545: 
546:       switch (operation) {
547:         case "swift":
548:           alert("✅ تم رفع السليب بنجاح");
549:           break;
550:         case "confirm":
551:           alert("✅ تم تأكيد الدفعة من المورد بنجاح");
552:           break;
553:         default:
554:           alert("تم حفظ العملية بنجاح");
555:       }
556: 
557:     } catch (error: any) {
558:       console.error("Payment Operation Error:", error);
559:       alert(`❌ ${error.message || "حدث خطأ أثناء حفظ العملية"}`);
560:     } finally {
561:       setLoading(false);
562:     }
563:   };

795:           currentUser.role || "user"
796:         );
797: 
798:         const createdDeal = await dealsService.getDeal(dealId);
799:         setFormData(createdDeal);
800:         setItems(createdDeal.items || []);
801:         setInstallments(createdDeal.installments || []);
802:         setInstallmentPlanEnabled(createdDeal.installmentPlanEnabled || false);
803:         await loadActivities();
804: 
805:         alert(`✅ تم إنشاء الصفقة بنجاح برقم: ${createdDeal.dealNumber}`);
806:       }
807: 
808:     } catch (e: any) {
809:       console.error("❌ Save Error:", e);
810:       alert(`❌ فشل الحفظ: ${e.message}`);
811:     } finally {
812:       setSaving(false);

817:     return items.reduce((sum, item) => {
818:       const qty = item.quantity || 0;
819:       const price = item.unitPrice || 0;
820:       return sum + (qty * price);
821:     }, 0);
822:   };

838:   const calculateTaxAmount = (): number => {
839:     const subtotal = calculateSubtotal();
840:     const discountAmount = formData.discountAmount || 0;
841:     const netAfterDiscount = Math.max(0, subtotal - discountAmount);
842:     const taxRate = formData.taxRate || 0;
843: 
844:     if (formData.taxType === 'amount') {
845:       return formData.taxAmount || 0;
846:     }
847:     return netAfterDiscount * (taxRate / 100);

850:   const calculateGrandTotal = (): number => {
851:     const subtotal = calculateSubtotal();
852:     const discountAmount = formData.discountAmount || 0;
853:     const netAfterDiscount = Math.max(0, subtotal - discountAmount);
854: 
855:     let taxAmount = 0;
856:     if (formData.taxType === 'amount') {
857:       taxAmount = formData.taxAmount || 0;
858:     } else {
859:       taxAmount = netAfterDiscount * ((formData.taxRate || 0) / 100);
860:     }
861: 
862:     const shipping = formData.shippingIncluded ? 0 : (formData.shippingCost || 0);
863:     return netAfterDiscount + taxAmount + shipping;
864:   };

929:   const getPaymentStatusFromPayments = (deal: Deal): PaymentStatus => {
930:     const total = deal.totalAmount || 0;
931:     const paid = deal.payments?.reduce((sum, p) => sum + (p.amount || 0), 0) || 0;
932: 
933:     if (total === 0) return "not_paid";
934:     const percentage = (paid / total) * 100;
935:     const payments = deal.payments || [];
936: 
937:     const paymentsWithClaimOnly = payments.filter(
938:       (p) => p.alibabaClaimImage && !p.bankSwiftImage && !p.confirmedBySupplier
939:     );
940: 
941:     const paymentsWithSwiftUnconfirmed = payments.filter(
942:       (p) => p.bankSwiftImage && !p.confirmedBySupplier
943:     );
944: 
945:     const confirmedPayments = payments.filter((p) => p.confirmedBySupplier);
946: 
947:     if (paymentsWithClaimOnly.length > 0 && paymentsWithSwiftUnconfirmed.length === 0) {
948:       return "claim_raised";
949:     }
950: 
951:     if (paymentsWithSwiftUnconfirmed.length > 0) {
952:       return "payment_pending_confirmation";
953:     }
954: 
955:     if (confirmedPayments.length > 0) {
956:       if (payments.length === confirmedPayments.length) {
957:         if (percentage === 100) return "paid";
958:         if (percentage > 0 && percentage < 100) return "partially_paid";
959:       }
960:       return "partially_paid";
961:     }
962: 
963:     if (percentage === 0) return "not_paid";
964:     if (percentage > 0 && percentage < 100) return "partially_paid";
965:     if (percentage === 100) return "paid";
966: 
967:     return "not_paid";
968:   };

90:         const price = parseFloat(item.unitPrice as any) || 0;

100:     const taxableBase = netAfterDiscount + shippingCost;

107:       taxAmount = taxableBase * (taxRate / 100);
108:     }

112:     const remainingAmount = grandTotal - paidAmount;
113: 
114:     return { grandTotal, paidAmount, remainingAmount };

5: interface InstallmentManagerProps {
6:     installments: DealInstallment[];

26: 
27:     const getEffectiveInstallments = (): DealInstallment[] => {
28:         if (deal?.installments && deal.installments.length > 0) return deal.installments;
29:         return propInstallments;
30:     };
31: 
32:     const effectiveInstallments = getEffectiveInstallments();
33: 
34:     const checkIfPaymentsStarted = (): boolean => {
35:         const hasConfirmedPayments = deal?.payments?.some((p: any) => p.confirmedBySupplier || p.bankSwiftImage);
36:         const hasPaidInstallments = effectiveInstallments.some(inst => inst.status === 'paid');
37:         return hasConfirmedPayments || hasPaidInstallments;
38:     };
39:

41: 
42:     // تهيئة أولية
43:     useEffect(() => {
44:         if (installmentPlanEnabled && effectiveInstallments.length === 0) {
45:             const defaultInstallment: DealInstallment = {
46:                 id: crypto.randomUUID(),
47:                 installmentNumber: 1,
48:                 percentage: 100,
49:                 amount: Number(grandTotal.toFixed(2)),
50:                 status: 'unpaid',
51:                 createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
52:                 updatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
53:             };
54:             onUpdateInstallments([defaultInstallment]);
55:         } else if (!installmentPlanEnabled && effectiveInstallments.length > 0) {
56:             onUpdateInstallments([]);
57:         }
58:     }, [installmentPlanEnabled, grandTotal, effectiveInstallments]);

61:     const generateInstallments = (count: number) => {
62:         if (!installmentPlanEnabled || isLocked) return;

64:         const percentagePerInstallment = 100 / count;
65: 
66:         for (let i = 1; i <= count; i++) {
67:             newInstallments.push({
68:                 id: crypto.randomUUID(),
69:                 installmentNumber: i,
70:                 percentage: Number(percentagePerInstallment.toFixed(2)),
71:                 amount: Number(((percentagePerInstallment / 100) * grandTotal).toFixed(2)),
72:                 status: 'unpaid',
73:                 createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
74:                 updatedAt: new Date().toISOString()

78:         onUpdateInstallments(newInstallments);
79:     };
80:

82:     const updatePercentage = (index: number, newPercentage: number) => {
83:         if (!installmentPlanEnabled || isLocked) return;
84:         const updated = [...effectiveInstallments];
85:         updated[index] = {
86:             ...updated[index],
87:             percentage: newPercentage,
88:             amount: Number(((newPercentage / 100) * grandTotal).toFixed(2))
89:         };
90:         onUpdateInstallments(updated);
91:     };
92:

96:         const updated = [...effectiveInstallments];
97:         const newPercentage = grandTotal > 0 ? (newAmount / grandTotal) * 100 : 0;
98: 
99:         updated[index] = {
100:             ...updated[index],
101:             amount: newAmount,
102:             percentage: Number(newPercentage.toFixed(2))
103:         };
104:         onUpdateInstallments(updated);
105:     };
106:

113:             percentage: Number(remainingPct.toFixed(2)),

147:                                 {installmentPlanEnabled ? 'مفعل' : 'معطل'}

459:                         <div className="p-6">
460:                             <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-6">
461:                                 <h3 className="font-bold text-xl text-gray-900 dark:text-white">تسجيل الدفعة {selectedInstallment.installmentNumber}</h3>

479:                     </div>

484:         </div>

62:     initialInvoice || {}
63:   );
64:   const [suppliers, setSuppliers] = useState<Supplier[]>([]);
65:   const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
66:   const [previewImage, setPreviewImage] = useState<string | null>(null);
67:   const [showItemSearch, setShowItemSearch] = useState(false);

70:     return (
71:       initialInvoice?.dealInfo ||
72:       dealData || {
73:         createdBy: currentUser.id,
74:         createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
75:       }
76:     );
77:   });
78: 
79:   const [installments, setInstallments] = useState<InvoiceInstallment[]>(
80:     initialInvoice?.installments || []
81:   );
82:

84:     initialInvoice?.installmentPlanEnabled || false
85:   );
86:

88:     initialInvoice?.dealInfo?.activityLog || []

94:     return () => unsubSuppliers();

98:   const recalculateTotals = (updatedFields: Partial<Invoice> = {}) => {
99:     const nextData = { ...formData, ...updatedFields };
100:     const items = nextData.items || [];
101: 
102:     const itemsSubtotal = items.reduce(
103:       (sum, item) => sum + (item.totalPrice || 0),
104:       0
105:     );
106:     const validShipping = nextData.shippingIncluded
107:       ? 0
108:       : nextData.shippingCost || 0;
109:     const afterDiscount = Math.max(
110:       0,
111:       itemsSubtotal - (nextData.discountAmount || 0)
112:     );
113:     const taxableBase = afterDiscount + validShipping;
114:

116:     if (nextData.taxType === 'amount') {
117:       taxAmount = nextData.taxAmount || 0;
118:     } else {
119:       taxAmount = taxableBase * ((nextData.taxRate || 0) / 100);
120:     }
121:

123:       const lp = nextData.localPayments;
124:       if (!lp || lp.includedInPrice) return 0;
125:       if (lp.calculationMethod === 'lump_sum') return lp.lumpSumAmount || 0;
126:       return (
127:         (lp.customsClearanceFees || 0) +
128:         (lp.customsDuties || 0) +
129:         (lp.portFees || 0) +
130:         (lp.internalShippingFees || 0) +
131:         (lp.palestinianTaxCustoms || 0)
132:       );
133:     };
134: 
135:     const totalLocalPayments = calculateTotalLocalPayments();
136:     const grandTotal = taxableBase + taxAmount + totalLocalPayments;
137: 
138:     setFormData((prev) => ({
139:       ...prev,
140:       ...updatedFields,

142:       taxAmount,
143:       grandTotal,

314:         const itemsSubtotal = items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + (item.totalPrice || 0), 0);
315:         const validShipping = updated.shippingIncluded ? 0 : (updated.shippingCost || 0);

======= components\procurement\invoices\InvoicePrintView.tsx =======
1: import React, { useRef } from 'react';
2: import { Invoice, User, Supplier } from '../../../types';
3: import { Printer, X, MapPin, Phone, Mail, FileText, Building2, Truck, Hash, Calendar, DollarSign, CreditCard, Edit, ExternalLink, Box } from 'lucide-react';
4: 
5: interface InvoicePrintViewProps {
6:     invoice: Invoice;
7:     currentUser: User;
8:     supplier?: Supplier;
9:     onClose?: () => void;
10:     onEdit?: () => void;
11: }
12: 
13: export const InvoicePrintView: React.FC<InvoicePrintViewProps> = ({ invoice, currentUser, supplier, onClose, onEdit }) => {
14:     const componentRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
15: 
16:     const handlePrint = () => {
17:         window.print();
18:     };
19: 
20:     const formatCurrency = (amount: number) => {
21:         const symbol = invoice.currency === 'ILS' ? '₪' : '$';
22:         return `${symbol}${amount.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}`;
23:     };
24: 
25:     const formatDate = (dateString?: string) => {
26:         if (!dateString) return '-';
27:         return new Date(dateString).toLocaleDateString('en-GB');
28:     };
29: 
30:     const getSupplierAddress = () => {
31:         if (invoice.supplierSnapshot?.address) return invoice.supplierSnapshot.address;
32:         if (!supplier) return 'العنوان غير مسجل';
33:         return [supplier.street, supplier.city, supplier.country].filter(Boolean).join('، ');
34:     };
35: 
36:     const getSupplierName = () => {
37:         if (invoice.supplierSnapshot?.tradeName) {
38:             return invoice.supplierSnapshot.alias
39:                 ? `${invoice.supplierSnapshot.tradeName} (${invoice.supplierSnapshot.alias})`
40:                 : invoice.supplierSnapshot.tradeName;
41:         }
42:         if (!supplier) return invoice.factoryName || 'مورد غير محدد';
43:         return supplier.alias || supplier.tradeName || invoice.factoryName || 'مورد غير محدد';
44:     };
45: 
46:     // Calculate totals if not provided
47:     const calculateTotals = () => {

======= components\procurement\invoices\sections\DealActivityLog.tsx =======
1: import React from 'react';
2: import { DealActivity } from '@/types';
3: import { History, CheckCircle, XCircle, FileText, DollarSign, Clock } from 'lucide-react';

6: interface DealActivityLogProps {

8: }
9: 
10: export const DealActivityLog: React.FC<DealActivityLogProps> = ({ activities }) => {
11:   const getActivityIcon = (type: string) => {
12:     switch (type) {
13:       case 'status_change':
14:         return <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-500" />;
15:       case 'payment':
16:         return <DollarSign className="w-4 h-4 text-green-500" />;
17:       case 'note':
18:         return <FileText className="w-4 h-4 text-gray-500" />;
19:       case 'attachment':
20:         return <FileText className="w-4 h-4 text-purple-500" />;
21:       default:
22:         return <Clock className="w-4 h-4 text-gray-500" />;
23:     }
24:   };
25: 
26:   const getActivityColor = (type: string) => {
27:     switch (type) {
28:       case 'status_change':
29:         return 'border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800 bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-900/10';
30:       case 'payment':
31:         return 'border-green-200 dark:border-green-800 bg-green-50 dark:bg-green-900/10';
32:       case 'note':
33:         return 'border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800/10';
34:       case 'attachment':
35:         return 'border-purple-200 dark:border-purple-800 bg-purple-50 dark:bg-purple-900/10';
36:       default:
37:         return 'border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800/10';
38:     }
39:   };
40: 
41:   return (
42:     <CollapsibleSection
43:       title="سجل نشاطات الصفقة"
44:       icon={History}
45:       defaultOpen={false}
46:       className="border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700"
47:     >
48:       <div className="space-y-3">
49:         {activities.length === 0 ? (
50:           <div className="text-center py-8 text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
51:             <History className="w-12 h-12 mx-auto mb-3 opacity-50" />
52:             <p>لا توجد نشاطات مسجلة</p>
53:           </div>
54:         ) : (
55:           activities.map((activity) => (
56:             <div

59:             >
60:               <div className="flex justify-between items-start">
61:                 <div className="flex items-start gap-3 flex-1">
62:                   <div className="mt-1">
63:                     {getActivityIcon(activity.type)}
64:                   </div>
65:                   <div className="flex-1">
66:                     <p className="font-medium text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
67:                       {activity.action}
68:                     </p>

71:                         {activity.details}
72:                       </p>
73:                     )}
74:                     <div className="flex items-center gap-4 mt-2 text-xs text-gray-500">

112:                   />

138:                 />

161:             placeholder="https://..."
162:           />
163:           {dealInfo.alibabaOrderLink && (
164:             <p className="text-xs text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400">
165:               <a href={dealInfo.alibabaOrderLink} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="hover:underline">
166:                 انقر لفتح الرابط
167:               </a>
168:             </p>
169:           )}
170:         </div>
171: 
172:         {/* Internal Notes */}
173:         <div className="space-y-2">
174:           <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 flex items-center gap-2">
175:             <FileText className="w-4 h-4" />
176:             الملاحظات الداخلية للصفقة
177:           </label>
178:           <textarea
179:             value={dealInfo.internalNotes || ''}
180:             onChange={(e) => onUpdateDealInfo('internalNotes', e.target.value)}
181:             rows={4}
182:             className="w-full p-3 border border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-600 rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 text-gray-900 dark:text-white"
183:             placeholder="ملاحظات الصفقة الداخلية..."
184:           />
185:         </div>
186:       </div>
187:     </div>
188:   );
189: };

======= components\procurement\invoices\sections\InstallmentsSection.tsx =======
1: import React, { useState } from 'react';
2: import {
3:   CreditCard, Calculator, Plus, Trash2, CheckCircle2,
4:   DollarSign, FileText, ChevronRight, AlertCircle,
5:   Calendar, UploadCloud, Loader2, Eye, X
6: } from 'lucide-react';
7: import { CollapsibleSection } from '@/components/ui/CollapsibleSection';
8: 
9: interface Installment {
10:   id: string;
11:   installmentNumber: number;
12:   amount: number;
13:   status: 'unpaid' | 'paid';
14:   notes?: string;
15:   bankSlipUrl?: string;
16:   paymentDate?: string;
17: }
18: 
19: interface InstallmentsSectionProps {
20:   installments: Installment[];
21:   installmentPlanEnabled: boolean;
22:   items?: any[];
23:   discountAmount?: number;
24:   taxRate?: number;
25:   shippingCost?: number;
26:   shippingIncluded?: boolean;
27:   localPayments?: any;
28:   onToggleInstallmentPlan: (enabled: boolean) => void;
29:   onAddInstallment: () => void;
30:   onRemoveInstallment: (index: number) => void;
31:   onUpdateInstallment: (index: number, field: string, value: any) => void;
32:   readOnly?: boolean;
33:   currency?: 'USD' | 'ILS';
34: }
35: 
36: export const InstallmentsSection: React.FC<InstallmentsSectionProps> = ({
37:   installments,
38:   installmentPlanEnabled,
39:   items = [],
40:   discountAmount = 0,
41:   taxRate = 0,
42:   shippingCost = 0,
43:   shippingIncluded = false,
44:   localPayments = {},
45:   onToggleInstallmentPlan,
46:   onAddInstallment,
47:   onRemoveInstallment,
48:   onUpdateInstallment,
49:   readOnly = false,
50:   currency = 'USD'
51: }) => {
52:   const symbol = currency === 'ILS' ? '₪' : '$';
53: 
54:   const [uploadingIndex, setUploadingIndex] = useState<number | null>(null);
55: 
56:   // دالة حساب المدفوعات المحلية
57:   const calculateTotalLocalPayments = () => {
58:     if (!localPayments || localPayments.includedInPrice) return 0;
59: 
60:     if (localPayments.calculationMethod === 'lump_sum') {
61:       return localPayments.lumpSumAmount || 0;
62:     }
63: 
64:     if (localPayments.calculationMethod === 'detailed') {
65:       return (
66:         (localPayments.customsClearanceFees || 0) +
67:         (localPayments.customsDuties || 0) +
68:         (localPayments.portFees || 0) +
69:         (localPayments.internalShippingFees || 0)
70:       );
71:     }
72: 
73:     return 0;
74:   };
75: 
76:   const totalLocalPayments = calculateTotalLocalPayments();
77: 
78:   // دالة حساب الإجمالي الكلي - تضم كل شيء
79:   const calculateGrandTotal = () => {
80:     // حساب إجمالي المنتجات
81:     const subtotal = items.reduce((sum, item) => {
82:       const qty = item.quantity || 0;
83:       const price = item.unitPrice || 0;
84:       const itemDisc = item.itemDiscount || 0;
85:       return sum + Math.max(0, (qty * price) - itemDisc);
86:     }, 0);
87: 
88:     const netAfterDiscount = Math.max(0, subtotal - discountAmount);
89:     const taxAmount = netAfterDiscount * (taxRate / 100);
90:     const shipping = shippingIncluded ? 0 : shippingCost;
91: 
92:     // الإجمالي الكامل: المنتجات + الضريبة + الشحن + المدفوعات المحلية
93:     return netAfterDiscount + taxAmount + shipping + totalLocalPayments;
94:   };
95: 
96:   const grandTotal = calculateGrandTotal();
97:   const totalPaidAmount = installments
98:     .filter(inst => inst.status === 'paid')
99:     .reduce((sum, inst) => sum + (inst.amount || 0), 0);
100:   const remainingAmount = grandTotal - totalPaidAmount;
101:   const progressPercentage = grandTotal > 0 ? Math.round((totalPaidAmount / grandTotal) * 100) : 0;
102: 
103:   // دالة الرفع إلى Cloudinary (نفسها)
104:   const handleFileUpload = async (file: File, index: number) => {
105:     if (!file) return;
106: 
107:     const CLOUD_NAME = "YOUR_CLOUD_NAME";
108:     const UPLOAD_PRESET = "YOUR_UPLOAD_PRESET";
109: 
110:     setUploadingIndex(index);
111: 
112:     const formData = new FormData();
113:     formData.append("file", file);
114:     formData.append("upload_preset", UPLOAD_PRESET);
115: 
116:     try {
117:       const response = await fetch(
118:         `https://api.cloudinary.com/v1_1/${CLOUD_NAME}/image/upload`,
119:         {
120:           method: "POST",
121:           body: formData,
122:         }
123:       );
124: 
125:       const data = await response.json();
126: 
127:       if (data.secure_url) {
128:         onUpdateInstallment(index, 'bankSlipUrl', data.secure_url);
129:       } else {
130:         alert("فشل رفع الصورة");
131:       }
132:     } catch (error) {
133:       console.error("Upload error:", error);
134:       alert("حدث خطأ أثناء رفع الصورة");
135:     } finally {
136:       setUploadingIndex(null);
137:     }
138:   };
139:   return (
140:     <CollapsibleSection
141:       title="خطة الدفع والتحصيل"
142:       icon={CreditCard}
143:       defaultOpen={false}
144:       className="border-blue-100 dark:border-blue-900/30 overflow-hidden"
145:     >
146:       <div className="space-y-5">
147:         {/* Header: Toggle & Quick Summary */}
148:         <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4 p-4 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-50 to-indigo-50 dark:from-blue-900/10 dark:to-indigo-900/10 border border-blue-100 dark:border-blue-800/30">
149:           <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
150:             <div className="w-12 h-12 flex items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 shadow-sm border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-700">
151:               <CreditCard className="w-6 h-6 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" />
152:             </div>
153:             <div>
154:               <h4 className="font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">نظام الدفعات</h4>
155:               <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">إدارة الجدولة والتحصيل المالي</p>
156:               {/* إظهار تلميح عن الشحن والمدفوعات المحلية */}
157:               {(shippingCost > 0 || totalLocalPayments > 0) && (
158:                 <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 mt-1">
159:                   {shippingCost > 0 && !shippingIncluded && (
160:                     <span className="text-xs text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">
161:                       يشمل الشحن: {symbol}{shippingCost.toLocaleString()}
162:                     </span>
163:                   )}
164:                   {totalLocalPayments > 0 && !localPayments.includedInPrice && (
165:                     <span className="text-xs text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">
166:                       ومدفوعات محلية: {symbol}{totalLocalPayments.toLocaleString()}
167:                     </span>
168:                   )}
169:                 </div>
170:               )}
171:             </div>
172:           </div>
173: 
174:           <div className="flex items-center gap-6">
175:             <div className="hidden sm:flex flex-col items-end">
176:               <span className="text-xs text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold">نسبة التحصيل</span>
177:               <span className="text-lg font-black text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400">{progressPercentage}%</span>
178:             </div>
179:             <label className="relative inline-flex items-center cursor-pointer scale-110">
180:               <input
181:                 type="checkbox"
182:                 checked={installmentPlanEnabled}
183:                 onChange={(e) => onToggleInstallmentPlan(e.target.checked)}
184:                 className="sr-only peer"
185:                 disabled={readOnly}
186:               />

188:             </label>

191:

194:

196:             <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-3">

199:                 { label: 'المبلغ المحصل', value: totalPaidAmount, color: 'text-green-600', bg: 'bg-green-50/50', icon: CheckCircle2 },
200:                 { label: 'المتبقي', value: remainingAmount, color: 'text-amber-600', bg: 'bg-amber-50/50', icon: AlertCircle },
201:               ].map((card, i) => (
202:                 <div key={i} className={`${card.bg} dark:bg-gray-800/40 p-4 rounded-xl border border-gray-100 dark:border-gray-700 shadow-sm flex items-center justify-between`}>
203:                   <div>
204:                     <p className="text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 mb-1">{card.label}</p>
205:                     <p className={`text-xl font-black ${card.color} dark:text-white`}>
206:                       {symbol}{card.value.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}
207:                     </p>
208:                     {card.label === 'إجمالي الفاتورة' && (
209:                       <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-1">
210:                         {shippingCost > 0 && !shippingIncluded && `يشمل الشحن`}
211:                         {totalLocalPayments > 0 && !localPayments.includedInPrice && ` ومدفوعات محلية`}

405:                       {progressPercentage === 100 ? 'مكتمل' : 'قيد التحصيل'}
406:                     </span>
407:                   </div>
408:                   <span className="text-sm font-black text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400">{progressPercentage}%</span>
409:                 </div>
410:                 <div className="h-2.5 bg-gray-200 dark:bg-gray-700 rounded-full overflow-hidden shadow-inner">
411:                   <div
412:                     className="h-full bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-500 to-indigo-500 transition-all duration-700 ease-out"
413:                     style={{ width: `${Math.min(100, progressPercentage)}%` }}
414:                   />
415:                 </div>
416:               </div>
417:             )}
418:           </div>
419:         )}
420:       </div>
421:     </CollapsibleSection>
422:   );

18: export const OldInvoiceFilters: React.FC<OldInvoiceFiltersProps> = ({

92:                     case 'invoiceNumber':
93:                         if (!(invoice.invoiceNumber || '').toLowerCase().includes(value)) return false;
94:                         break;
95:                     case 'factoryName':
96:                         if (!(invoice.factoryName || '').toLowerCase().includes(value)) return false;
97:                         break;
98:                     case 'grandTotal':
99:                         const total = (invoice.grandTotal?.toString() || '0').toLowerCase();
100:                         if (!total.includes(value)) return false;
101:                         break;
102:                 }
103:             }
104: 
105:             return true;
106:         });
107:     }, [invoices, searchTerm, columnFilters]);
108: 
109:     // ترتيب الفواتير
110:     const sortedInvoices = useMemo(() => {
111:         return [...filteredInvoices].sort((a, b) => {
112:             let aValue: any = '';
113:             let bValue: any = '';
114: 
115:             switch (sortConfig.key) {
116:                 case 'invoiceDate':
117:                     aValue = a.invoiceDate || '';
118:                     bValue = b.invoiceDate || '';
119:                     break;
120:                 case 'invoiceNumber':
121:                     aValue = a.invoiceNumber || '';
122:                     bValue = b.invoiceNumber || '';
123:                     break;
124:                 case 'factoryName':
125:                     aValue = a.factoryName || '';
126:                     bValue = b.factoryName || '';
127:                     break;
128:                 case 'itemsCount':
129:                     aValue = a.items?.length || 0;
130:                     bValue = b.items?.length || 0;
131:                     break;
132:                 case 'grandTotal':
133:                     aValue = a.grandTotal || 0;
134:                     bValue = b.grandTotal || 0;
135:                     break;
136:             }
137: 
138:             if (aValue < bValue) {
139:                 return sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? -1 : 1;
140:             }
141:             if (aValue > bValue) {
142:                 return sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
143:             }
144:             return 0;
145:         });
146:     }, [filteredInvoices, sortConfig]);

170:             }
171:         } else {
172:             if (currentPage <= 3) {
173:                 for (let i = 1; i <= 4; i++) pages.push(i);
174:                 pages.push('...');
175:                 pages.push(totalPages);
176:             } else if (currentPage >= totalPages - 2) {
177:                 pages.push(1);
178:                 pages.push('...');
179:                 for (let i = totalPages - 3; i <= totalPages; i++) pages.push(i);
180:             } else {
181:                 pages.push(1);
182:                 pages.push('...');
183:                 for (let i = currentPage - 1; i <= currentPage + 1; i++) pages.push(i);
184:                 pages.push('...');
185:                 pages.push(totalPages);
186:             }
187:         }
188:         return pages;
189:     };

206:                     </div>
207:                     <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
208:                       {supplier.country && (
209:                         <span className="text-[10px] bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-700 text-gray-500 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded flex-shrink-0">
210:                           {supplier.country}
211:                         </span>
212:                       )}
213: 
214:                       {/* زر عرض المورد في القائمة */}
215:                       {onViewSupplier && (
216:                         <button
217:                           onClick={(e) => {
218:                             e.stopPropagation();
219:                             onViewSupplier(supplier.id);
220:                           }}
221:                           className="p-1 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 text-gray-400 hover:text-blue-600 dark:hover:text-blue-400 transition-opacity"
222:                           title="عرض بيانات المورد"
223:                         >
224:                           <Eye className="w-4 h-4" />
225:                         </button>
226:                       )}
227:                     </div>
228:                   </li>
229:                 );
230:               })}
231:             </ul>
232:           ) : (
233:             <div className="p-3 text-center text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 text-sm">
234:               <p>لا توجد نتائج {type === 'factory' ? ' (مصانع)' : ''}</p>
235:               {onOpenAddModal && (
236:                 <button
237:                   onClick={onOpenAddModal}
238:                   className="mt-2 text-blue-600 hover:underline text-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-1 w-full"
239:                 >
240:                   <UserPlus className="w-3 h-3" /> إضافة {type === 'factory' ? 'مصنع' : 'مورد'} جديد
241:                 </button>
242:               )}
243:             </div>
244:           )}
245:         </div>
246:       )}
247:     </div>
248:   );
249: };

======= components\procurement\price-offers\FilterPanel.tsx =======
1: import React from 'react';
2: import { PriceOffer, PriceOfferStatus } from '../../../types';
3: import { List, Clock, AlertCircle, MessageSquare, CheckSquare, Filter } from 'lucide-react';
4: 
5: interface FilterPanelProps {
6:     activeFilter: PriceOfferStatus | 'all';
7:     onFilterChange: (filter: PriceOfferStatus | 'all') => void;
8:     offers: PriceOffer[];
9: }
10: 
11: export const FilterPanel: React.FC<FilterPanelProps> = ({ activeFilter, onFilterChange, offers }) => {
12:     const filterOptions: Array<{ value: PriceOfferStatus | 'all', label: string, icon: any, color: string }> = [
13:         { value: 'all', label: 'جميع العروض', icon: List, color: 'text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300' },
14:         { value: 'initial', label: 'العروض الأولية', icon: Clock, color: 'text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400' },
15:         { value: 'pending_info', label: 'بانتظار المعلومات', icon: AlertCircle, color: 'text-yellow-500 dark:text-yellow-400' },
16:         { value: 'under_discussion', label: 'تحت المناقشة', icon: MessageSquare, color: 'text-blue-500 dark:text-blue-400' },
17:         { value: 'approved_for_shipping', label: 'معتمد للشراء', icon: CheckSquare, color: 'text-green-500 dark:text-green-400' },
18:     ];
19: 
20:     const getCount = (status: PriceOfferStatus | 'all') => {
21:         if (status === 'all') return offers.length;
22:         return offers.filter(offer => offer.status === status).length;
23:     };
24: 
25:     return (
26:         <div className="bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 p-4 mb-6">
27:             <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
28:                 <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
29:                     <Filter className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-500" />
30:                     <h3 className="font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">تصفية العروض</h3>
31:                 </div>
32:                 <div className="text-sm text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
33:                     {activeFilter === 'all' ? 'عرض جميع العروض' : `عرض ${filterOptions.find(f => f.value === activeFilter)?.label}`}
34:                 </div>
35:             </div>
36: 
37:             <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
38:                 {filterOptions.map((option) => {
39:                     const count = getCount(option.value);
40:                     const isActive = activeFilter === option.value;
41:                     const Icon = option.icon;
42: 
43:                     return (
44:                         <button
45:                             key={option.value}
46:                             onClick={() => onFilterChange(option.value)}
47:                             className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-lg transition-all duration-200 ${isActive
48:                                 ? 'bg-blue-600 dark:bg-blue-500 text-white shadow-md'
49:                                 : 'bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-700 text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 hover:bg-gray-200 dark:hover:bg-gray-600'
50:                                 }`}
51:                         >
52:                             <Icon className={`w-4 h-4 ${isActive ? 'text-white' : option.color}`} />
53:                             <span className="font-medium">{option.label}</span>
54:                             <span className={`text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full ${isActive
55:                                 ? 'bg-white/20'
56:                                 : 'bg-gray-200 dark:bg-gray-600 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400'
57:                                 }`}>
58:                                 {count}
59:                             </span>
60:                         </button>
61:                     );
62:                 })}
63:             </div>
64:         </div>
65:     );
66: };

======= components\procurement\price-offers\ItemSearchModal.tsx =======
1: import React, { useState, useMemo, useEffect } from 'react';
2: import { Item, SupplierItemPrice } from '../../../types';
3: import { Package, X, Search, Hash, DollarSign } from 'lucide-react';
4: import { collection, query, where, orderBy, getDocs, limit } from "firebase/firestore";
5: import { db } from '@/firebaseConfig';
6: 
7: interface ItemSearchModalProps {
8:     isOpen: boolean;
9:     onClose: () => void;
10:     onSelectItem: (item: Item, lastPrice?: number) => void;
11:     items: Item[];
12:     supplierId?: string;
13: }
14: 
15: export const ItemSearchModal: React.FC<ItemSearchModalProps> = ({ isOpen, onClose, onSelectItem, items = [], supplierId }) => {
16:     const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
17:     const [itemPrices, setItemPrices] = useState<Record<string, number>>({});
18:     const [loadingPrices, setLoadingPrices] = useState(false);
19: 
20:     // Filter items based on search
21:     const filteredItems = useMemo(() => {
22:         if (!items) return [];
23:         if (!searchQuery.trim()) return items;
24:         const lowerQuery = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
25:         return items.filter(item =>
26:             item.name.toLowerCase().includes(lowerQuery) ||
27:             item.modelNumber?.toLowerCase().includes(lowerQuery) ||
28:             item.categoryName.toLowerCase().includes(lowerQuery)
29:         );
30:     }, [items, searchQuery]);
31: 
32:     // Fetch last prices for filtered items from this supplier
33:     useEffect(() => {
34:         const fetchPrices = async () => {
35:             if (!supplierId || !isOpen) return;
36: 
37:             setLoadingPrices(true);
38:             const prices: Record<string, number> = {};
39: 
40:             const targetItems = filteredItems.slice(0, 20);
41: 
42:             try {
43:                 await Promise.all(
44:                     targetItems.map(async (item) => {
45:                         const q = query(
46:                             collection(db, "supplier_prices"),
47:                             where("supplierId", "==", supplierId),
48:                             where("itemId", "==", item.id),
49:                             orderBy("date", "desc"),
50:                             limit(1)
51:                         );
52:                         const snapshot = await getDocs(q);
53:                         if (!snapshot.empty) {
54:                             const data = snapshot.docs[0].data() as SupplierItemPrice;
55:                             prices[item.id] = data.price;
56:                         }
57:                     })
58:                 );
59:                 setItemPrices(prices);
60:             } catch (error) {
61:                 console.error("Error fetching item prices:", error);
62:             } finally {
63:                 setLoadingPrices(false);
64:             }
65:         };
66: 
67:         const debounceTimer = setTimeout(() => {
68:             fetchPrices();
69:         }, 500);
70: 
71:         return () => clearTimeout(debounceTimer);
72:     }, [filteredItems, supplierId, isOpen]);
73: 
74:     if (!isOpen) return null;
75: 
76:     return (
77:         <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/70 flex items-center justify-center z-50 p-4">
78:             <div className="bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl w-full max-w-4xl max-h-[90vh] flex flex-col border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700">
79:                 <div className="p-6 border-b border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 flex justify-between items-center bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-900/50">
80:                     <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
81:                         <div className="p-2 bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-900/30 rounded-lg">
82:                             <Package className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" />
83:                         </div>
84:                         <div>
85:                             <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">إضافة صنف</h3>
86:                             <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">اختر منتجاً من القائمة لإضافته </p>
87:                         </div>
88:                     </div>
89:                     <button
90:                         onClick={onClose}
91:                         className="p-2 text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-700 dark:hover:text-gray-200 hover:bg-gray-100 dark:hover:bg-gray-700 rounded-lg transition-colors"
92:                     >
93:                         <X className="w-5 h-5" />
94:                     </button>
95:                 </div>
96: 
97:                 <div className="p-4 border-b border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 bg-white dark:bg-gray-800">
98:                     <div className="relative">
99:                         <Search className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-5 h-5 text-gray-400 dark:text-gray-500" />
100:                         <input
101:                             type="text"
102:                             placeholder="ابحث باسم المنتج، رقم الموديل، أو الفئة..."
103:                             value={searchQuery}
104:                             onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
105:                             className="w-full pr-10 pl-4 py-3 rounded-lg border border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-600 bg-white dark:bg-gray-700 text-gray-900 dark:text-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 dark:focus:ring-blue-400 focus:border-transparent transition-all"
106:                             autoFocus
107:                         />
108:                     </div>
109:                 </div>
110: 
111:                 <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4">
112:                     {loadingPrices && (
113:                         <div className="text-center py-4">
114:                             <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400">
115:                                 <div className="w-4 h-4 border-2 border-blue-600 dark:border-blue-400 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin"></div>
116:                                 <span className="text-sm">جاري تحميل آخر الأسعار...</span>
117:                             </div>
118:                         </div>
119:                     )}
120: 
121:                     <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
122:                         {filteredItems.slice(0, 50).map(item => (
123:                             <button
124:                                 key={item.id}
125:                                 onClick={() => onSelectItem(item, itemPrices[item.id])}
126:                                 className="group text-right bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 rounded-xl p-4 hover:border-blue-500 dark:hover:border-blue-400 hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-200 flex gap-4 w-full hover:bg-gray-50 dark:hover:bg-gray-700/50"
127:                             >
128:                                 <div className="w-16 h-16 flex-shrink-0 bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-700 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden ring-1 ring-gray-200 dark:ring-gray-600 group-hover:ring-blue-300 dark:group-hover:ring-blue-500">
129:                                     {item.imageUrls?.[0] ? (
130:                                         <img
131:                                             src={item.imageUrls[0]}
132:                                             alt={item.name}
133:                                             className="w-full h-full object-cover group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-200"
134:                                         />
135:                                     ) : (

146:                                         </span>

149:                                                 <Hash className="w-3 h-3" /> {item.modelNumber}
150:                                             </span>
151:                                         )}
152:                                     </div>

16:     onFilterChange: (filter: PriceOfferStatus | 'all') => void;
17:     onSearchChange: (query: string) => void;
18:     onEdit: (offer: PriceOffer) => void;
19:     onDelete: (id: string) => void;
20:     onCreateNew: () => void;
21:     onClearFilter: () => void;
22:     onViewDetails: (offer: PriceOffer) => void;
23:     onChangeStatus: (offerId: string, newStatus: PriceOfferStatus) => void;
24:     allDbItems?: any[];

27: export const PriceOfferList: React.FC<PriceOfferListProps> = ({
28:     offers,

30:     activeFilter,
31:     searchQuery,
32:     onFilterChange,
33:     onSearchChange,
34:     onEdit,

42:     const [dropdownOpen, setDropdownOpen] = useState<string | null>(null);
43:     const [statusDropdown, setStatusDropdown] = useState<string | null>(null);
44:     const [selectedOffer, setSelectedOffer] = useState<PriceOffer | null>(null);
45:     const [menuPosition, setMenuPosition] = useState<{ top: number; left: number } | null>(null);
46:     const tableRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
47: 
48:     // Helper function to get top 3 products by quantity
49:     const getTopProductsByQuantity = (offer: PriceOffer) => {
50:         if (!offer.items || offer.items.length === 0) return [];
51:         return [...offer.items]
52:             .sort((a, b) => (b.quantity || 0) - (a.quantity || 0))
53:             .slice(0, 3);
54:     };
55: 
56:     // دالة لاختصار النص الطويل
57:     const truncateText = (text: string, maxLength: number = 100) => {
58:         if (!text) return '';
59:         if (text.length <= maxLength) return text;
60:         return text.substring(0, maxLength) + '...';
61:     };

68:             top: e.clientY,
69:             left: e.clientX
70:         });

72:         setStatusDropdown(null);
73:     };

76:     useEffect(() => {

81:             setSelectedOffer(null);
82:         };

84:         const timer = setTimeout(() => {
85:             document.addEventListener('click', handleClickOutside);
86:         }, 100);
87:

90:             document.removeEventListener('click', handleClickOutside);
91:         };

101:

103:                 const supplierName = (supplier?.alias || supplier?.tradeName || '').toLowerCase();
104: 
105:                 const matchesOfferNumber = offer.offerNumber?.toLowerCase().includes(query);
106:                 const matchesSupplier = supplierName.includes(query);
107:                 const matchesFactoryName = offer.factoryName?.toLowerCase().includes(query);
108:                 const matchesItems = offer.items?.some(item =>
109:                     item.name?.toLowerCase().includes(query)
110:                 );
111:                 const matchesInternalNotes = (offer.internalNotes || '').toLowerCase().includes(query);
112: 
113:                 return matchesOfferNumber || matchesSupplier || matchesFactoryName ||
114:                     matchesItems || matchesInternalNotes;
115:             }
116: 
117:             return true;
118:         })

120:                 if (a.status === 'under_discussion' && b.status !== 'under_discussion') return -1;

122:                 return new Date(b.createdAt).getTime() - new Date(a.createdAt).getTime();
123:             });
124:     }, [offers, activeFilter, searchQuery, suppliers]);

139:         { value: 'under_discussion' as PriceOfferStatus, label: 'تحت المناقشة', icon: MessageSquare, color: 'text-blue-500' },

======= components\procurement\price-offers\StatisticsPanel.tsx =======
1: import React, { useMemo } from 'react';
2: import { PriceOffer, PriceOfferStatus, Supplier } from '../../../types';
3: import { FileText, DollarSign, User, BarChart3 } from 'lucide-react';
4: 
5: export const StatisticsPanel: React.FC<{ offers: PriceOffer[]; suppliers: Supplier[] }> = ({ offers, suppliers }) => {
6:     const stats = useMemo(() => {
7:         const totalOffers = offers.length;
8:         const totalValue = offers.reduce((sum, offer) => sum + offer.grandTotal, 0);
9: 
10:         const statusCounts = offers.reduce((acc, offer) => {
11:             acc[offer.status] = (acc[offer.status] || 0) + 1;
12:             return acc;
13:         }, {} as Record<PriceOfferStatus, number>);
14: 
15:         const supplierCount = new Set(offers.map(offer => offer.supplierId)).size;
16:         const averageValue = totalOffers > 0 ? totalValue / totalOffers : 0;
17: 
18:         return {
19:             totalOffers,
20:             totalValue,
21:             statusCounts,
22:             supplierCount,
23:             averageValue
24:         };
25:     }, [offers]);
26: 
27:     return (
28:         <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 mb-6">
29:             <div className="bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-500 to-blue-600 rounded-xl p-5 text-white">
30:                 <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
31:                     <div>
32:                         <p className="text-sm opacity-90">إجمالي العروض</p>
33:                         <p className="text-2xl font-bold mt-1">{stats.totalOffers}</p>
34:                     </div>
35:                     <FileText className="w-10 h-10 opacity-80" />
36:                 </div>
37:             </div>
38: 
39:             <div className="bg-gradient-to-r from-green-500 to-green-600 rounded-xl p-5 text-white">
40:                 <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
41:                     <div>
42:                         <p className="text-sm opacity-90">القيمة الإجمالية</p>
43:                         <p className="text-2xl font-bold mt-1">${stats.totalValue.toLocaleString()}</p>
44:                     </div>
45:                     <DollarSign className="w-10 h-10 opacity-80" />
46:                 </div>
47:             </div>
48: 
49:             <div className="bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-500 to-purple-600 rounded-xl p-5 text-white">
50:                 <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
51:                     <div>
52:                         <p className="text-sm opacity-90">عدد الموردين</p>
53:                         <p className="text-2xl font-bold mt-1">{stats.supplierCount}</p>
54:                     </div>
55:                     <User className="w-10 h-10 opacity-80" />
56:                 </div>
57:             </div>
58: 
59:             <div className="bg-gradient-to-r from-orange-500 to-orange-600 rounded-xl p-5 text-white">
60:                 <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
61:                     <div>
62:                         <p className="text-sm opacity-90">متوسط قيمة العرض</p>
63:                         <p className="text-2xl font-bold mt-1">${stats.averageValue.toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 0 })}</p>
64:                     </div>
65:                     <BarChart3 className="w-10 h-10 opacity-80" />
66:                 </div>
67:             </div>
68:         </div>
69:     );
70: };

18:     isOpen, onClose, allDeals, existingDealIds, allSuppliers, onAddDeals
19: }) => {

22:     const [filterStatus, setFilterStatus] = useState("all");

24:     // تصفية الصفقات (نستثني المضافة مسبقاً)
25:     const filteredDeals = useMemo(() => {

27:             if (existingDealIds.includes(deal.id)) return false; // إخفاء المضافة مسبقاً
28: 
29:             // فلتر البحث
30:             if (searchTerm) {
31:                 const term = searchTerm.toLowerCase();

33:                     deal.dealNumber?.toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
34:                     deal.originalOfferNumber?.toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
35:                     deal.factoryName?.toLowerCase().includes(term);
36:                 if (!matches) return false;
37:             }
38: 
39:             // فلتر الحالة (اختياري)
40:             if (filterStatus !== "all" && deal.status !== filterStatus) return false;
41: 
42:             return true;
43:         });
44:     }, [allDeals, existingDealIds, searchTerm, filterStatus]);
45: 
46:     const toggleSelection = (dealId: string) => {
47:         setSelectedIds(prev => {
48:             const newSet = new Set(prev);
49:             if (newSet.has(dealId)) newSet.delete(dealId);
50:             else newSet.add(dealId);
51:             return newSet;
52:         });
53:     };
54:

56:         onAddDeals(Array.from(selectedIds));
57:         setSelectedIds(new Set());
58:         onClose();
59:     };
60: 
61:     if (!isOpen) return null;
62: 
63:     return (
64:         <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm p-4">
65:             <div className="bg-white dark:bg-gray-900 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl w-full max-w-5xl max-h-[90vh] flex flex-col border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700">
66: 
67:                 {/* Header */}
68:                 <div className="p-5 border-b border-gray-100 dark:border-gray-800 flex justify-between items-center bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800/50 rounded-t-2xl">
69:                     <div>
70:                         <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white flex items-center gap-2">
71:                             <Package className="w-6 h-6 text-blue-500" />
72:                             اختر الصفقات للشحن
73:                         </h3>
74:                         <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 mt-1">
75:                             تم تحديد {selectedIds.size} صفقة
76:                         </p>
77:                     </div>
78:                     <div className="flex gap-3">
79:                         <button onClick={onClose} className="p-2 hover:bg-gray-200 dark:hover:bg-gray-700 rounded-full transition-colors">
80:                             <X className="w-5 h-5 text-gray-500" />
81:                         </button>
82:                     </div>
83:                 </div>

162:                             <input type="text" value={shippingInfo.billOfLadingNumber || ''} onChange={(e) => setShippingInfo(prev => ({ ...prev, billOfLadingNumber: e.target.value }))} className="w-full p-2 text-sm bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-900 border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 rounded-lg font-mono" />
163:                         </div>
164:                     </div>

======= components\store\ProductCard.tsx =======
1: import React from 'react';
2: import { Item } from '../../types';
3: import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
4: import { Eye, Share2, Tag } from 'lucide-react';
5: 
6: interface ProductCardProps {
7:     item: Item;
8: }
9: 
10: export const ProductCard: React.FC<ProductCardProps> = ({ item }) => {
11:     // تحديد البيانات المراد عرضها (المتجر أولاً، ثم البيانات الأصلية)
12:     const displayName = item.storeName || item.name;
13:     const displayDescription = item.storeDescription || item.specifications;
14: 
15:     const handleShare = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
16:         e.preventDefault();
17:         e.stopPropagation();
18:         const url = `${window.location.origin}/store/product/${item.id}`;
19: 
20:         if (navigator.share) {
21:             navigator.share({
22:                 title: displayName,
23:                 text: displayDescription,
24:                 url: url,
25:             });
26:         } else {
27:             navigator.clipboard.writeText(url);
28:             alert('تم نسخ رابط المنتج!');
29:         }
30:     };
31: 
32:     return (
33:         <Link
34:             to={`/store/product/${item.id}`}
35:             className="group bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-2xl shadow-sm hover:shadow-xl transition-all duration-300 border border-gray-100 dark:border-gray-700 flex flex-col h-full overflow-hidden"
36:         >
37:             {/* Image Container */}
38:             <div className="relative h-56 sm:h-64 overflow-hidden bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-900">
39:                 <img
40:                     src={item.imageUrls?.[0] || '/placeholder-image.png'}
41:                     alt={displayName}
42:                     className="w-full h-full object-cover transform group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform duration-500"
43:                     loading="lazy"
44:                 />
45: 
46:                 {/* Overlay */}
47:                 <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/20 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-300" />
48: 
49:                 {/* Price Tag (If exists) */}
50:                 {item.salePrice && item.salePrice > 0 && (
51:                     <div className="absolute bottom-3 right-3 bg-white/95 dark:bg-gray-800/95 backdrop-blur-sm px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg shadow-lg flex items-center gap-1">
52:                         <span className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
53:                             {item.salePrice.toLocaleString()}
54:                         </span>
55:                         <span className="text-xs text-gray-500">ILS</span>
56:                     </div>
57:                 )}
58: 
59:                 {/* Share Button */}
60:                 <button
61:                     onClick={handleShare}
62:                     className="absolute top-3 left-3 p-2 bg-white/90 dark:bg-gray-800/90 rounded-full shadow-sm opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-all duration-300 hover:bg-blue-50 hover:text-blue-600"
63:                 >
64:                     <Share2 className="w-4 h-4" />
65:                 </button>
66:             </div>
67: 
68:             {/* Content */}
69:             <div className="p-4 flex flex-col flex-grow">
70:                 {/* Categories & Brand Badges */}
71:                 <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 mb-2 text-[10px] sm:text-xs">
72:                     {item.brandName && (
73:                         <span className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-700 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300 rounded-md font-medium">
74:                             {item.brandName}
75:                         </span>
76:                     )}
77:                     <span className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-900/20 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 rounded-md">
78:                         {item.categoryName}
79:                     </span>
80:                 </div>
81: 
82:                 {/* Title */}
83:                 <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white line-clamp-2 mb-2 group-hover:text-blue-600 transition-colors" title={displayName}>
84:                     {displayName}
85:                 </h3>
86: 
87:                 {/* Description */}
88:                 <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 line-clamp-2 mb-4 flex-grow">

90:                 </p>

======= components\TaskDetailsModal\index.tsx =======
1: // TaskDetailsModal/index.tsx
2: import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
3: import { TaskDetailsModalProps } from "./TaskDetailsModal.types";
4: import { useTaskLogic } from "./useTaskLogic";
5: import { ManagerTaskView } from "./ManagerTaskView";
6: import { StandardTaskView } from "./StandardTaskView";
7: 
8: type ViewMode = 'dashboard' | 'details';
9: 
10: export const TaskDetailsModal: React.FC<TaskDetailsModalProps> = (props) => {
11:   const { task, user, users, isOpen } = props;
12:   const [localTask, setLocalTask] = useState(task);
13:   const [selectedUserId, setSelectedUserId] = useState<string>(user.id);
14:   
15:   // تحديد الوضع الافتراضي: إذا كان مدير أو مشتريات يبدأ بلوحة القيادة، غير ذلك التفاصيل
16:   const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useState<ViewMode>(
17:     (user.role === 'manager' || user.role === 'procurement') ? 'dashboard' : 'details'
18:   );
19: 
20:   useEffect(() => {
21:     setLocalTask(task);
22:   }, [task]);
23: 
24:   const logic = useTaskLogic(localTask, users, isOpen);
25: 
26:   if (!isOpen) return null;
27: 
28:   // التعامل مع التنقل
29:   const handleViewDetails = (userId: string) => {
30:     setSelectedUserId(userId);
31:     setViewMode('details');
32:   };
33: 
34:   const handleBackToDashboard = () => {
35:     setViewMode('dashboard');
36:   };
37: 
38:   // عرض لوحة القيادة (Dashboard)
39:   if (viewMode === 'dashboard' && (user.role === 'manager' || user.role === 'procurement')) {
40:     return (
41:       <ManagerTaskView
42:         {...props}
43:         task={localTask}
44:         stats={logic.stats}
45:         searchTerm={logic.searchTerm}
46:         setSearchTerm={logic.setSearchTerm}
47:         statusFilter={logic.statusFilter}
48:         setStatusFilter={logic.setStatusFilter}
49:         filteredSubmissionsData={logic.filteredSubmissionsData}
50:         toggleUserExpansion={logic.toggleUserExpansion}
51:         expandAllUsers={() => logic.setExpandedUsers(logic.assignedUsers.map(u => u.id))}
52:         collapseAllUsers={() => logic.setExpandedUsers([])}
53:         onViewDetails={handleViewDetails} // نمرر دالة الانتقال للتفاصيل
54:       />
55:     );
56:   }
57: 
58:   // عرض تفاصيل المهمة (Standard View)
59:   return (
60:     <StandardTaskView
61:       {...props}
62:       task={localTask}
63:       selectedUserId={selectedUserId}
64:       setSelectedUserId={setSelectedUserId}
65:       currentTime={logic.currentTime}
66:       assignedUsers={logic.assignedUsers}
67:       allSubmissionsData={logic.allSubmissionsData}
68:       // نمرر خاصية جديدة لزر العودة (سنضيفها في StandardTaskView)
69:       onBackToDashboard={
70:         (user.role === 'manager' || user.role === 'procurement') 
71:           ? handleBackToDashboard 
72:           : undefined
73:       }
74:     />
75:   );
76: };

135:                  {task.title}
136:                  {selectedUser.id !== user.id && <span className="text-sm font-normal text-gray-500">({selectedUser.name})</span>}
137:                </h2>
138:                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-xs sm:text-sm">
139:                  <StatusBadge status={selectedUserTaskStatus.status} />
140:                  <PriorityIndicator priority={task.priority} />
141:                </div>
142:              </div>
143:            </div>
144:            <button onClick={onClose} className="text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 text-2xl px-2">&times;</button>
145:         </header>
146: 
147:         {/* User Selector for Admins */}
148:         {isReviewer && assignedUsers.length > 0 && (
149:           <div className="px-4 py-3 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800/50 border-b border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 sticky top-[73px] z-10">
150:              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
151:                {assignedUsers.map(u => (
152:                  <button key={u.id} onClick={() => setSelectedUserId(u.id)} className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs transition ${selectedUserId === u.id ? "bg-blue-600 text-white" : "bg-gray-200 text-gray-700"}`}>
153:                     {u.name} {u.id === user.id && " (أنت)"}
154:                  </button>
155:                ))}
156:              </div>
157:           </div>
158:         )}
159: 
160:         {/* Main Content */}
161:         <main className="flex-1 p-4 sm:p-5 overflow-y-auto grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
162:            {/* Task Info Column */}
163:            <div className="space-y-6">
164:               <div>
165:                  <h3 className="text-lg font-bold mb-2 text-gray-800 dark:text-gray-100 border-b pb-1">تفاصيل المهمة</h3>
166:                  <div className="divide-y divide-gray-200 dark:divide-gray-700 text-sm">
167:                     <DetailRow label="الوقت المنقضي" value={
168:                         <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
169:                             <span>{formatMillisecondsToWords(getCurrentElapsedTime())}</span>
170:                             {selectedUserTaskStatus.status === "in_progress" && <span className="animate-pulse">🟢</span>}
171:                         </div>
172:                     } />
173:                     <DetailRow label="تاريخ التسليم" value={task.dueDate} />
174:                  </div>
175:                  <p className="mt-3 p-3 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-700/50 rounded-lg text-sm whitespace-pre-wrap">{task.description}</p>
176:                  <TaskImagesGallery images={task.images || []} />
177:                  {selectedUserTaskStatus.status === "rejected" && task.rejectReason && (
178:                     <div className="mt-3 p-3 bg-red-50 text-red-800 rounded-lg border border-red-300">
179:                         <p className="font-bold text-sm">سبب الرفض:</p>
180:                         <p className="text-sm">{task.rejectReason}</p>
181:                     </div>
182:                  )}
183:               </div>
184:               
185:               {/* Submission Area */}
186:               <div>
187:                 <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-2 border-b pb-1">
188:                    <h3 className="text-lg font-bold">تسليم العمل</h3>
189:                    {/* زر إضافة تسليم يظهر فقط إذا كنت تعمل على ملفك الخاص والحالة تسمح */}
190:                    {canWorkOnTask && !isCreating && !editingSubmissionId && ["in_progress", "submitted", "rejected"].includes(selectedUserTaskStatus.status) && (
191:                       <button onClick={() => setIsCreating(true)} className="text-sm bg-blue-600 text-white px-3 py-1 rounded hover:bg-blue-700">+ تسليم جديد</button>
192:                    )}
193:                 </div>
194:                 {isCreating || editingSubmissionId ? (
195:                    <SubmissionForm
196:                      initialData={editingSubmissionId ? (task.submissions || []).find(s => s.id === editingSubmissionId) : undefined}
197:                      onSubmit={handleSaveSubmission} onCancel={() => {setIsCreating(false); setEditingSubmissionId(null);}}
198:                      isEditMode={!!editingSubmissionId} userRole={user.role} taskId={task.id} userId={selectedUserId}
199:                    />
200:                 ) : (
201:                    <SubmissionHistoryList
202:                      submissions={allSubmissionsData.find(d => d.userId === selectedUserId)?.submissions || []}
203:                      onEdit={(s) => { 
204:                        // السماح بالتعديل فقط إذا كان المستخدم يملك التسليم ولم تتم الموافقة عليه
205:                        if(s.userId === user.id && s.status !== 'approved') setEditingSubmissionId(s.id); 
206:                      }}
207:                      // نمرر الدور: إذا كان المستخدم يراجع موظف آخر، نمرر دوره (مدير/مشتريات). إذا كان يشاهد نفسه، نمرر 'employee' ليختفي زر القبول/الرفض
208:                      userRole={selectedUserId === user.id ? 'employee' : user.role} 
209:                      currentUserId={selectedUserId}
210:                      onUpdateSubmissionStatus={onUpdateSubmissionStatus} 
211:                      selectedUserName={selectedUser.name}
212:                    />
213:                 )}
214:               </div>
215:            </div>
216: 
217:            {/* Activity Log Column */}
218:            <div className="border-t md:border-t-0 md:border-r md:pr-4 pt-4 md:pt-0">
219:               <h3 className="text-lg font-bold mb-3 text-gray-800 dark:text-gray-100">سجل النشاط</h3>
220:               <ul className="space-y-4 text-sm max-h-[300px] md:max-h-full overflow-y-auto">
221:                  {(task.logs || []).slice().reverse().map(log => (
222:                     <li key={log.id} className="relative pr-4 border-r-2 border-gray-200">
223:                        <div className="absolute -right-[5px] top-1 w-2 h-2 bg-blue-500 rounded-full"></div>
224:                        <p className="font-bold">{usersMap[log.userId] || "System"}</p>
225:                        <span className="text-xs text-gray-500 block mb-1">{new Date(log.timestamp).toLocaleString()}</span>
226:                        <p className="text-gray-600">{log.action} {log.newValue && `: ${log.newValue}`}</p>
227:                     </li>
228:                  ))}
229:               </ul>
230:            </div>
231:         </main>
232: 
233:         <footer className="p-4 bg-gray-50 border-t flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-3">
234:            <div className="w-full sm:flex-1">{renderActionButtons()}</div>
235:            <button onClick={onClose} className="bg-gray-200 text-gray-800 font-bold py-3 px-6 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-300">إغلاق</button>
236:         </footer>
237:       </div>
238:     </div>
239:   );
240: };
