======= components\TaskDetailsModal\useTaskLogic.ts =======
1: // TaskDetailsModal/useTaskLogic.ts
2: import { useState, useMemo, useEffect } from "react";
3: import { Task, User } from "../../types";
4: 
5: export const useTaskLogic = (
6:   task: Task,
7:   users: User[],
8:   isOpen: boolean
9: ) => {
10:   const [currentTime, setCurrentTime] = useState(Date.now());
11:   const [expandedUsers, setExpandedUsers] = useState<string[]>([]);
12:   const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
13:   const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState('all');
14: 
15:   // تحديث الوقت كل دقيقة
16:   useEffect(() => {
17:     if (isOpen) {
18:       setCurrentTime(Date.now());
19:       const interval = setInterval(() => setCurrentTime(Date.now()), 60000);
20:       return () => clearInterval(interval);
21:     }
22:   }, [isOpen]);
23: 
24:   // FIX: التعامل مع assignedTo سواء كان مصفوفة أو نص مفرد
25:   const assignedUsers = useMemo(() => {
26:     // نستخدم (as any) لتجنب خطأ TypeScript إذا كان النوع معرفاً كـ string فقط
27:     const assignedToRaw = task.assignedTo as unknown;
28:     
29:     let userIds: string[] = [];
30: 
31:     if (Array.isArray(assignedToRaw)) {
32:       userIds = assignedToRaw as string[];
33:     } else if (typeof assignedToRaw === 'string') {
34:       userIds = [assignedToRaw];
35:     }
36: 
37:     return userIds
38:       .map((userId) => users.find((u) => u.id === userId))
39:       .filter((u): u is User => Boolean(u)); // (u is User) تضمن لـ TS أن النتيجة مصفوفة مستخدمين صحيحة
40:   }, [task.assignedTo, users]);
41: 
42:   const allSubmissionsData = useMemo(() => {
43:     return assignedUsers.map(assignedUser => {
44:       const userId = assignedUser.id;
45:       const userSubmissions = (task.submissions || []).filter(sub => sub.userId === userId);
46:       const sortedSubmissions = [...userSubmissions].sort(
47:         (a, b) => new Date(b.createdAt).getTime() - new Date(a.createdAt).getTime()
48:       );
49:       const latestSubmission = sortedSubmissions.length > 0 ? sortedSubmissions[0] : null;
50:       const userStatus = task.userStatuses?.[userId] || {};
51:       
52:       return {
53:         user: assignedUser,
54:         userId,
55:         submissions: sortedSubmissions,
56:         latestSubmission,
57:         userStatus,
58:         submissionCount: userSubmissions.length,
59:         isExpanded: expandedUsers.includes(userId)
60:       };
61:     });
62:   }, [task, assignedUsers, expandedUsers, users]);
63: 
64:   const filteredSubmissionsData = useMemo(() => {
65:     return allSubmissionsData.filter(data => {
66:       const matchesSearch = 
67:         data.user.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
68:         data.user.email?.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
69:         (data.latestSubmission?.status && data.latestSubmission.status.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()));
70:       
71:       const matchesStatus = 
72:         statusFilter === 'all' ||
73:         (statusFilter === 'submitted' && data.latestSubmission) || // تمت إضافة || هنا (كان مفقوداً)
74:         (statusFilter === 'pending' && data.latestSubmission?.status === 'pending') ||
75:         (statusFilter === 'approved' && data.latestSubmission?.status === 'approved') ||
76:         (statusFilter === 'rejected' && data.latestSubmission?.status === 'rejected') ||
77:         (statusFilter === 'not_submitted' && !data.latestSubmission) ||
78:         (statusFilter === 'with_new_items' && data.latestSubmission?.newItemsCount && data.latestSubmission.newItemsCount > 0);
79:       
80:       return matchesSearch && matchesStatus;
81:     });
82:   }, [allSubmissionsData, searchTerm, statusFilter]);
83: 
84:   const stats = useMemo(() => {
85:     const total = assignedUsers.length;
86:     const submitted = allSubmissionsData.filter(d => d.latestSubmission).length;
87:     const pending = allSubmissionsData.filter(d => d.latestSubmission?.status === 'pending').length;
88:     const approved = allSubmissionsData.filter(d => d.latestSubmission?.status === 'approved').length;
89:     const rejected = allSubmissionsData.filter(d => d.latestSubmission?.status === 'rejected').length;
90:     const withNewItems = allSubmissionsData.filter(d => d.latestSubmission?.newItemsCount && d.latestSubmission.newItemsCount > 0).length;
91: 
92:     return { total, submitted, pending, approved, rejected, withNewItems };
93:   }, [allSubmissionsData, assignedUsers]);
94: 
95:   const toggleUserExpansion = (userId: string) => {
96:     setExpandedUsers(prev => prev.includes(userId) ? prev.filter(id => id !== userId) : [...prev, userId]);
97:   };
98: 
99:   return {
100:     currentTime,
101:     assignedUsers,
102:     allSubmissionsData,
103:     filteredSubmissionsData,
104:     stats,
105:     searchTerm,
106:     setSearchTerm,
107:     statusFilter,
108:     setStatusFilter,
109:     toggleUserExpansion,
110:     setExpandedUsers,
111:     expandedUsers
112:   };
113: };

72:         (statusFilter === 'approved' && data.latestSubmission?.status === 'approved') ||

======= components\ui\CollapsibleSection.tsx =======
1: import React, { useState } from 'react';
2: import { ChevronDown, ChevronUp, LucideIcon, Info } from 'lucide-react';
3: 
4: interface CollapsibleSectionProps {
5:     title: string;
6:     icon?: LucideIcon;
7:     defaultOpen?: boolean;
8:     children: React.ReactNode;
9:     className?: string;
10:     description?: string;
11:     compact?: boolean;
12:     badge?: string;
13:     badgeColor?: 'blue' | 'green' | 'red' | 'yellow' | 'purple' | 'gray';
14:     onToggle?: (isOpen: boolean) => void;
15: }
16: 
17: export const CollapsibleSection: React.FC<CollapsibleSectionProps> = ({
18:     title,
19:     icon: Icon,
20:     defaultOpen = true,
21:     children,
22:     className = "",
23:     description,
24:     compact = false,
25:     badge,
26:     badgeColor = 'blue',
27:     onToggle
28: }) => {
29:     const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(defaultOpen);
30: 
31:     const handleToggle = () => {
32:         const newState = !isOpen;
33:         setIsOpen(newState);
34:         onToggle?.(newState);
35:     };
36: 
37:     const badgeColors = {
38:         blue: 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 dark:bg-blue-900/30 dark:text-blue-300 border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800/50',
39:         green: 'bg-green-100 text-green-800 dark:bg-green-900/30 dark:text-green-300 border-green-200 dark:border-green-800/50',
40:         red: 'bg-red-100 text-red-800 dark:bg-red-900/30 dark:text-red-300 border-red-200 dark:border-red-800/50',
41:         yellow: 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800 dark:bg-yellow-900/30 dark:text-yellow-300 border-yellow-200 dark:border-yellow-800/50',
42:         purple: 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-800 dark:bg-purple-900/30 dark:text-purple-300 border-purple-200 dark:border-purple-800/50',
43:         gray: 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-600'
44:     };
45: 
46:     return (
47:         <div className={`${compact ? 'rounded-lg' : 'rounded-xl'} bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 shadow-sm border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 overflow-hidden transition-all duration-200 ${className}`}>
48:             <button
49:                 onClick={handleToggle}
50:                 className={`w-full flex items-center justify-between ${compact ? 'p-3' : 'p-4'} ${isOpen
51:                     ? 'bg-gray-50/80 dark:bg-gray-800/80 border-b border-gray-100 dark:border-gray-700/50'
52:                     : 'bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 hover:bg-gray-50 dark:hover:bg-gray-750'
53:                     } transition-colors`}
54:             >
55:                 <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-1 min-w-0">
56:                     {Icon && (
57:                         <div className={`${compact ? 'p-1.5' : 'p-2'} rounded-lg flex-shrink-0 ${isOpen
58:                                 ? 'bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-900/30 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400'
59:                                 : 'bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-700 text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400'
60:                             }`}>
61:                             <Icon className={compact ? "w-4 h-4" : "w-5 h-5"} />
62:                         </div>
63:                     )}
64: 
65:                     <div className={`flex-1 min-w-0 ${compact ? 'text-right pr-2' : 'text-right pr-3'}`}>
66:                         <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
67:                             <h3 className={`font-semibold truncate ${compact ? 'text-sm' : 'text-base'} text-gray-900 dark:text-white`}>
68:                                 {title}
69:                             </h3>
70: 
71:                             {badge && (
72:                                 <span className={`flex-shrink-0 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs border ${badgeColors[badgeColor]}`}>
73:                                     {badge}
74:                                 </span>
75:                             )}
76:                         </div>
77: 
78:                         {description && (
79:                             <p className={`truncate ${compact ? 'text-xs mt-0.5' : 'text-sm mt-1'} text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 font-normal`}>
80:                                 {description}
81:                             </p>
82:                         )}
83:                     </div>
84:                 </div>
85: 
86:                 <div className={`flex-shrink-0 ${compact ? 'p-1' : 'p-1.5'} rounded-full transition-colors ${isOpen ? 'bg-gray-200 dark:bg-gray-700' : 'bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-700/50'
87:                     }`}>

======= components\utils\formatters.ts =======
1: // formatters.ts
2: 
3: export const formatMillisecondsToWords = (ms: number) => {
4:   if (!ms || ms < 0) return "0 ثانية";
5:   const totalSeconds = Math.floor(ms / 1000);
6:   const hours = Math.floor(totalSeconds / 3600);
7:   const minutes = Math.floor((totalSeconds % 3600) / 60);
8:   const seconds = totalSeconds % 60;
9:   const parts = [];
10:   if (hours > 0) parts.push(`${hours} ساعة`);
11:   if (minutes > 0) parts.push(`${minutes} دقيقة`);
12:   if (seconds > 0 || totalSeconds === 0) parts.push(`${seconds} ثانية`);
13:   return parts.join("، ");
14: };

======= constants\shipping.ts =======
1: export const SHIPPING_TERMS = [
2:     { code: 'EXW', name: 'Ex Works' },
3:     { code: 'FCA', name: 'Free Carrier' },
4:     { code: 'FAS', name: 'Free Alongside Ship' },
5:     { code: 'FOB', name: 'Free on Board' },
6:     { code: 'CFR', name: 'Cost and Freight' },
7:     { code: 'CIF', name: 'Cost, Insurance and Freight' },
8:     { code: 'CPT', name: 'Carriage Paid To' },
9:     { code: 'CIP', name: 'Carriage and Insurance Paid To' },
10:     { code: 'DAT', name: 'Delivered at Terminal' },
11:     { code: 'DAP', name: 'Delivered at Place' },
12:     { code: 'DDP', name: 'Delivered Duty Paid' }
13: ] as const;
14: 
15: export type ShippingTermCode = typeof SHIPPING_TERMS[number]['code'];
16: 
17: export const getShippingTermIndex = (code: string) => {
18:     return SHIPPING_TERMS.findIndex(t => t.code === code);
19: };
20: 
21: export const getLatestShippingTerm = (codes: string[]): ShippingTermCode => {
22:     if (!codes || codes.length === 0) return 'EXW';
23: 
24:     let maxIndex = -1;
25:     let latestTerm: ShippingTermCode = 'EXW';
26: 
27:     codes.forEach(code => {
28:         const index = getShippingTermIndex(code);
29:         if (index > maxIndex) {
30:             maxIndex = index;
31:             latestTerm = code as ShippingTermCode;
32:         }
33:     });
34: 
35:     return latestTerm;
36: };
37: 
38: export const getShippingPath = (from: string, to: string): typeof SHIPPING_TERMS[number][] => {
39:     const fromIndex = getShippingTermIndex(from);
40:     const toIndex = getShippingTermIndex(to);
41: 
42:     if (fromIndex === -1 || toIndex === -1) return [];
43: 
44:     if (fromIndex <= toIndex) {
45:         return SHIPPING_TERMS.slice(fromIndex, toIndex + 1) as unknown as typeof SHIPPING_TERMS[number][];
46:     } else {
47:         // In case 'to' is earlier than 'from' (odd but handle it)
48:         return SHIPPING_TERMS.slice(toIndex, fromIndex + 1).reverse() as unknown as typeof SHIPPING_TERMS[number][];
49:     }
50: };


======= constants\supplierConstants.ts =======

11:     { value: 'shipping_agent', label: 'وكيل شحن' },
12:     { value: 'international_trader', label: 'تاجر عالمي' },
13:     { value: 'local_company', label: 'شركة محلية' },
14:     { value: 'service_provider', label: 'مقدم خدمة' },

18:     if (!value) return 'غير محدد';
19:     const option = SUPPLIER_TYPES.find(opt => opt.value === value);
20:     return option ? option.label : value;
21: };


======= contexts\AuthContext.tsx =======
1: 
2: import React, { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
3: import { User, AppView } from '../types';
4: import { auth, db } from '../firebaseConfig';
5: import { doc, getDoc } from 'firebase/firestore';
6: import { activityService } from '../services/firestoreService';
7: 
8: interface AuthContextType {
9:     currentUser: User | null;
10:     loading: boolean;
11:     logout: () => Promise<void>;
12:     updateUser: (user: User) => void;
13: }
14: 
15: const AuthContext = createContext<AuthContextType | undefined>(undefined);
16: 
17: export const useAuth = () => {
18:     const context = useContext(AuthContext);
19:     if (!context) {
20:         throw new Error('useAuth must be used within an AuthProvider');
21:     }
22:     return context;
23: };
24: 
25: export const AuthProvider: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
26:     const [currentUser, setCurrentUser] = useState<User | null>(null);
27:     const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
28: 
29:     const fetchUserProfile = async (uid: string): Promise<User | null> => {
30:         try {
31:             const userDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, "users", uid));
32:             if (userDoc.exists()) {
33:                 const userData = userDoc.data() as User;
34:                 return { ...userData, id: userDoc.id }; // Ensure ID is included
35:             }
36:         } catch (error) {
37:             console.error("Error fetching user profile:", error);
38:         }
39:         return null;
40:     };
41: 
42:     useEffect(() => {
43:         const unsubscribe = auth.onAuthStateChanged(async (firebaseUser) => {
44:             setLoading(true);
45:             if (firebaseUser) {
46:                 try {
47:                     const userProfile = await fetchUserProfile(firebaseUser.uid);
48:                     if (userProfile && userProfile.isApproved) {
49:                         setCurrentUser(userProfile);
50: 
51:                         // Initialize activity monitoring
52:                         try {
53:                             const status = await activityService.getActivityStatus(userProfile.id);
54:                             if (!status) {
55:                                 await activityService.initializeActivityStatus(userProfile.id);
56:                             }
57:                         } catch (err) {
58:                             console.error("Error initializing activity:", err);
59:                         }
60: 
61:                     } else {
62:                         setCurrentUser(null);
63:                     }
64:                 } catch (error) {
65:                     console.error(error);
66:                     setCurrentUser(null);
67:                 }
68:             } else {
69:                 setCurrentUser(null);
70:             }
71:             setLoading(false);
72:         });
73: 
74:         return () => unsubscribe();
75:     }, []);
76: 
77:     const logout = async () => {
78:         await auth.signOut();
79:         setCurrentUser(null);
80:     };
81: 
82:     const updateUser = (user: User) => {
83:         setCurrentUser(user);
84:     }
85: 
86:     return (
87:         <AuthContext.Provider value={{ currentUser, loading, logout, updateUser }}>
88:             {children}
89:         </AuthContext.Provider>
90:     );
91: };

======= services\activeTasksService.ts =======
1: // services/activeTasksService.ts
2: class ActiveTasksService {
3:   private activeTasks: Map<string, any> = new Map();
4:   private updateCallbacks: Set<(taskId: string, userId: string, time: number) => void> = new Set();
5:   private intervalId: number | null = null;
6: 
7:   constructor() {
8:     this.startGlobalTimer();
9:   }
10: 
11:   private startGlobalTimer() {
12:     if (this.intervalId) return;
13: 
14:     this.intervalId = window.setInterval(() => {
15:       const now = Date.now();
16:       
17:       this.activeTasks.forEach((activeTask, key) => {
18:         const [taskId, userId] = key.split('_');
19:         const elapsed = now - activeTask.startTime;
20:         const totalTime = activeTask.totalAccumulated + elapsed;
21:         
22:         // إخطار جميع المشتركين بالتحديث - بدون قسمة على 1000
23:         this.updateCallbacks.forEach(callback => {
24:           callback(taskId, userId, totalTime); // إزالة Math.floor(totalTime / 1000)
25:         });
26:       });
27:     }, 1000);
28:   }
29: 
30:   startTask(taskId: string, userId: string, accumulatedTime: number = 0) {
31:     const key = `${taskId}_${userId}`;
32:     
33:     this.activeTasks.set(key, {
34:       taskId,
35:       userId,
36:       startTime: Date.now(),
37:       totalAccumulated: accumulatedTime
38:     });
39: 
40:     console.log(`بدأ تتبع المهمة: ${taskId} للمستخدم: ${userId}`, {accumulatedTime});
41:   }
42: 
43:   stopTask(taskId: string, userId: string): number {
44:     const key = `${taskId}_${userId}`;
45:     const activeTask = this.activeTasks.get(key);
46:     
47:     if (activeTask) {
48:       const now = Date.now();
49:       const elapsed = now - activeTask.startTime;
50:       const totalTime = activeTask.totalAccumulated + elapsed;
51:       
52:       this.activeTasks.delete(key);
53:       console.log(`توقف تتبع المهمة: ${taskId} للمستخدم: ${userId}`, {totalTime});
54:       
55:       return totalTime; // إرجاع الوقت بالمللي ثانية
56:     }
57:     
58:     return 0;
59:   }
60: 
61:   getCurrentTime(taskId: string, userId: string): number {
62:     const key = `${taskId}_${userId}`;
63:     const activeTask = this.activeTasks.get(key);
64:     
65:     if (activeTask) {
66:       const now = Date.now();
67:       const elapsed = now - activeTask.startTime;
68:       return activeTask.totalAccumulated + elapsed; // إرجاع الوقت بالمللي ثانية (بدون قسمة)
69:     }
70:     
71:     return 0;
72:   }
73: 
74:   subscribeToTimeUpdates(callback: (taskId: string, userId: string, time: number) => void) {
75:     this.updateCallbacks.add(callback);
76:     
77:     return () => {
78:       this.updateCallbacks.delete(callback);
79:     };
80:   }
81: 
82:   isTaskActive(taskId: string, userId: string): boolean {
83:     const key = `${taskId}_${userId}`;
84:     return this.activeTasks.has(key);
85:   }
86: 
87:   getUserActiveTasks(userId: string): string[] {
88:     const userTasks: string[] = [];
89:     
90:     this.activeTasks.forEach((activeTask, key) => {
91:       const [taskId, taskUserId] = key.split('_');
92:       if (taskUserId === userId) {
93:         userTasks.push(taskId);
94:       }
95:     });
96:     
97:     return userTasks;
98:   }
99: }
100: 
101: export const activeTasksService = new ActiveTasksService();

======= services\attendanceService.ts =======
1: // services/attendanceService.ts
2: import { AttendanceSession, AttendanceRecord, DailyPoints } from '../types';
3: import { db } from '../firebaseConfig';
4: import { 
5:   collection, 
6:   doc, 
7:   setDoc, 
8:   getDoc, 
9:   getDocs,

11:   deleteDoc, 
12:   query, 
13:   where, 
14:   orderBy,
15:   onSnapshot

18: class AttendanceService {
19:   private activeSession: AttendanceSession | null = null;
20:   private sessionListeners: Set<(session: AttendanceSession | null) => void> = new Set();
21: 
22:   // بدء جلسة حضور جديدة
23:   async startAttendanceSession(managerId: string): Promise<AttendanceSession> {
24:     // إيقاف أي جلسة نشطة سابقة
25:     if (this.activeSession) {
26:       await this.endAttendanceSession(this.activeSession.id);
27:     }
28: 
29:     const now = new Date();
30:     const sessionId = crypto.randomUUID();
31:     
32:     const session: AttendanceSession = {
33:       id: sessionId,
34:       date: now.toISOString().split('T')[0],
35:       startTime: now.toISOString(),
36:       isActive: true,
37:       createdBy: managerId,
38:       attendees: []
39:     };
40: 
41:     // حفظ في Firebase
42:     await setDoc(doc(db, 'attendanceSessions', sessionId), session);
43: 
44:     // تعيين timeout لإنهاء الجلسة تلقائياً بعد 5 دقائق
45:     session.autoEndTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
46:       this.endAttendanceSession(sessionId);
47:     }, 5 * 60 * 1000); // 5 دقائق
48: 
49:     this.activeSession = session;
50:     this.notifySessionListeners();
51:     
52:     return session;
53:   }
54: 
55:   // إنهاء جلسة الحضور
56:   async endAttendanceSession(sessionId: string): Promise<void> {
57:     const sessionRef = doc(db, 'attendanceSessions', sessionId);
58:     const now = new Date().toISOString();
59: 
60:     await updateDoc(sessionRef, {
61:       isActive: false,
62:       endTime: now
63:     });
64: 
65:     if (this.activeSession?.id === sessionId) {
66:       if (this.activeSession.autoEndTimeout) {
67:         clearTimeout(this.activeSession.autoEndTimeout);
68:       }
69:       this.activeSession = null;
70:       this.notifySessionListeners();
71:     }
72:   }
73: 
74:   // تسجيل حضور موظف
75: async markAttendance(userId: string, sessionId: string): Promise<AttendanceRecord> {
76:   const sessionRef = doc(db, 'attendanceSessions', sessionId);
77:   const sessionDoc = await getDoc(sessionRef);
78:   
79:   if (!sessionDoc.exists()) {
80:     throw new Error('جلسة الحضور غير موجودة');
81:   }
82: 
83:   const session = sessionDoc.data() as AttendanceSession;
84:   
85:   if (!session.isActive) {
86:     throw new Error('جلسة الحضور منتهية');
87:   }
88: 
89:   // التحقق إذا كان الموظف قد سجل حضوره مسبقاً
90:   if (session.attendees.includes(userId)) {
91:     throw new Error('لقد سجلت حضورك مسبقاً');
92:   }
93: 
94:   // تحديث قائمة الحاضرين
95:   await updateDoc(sessionRef, {
96:     attendees: [...session.attendees, userId]
97:   });
98: 
99:   // إنشاء سجل الحضور
100:   const recordId = crypto.randomUUID();
101:   const record: AttendanceRecord = {
102:     id: recordId,
103:     userId,
104:     sessionId,
105:     date: session.date,
106:     attendedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
107:     points: 10, // 10 نقاط للحضور
108:     status: 'present'
109:   };
110: 
111:   await setDoc(doc(db, 'attendanceRecords', recordId), record);
112: 
113:   // 🔥 هذا هو الجزء المهم - تحديث نقاط الحضور
114:   await this.updateAttendancePoints(userId, session.date);
115: 
116:   return record;
117: }
118: 
119: private async updateAttendancePoints(userId: string, date: string, addPoints: boolean = true): Promise<void> {
120:   try {
121:     console.log('تحديث نقاط الحضور:', { userId, date, addPoints });
122:     
123:     const pointsRef = doc(db, "pointsHistory", userId, "days", date);
124:     const pointsSnap = await getDoc(pointsRef);
125:     
126:     const pointsChange = addPoints ? 10 : -10; // +10 أو -10
127:     
128:     if (pointsSnap.exists()) {
129:       const current = pointsSnap.data() as DailyPoints;
130:       console.log('النقاط الحالية قبل التحديث:', current);
131:       
132:       const currentAttendancePoints = current.attendancePoints || 0;
133:       const newAttendancePoints = Math.max(0, currentAttendancePoints + pointsChange);
134:       const newTotalPoints = Math.max(0, (current.totalPoints || 0) + pointsChange);
135:       
136:       await updateDoc(pointsRef, {
137:         attendancePoints: newAttendancePoints,
138:         totalPoints: newTotalPoints,
139:         attended: addPoints // إذا كنا نضيف نقاط = حاضر، إذا كنا نخصم = غائب
140:       });
141:       
142:       console.log('تم تحديث نقاط الحضور. النقاط بعد التحديث:', {
143:         attendancePoints: newAttendancePoints,
144:         totalPoints: newTotalPoints,
145:         attended: addPoints
146:       });
147:     } else if (addPoints) {
148:       // فقط ننشئ سجل جديد إذا كنا نضيف نقاط
149:       const newPoints: DailyPoints = {
150:         date,
151:         userId,
152:         workMinutes: 0,
153:         activityPoints: 0,
154:         taskPoints: 0,
155:         attendancePoints: 10,
156:         totalPoints: 10,
157:         checkinClicks: 0,
158:         completedTasks: 0,
159:         attended: true
160:       };
161:       await setDoc(pointsRef, newPoints);
162:       console.log('تم إنشاء سجل نقاط جديد مع نقاط الحضور');
163:     }
164:   } catch (error) {
165:     console.error('خطأ في تحديث نقاط الحضور:', error);
166:     throw error;
167:   }
168: }
169: 
170:   // تحديث نقاط اليوم
171:   private async updateDailyPoints(userId: string, date: string): Promise<void> {
172:     const pointsRef = doc(db, 'dailyPoints', `${userId}_${date}`);
173:     const pointsDoc = await getDoc(pointsRef);
174: 
175:     if (pointsDoc.exists()) {
176:       const currentPoints = pointsDoc.data() as DailyPoints;
177:       await updateDoc(pointsRef, {
178:         attendancePoints: 10,
179:         totalPoints: (currentPoints.taskPoints || 0) + (currentPoints.activityPoints || 0) + 10,
180:         attended: true
181:       });
182:     } else {
183:       const newPoints: DailyPoints = {
184:         date,
185:         userId,
186:         workMinutes: 0,
187:         activityPoints: 0,
188:         taskPoints: 0,
189:         attendancePoints: 10,
190:         totalPoints: 10,
191:         checkinClicks: 0,
192:         completedTasks: 0,
193:         attended: true
194:       };
195:       await setDoc(pointsRef, newPoints);
196:     }
197:   }
198: 
199:   // الحصول على الجلسة النشطة
200:   async getActiveSession(): Promise<AttendanceSession | null> {
201:     if (this.activeSession) return this.activeSession;
202: 
203:     const q = query(
204:       collection(db, 'attendanceSessions'),
205:       where('isActive', '==', true),
206:       orderBy('startTime', 'desc')
207:     );
208: 
209:     const snapshot = await getDocs(q);
210:     if (snapshot.empty) return null;
211: 
212:     this.activeSession = snapshot.docs[0].data() as AttendanceSession;
213:     return this.activeSession;
214:   }
215: 
216:   // الاشتراك في تحديثات الجلسة النشطة
217:   subscribeToActiveSession(callback: (session: AttendanceSession | null) => void) {
218:     this.sessionListeners.add(callback);
219:     
220:     // إرجاع دالة إلغاء الاشتراك
221:     return () => {
222:       this.sessionListeners.delete(callback);
223:     };
224:   }
225: 
226:   private notifySessionListeners() {
227:     this.sessionListeners.forEach(callback => {
228:       callback(this.activeSession);
229:     });
230:   }
231: 
232:   // الحصول على سجلات الحضور ليوم معين
233: async getAttendanceRecords(date: string): Promise<AttendanceRecord[]> {
234:   try {
235:     // جلب جميع السجلات ثم الفلترة محلياً (لا يحتاج index)
236:     const q = query(
237:       collection(db, 'attendanceRecords'),
238:       orderBy('attendedAt', 'desc')
239:     );
240: 
241:     const snapshot = await getDocs(q);
242:     const allRecords = snapshot.docs.map(doc => doc.data() as AttendanceRecord);
243:     
244:     // الفلترة محلياً حسب التاريخ
245:     const filteredRecords = allRecords.filter(record => record.date === date);
246:     
247:     return filteredRecords;
248:   } catch (error) {
249:     console.error('Error loading attendance records:', error);
250:     
251:     // Fallback: إرجاع مصفوفة فارغة في حالة الخطأ
252:     return [];
253:   }
254: }
255: 
256:   // الحصول على تقرير الحضور لفترة معينة
257: async getAttendanceReport(startDate: string, endDate: string): Promise<{ [userId: string]: number }> {
258:   try {
259:     const q = query(
260:       collection(db, 'attendanceRecords'),
261:       orderBy('date', 'desc')
262:     );
263: 
264:     const snapshot = await getDocs(q);
265:     const report: { [userId: string]: number } = {};
266: 
267:     snapshot.docs.forEach(doc => {
268:       const record = doc.data() as AttendanceRecord;
269:       
270:       // الفلترة محلياً حسب النطاق الزمني
271:       if (record.date >= startDate && record.date <= endDate) {
272:         if (!report[record.userId]) {
273:           report[record.userId] = 0;
274:         }
275:         report[record.userId]++;
276:       }
277:     });
278: 
279:     return report;
280:   } catch (error) {
281:     console.error('Error loading attendance report:', error);
282:     return {};
283:   }
284: }

286:   // التعديل اليدوي على الحضور
287: async updateAttendanceManually(
288:   userId: string, 
289:   date: string, 
290:   attended: boolean
291: ): Promise<void> {
292:   try {
293:     console.log('تعديل الحضور يدوياً:', { userId, date, attended });
294:     
295:     if (attended) {
296:       // إنشاء سجل حضور يدوي وإضافة النقاط
297:       const recordId = crypto.randomUUID();
298:       const record: AttendanceRecord = {
299:         id: recordId,
300:         userId,
301:         sessionId: 'manual',
302:         date,
303:         attendedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
304:         points: 10,
305:         status: 'present'
306:       };
307: 
308:       await setDoc(doc(db, 'attendanceRecords', recordId), record);
309:       await this.updateAttendancePoints(userId, date, true); // true يعني إضافة نقاط
310:       
311:       console.log('تم تسجيل الحضور وإضافة 10 نقاط');
312:     } else {
313:       // 🔥 البحث عن سجلات الحضور لهذا اليوم وحذفها
314:       const q = query(
315:         collection(db, 'attendanceRecords'),
316:         where('userId', '==', userId),
317:         where('date', '==', date)
318:       );
319: 
320:       const snapshot = await getDocs(q);
321:       
322:       // حذف جميع سجلات الحضور لهذا اليوم
323:       const deletePromises = snapshot.docs.map(async (doc) => {
324:         await deleteDoc(doc.ref);
325:       });
326:       
327:       await Promise.all(deletePromises);
328:       
329:       // 🔥 خصم 10 نقاط من سجل النقاط
330:       await this.deductAttendancePoints(userId, date);
331:       
332:       console.log('تم إلغاء الحضور وخصم 10 نقاط');
333:     }
334:   } catch (error) {
335:     console.error('خطأ في التعديل اليدوي للحضور:', error);
336:     throw error;
337:   }
338: }
339: 
340: private async deductAttendancePoints(userId: string, date: string): Promise<void> {
341:   try {
342:     console.log('خصم نقاط الحضور للمستخدم:', userId, 'التاريخ:', date);
343:     
344:     const pointsRef = doc(db, "pointsHistory", userId, "days", date);
345:     const pointsSnap = await getDoc(pointsRef);
346:     
347:     if (pointsSnap.exists()) {
348:       const current = pointsSnap.data() as DailyPoints;
349:       console.log('النقاط قبل الخصم:', current);
350:       
351:       const currentAttendancePoints = current.attendancePoints || 0;
352:       const pointsToDeduct = Math.min(currentAttendancePoints, 10); // لا نخصم أكثر من 10
353:       
354:       const updatedAttendancePoints = currentAttendancePoints - pointsToDeduct;
355:       const updatedTotalPoints = (current.totalPoints || 0) - pointsToDeduct;
356:       
357:       await updateDoc(pointsRef, {
358:         attendancePoints: Math.max(0, updatedAttendancePoints), // لا تسمح بقيم سالبة
359:         totalPoints: Math.max(0, updatedTotalPoints), // لا تسمح بقيم سالبة
360:         attended: false
361:       });
362:       
363:       console.log('تم خصم نقاط الحضور. النقاط بعد الخصم:', {
364:         attendancePoints: Math.max(0, updatedAttendancePoints),
365:         totalPoints: Math.max(0, updatedTotalPoints)
366:       });
367:     } else {
368:       console.log('لا يوجد سجل نقاط لهذا اليوم، لا يوجد ما يتم خصمه');
369:       // إذا لم يكن هناك سجل، ننشئ سجل بدون نقاط حضور
370:       const newPoints: DailyPoints = {
371:         date,
372:         userId,
373:         workMinutes: 0,
374:         activityPoints: 0,
375:         taskPoints: 0,
376:         attendancePoints: 0,
377:         totalPoints: 0,
378:         checkinClicks: 0,
379:         completedTasks: 0,
380:         attended: false
381:       };
382:       await setDoc(pointsRef, newPoints);
383:     }
384:   } catch (error) {
385:     console.error('خطأ في خصم نقاط الحضور:', error);
386:     throw error;
387:   }
388: }
389: 
390: }
391: 
392: export const attendanceService = new AttendanceService();

63: // --- Login ---
64: export const loginUser = async (email: string, password: string): Promise<User> => {
65:     // خطوة 1: محاولة تسجيل الدخول
66:     const userCredential = await signInWithEmailAndPassword(auth, email, password);
67:     const firebaseUser = userCredential.user;
68: 
69:     // خطوة 2: التحقق من تفعيل الإيميل
70:     if (!firebaseUser.emailVerified) {
71:         // إذا لم يتم التفعيل:
72:         await signOut(auth); // تسجيل الخروج مباشرة
73:         throw new Error("EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED"); // رمي الخطأ للواجهة
74:     }
75: 
76:     // Get Firestore user doc
77:     const userDocRef = doc(db, "users", firebaseUser.uid);
78:     const userDocSnap = await getDoc(userDocRef);
79: 
80:     if (!userDocSnap.exists()) {
81:         await signOut(auth);
82:         throw new Error("User data not found.");
83:     }
84: 
85:     const userData = userDocSnap.data() as User;
86: 
87:     // Update Firestore if email verified now
88:     if (!userData.isEmailVerified && firebaseUser.emailVerified) {
89:         await updateDoc(userDocRef, { isEmailVerified: true });
90:         userData.isEmailVerified = true;
91:     }
92: 
93:     // Check approval
94:     if (!userData.isApproved) {
95:         await signOut(auth);
96:         throw new Error("ACCOUNT_NOT_APPROVED");
97:     }
98: 
99:     return userData;
100: };

164:         throw e;
165:     } finally {

167:     }

======= services\autoDisableScheduler.ts =======
1: // services/autoDisableScheduler.ts
2: import { activityService } from './firestoreService';
3: import { getDocs, collection } from 'firebase/firestore';
4: import { db } from '../firebaseConfig';
5: import { User } from '../types';
6: 
7: class AutoDisableScheduler {
8:     private intervalId: NodeJS.Timeout | null = null;
9:     private isRunning: boolean = false;
10: 
11:     // بدء المجدول
12:     start() {
13:         if (this.isRunning) return;
14:         
15:         console.log('🚀 بدء مجدول التعطيل التلقائي...');
16:         this.isRunning = true;
17: 
18:         // التحقق كل دقيقة (60000 مللي ثانية)
19:         this.intervalId = setInterval(() => {
20:             this.checkGlobalDisableStatus();
21:         }, 60000);
22: 
23:         // التحقق فور البدء
24:         this.checkGlobalDisableStatus();
25:     }
26: 
27:     // إيقاف المجدول
28:     stop() {
29:         if (this.intervalId) {
30:             clearInterval(this.intervalId);
31:             this.intervalId = null;
32:         }
33:         this.isRunning = false;
34:         console.log('⏹️ إيقاف مجدول التعطيل التلقائي');
35:     }
36: 
37:     // التحقق من حالة التعطيل العامة
38:     private async checkGlobalDisableStatus() {
39:         try {
40:             console.log('🕒 التحقق من التعطيل التلقائي...', new Date().toLocaleTimeString('ar-EG'));
41:             
42:             // التحقق من الإعدادات العامة وتطبيقها
43:             await activityService.checkAndApplyGlobalDisable();
44:             
45:             console.log('✅ تم التحقق من التعطيل التلقائي');
46:             
47:         } catch (error) {
48:             console.error('❌ خطأ في مجدول التعطيل التلقائي:', error);
49:         }
50:     }
51: 
52:     // التحقق من حالة المجدول
53:     getStatus() {
54:         return {
55:             isRunning: this.isRunning,
56:             nextCheck: this.intervalId ? 'نشط' : 'متوقف'
57:         };
58:     }
59: 
60:     // تشغيل يدوي للمدير
61:     async manualCheck() {
62:         console.log('🔧 تشغيل يدوي للتحقق من التعطيل...');
63:         await this.checkGlobalDisableStatus();
64:     }
65: }
66: 
67: export const autoDisableScheduler = new AutoDisableScheduler();

======= services\cloudinaryService.ts =======
1: export class CloudinaryService {
2:   private readonly cloudName = 'dc66alhhk';
3:   private readonly uploadPreset = 'kitra_66';
4:   private readonly folder = 'Smart_product_system_KTRA';
5: 
6:   /**
7:    * رفع ملف (صورة أو PDF) وإرجاع الرابط
8:    */
9:   async uploadFile(file: File): Promise<string> {
10:     const formData = new FormData();
11: 
12:     // تحديد نوع المورد والمجلد بناءً على نوع الملف
13:     let resourceType = 'auto'; // القيمة الافتراضية
14:     let subFolder = 'others';
15: 
16:     if (file.type.startsWith('image/')) {
17:       resourceType = 'image';
18:       subFolder = 'images';
19:     } else if (file.type === 'application/pdf') {
20:       // ✅ للملفات غير الصور، يفضل استخدام raw أو تحديدها بدقة لتجنب مشاكل الـ Unsigned
21:       resourceType = 'raw';
22:       subFolder = 'documents';
23:     }
24: 
25:     formData.append('file', file);
26:     formData.append('upload_preset', this.uploadPreset);
27:     // ملاحظة: الـ Unsigned upload قد يرفض تحديد المجلد (folder) إذا لم يكن مسموحاً به في إعدادات الـ Preset 
28:     // إذا استمر الخطأ، جرب تعطيل سطر الـ folder مؤقتاً للتأكد
29:     formData.append('folder', `${this.folder}/${subFolder}`);
30: 
31:     try {
32:       // ✅ نستخدم resourceType المتغير هنا (image أو raw أو auto)
33:       const response = await fetch(
34:         `https://api.cloudinary.com/v1_1/${this.cloudName}/${resourceType}/upload`,
35:         {
36:           method: 'POST',
37:           body: formData, // لا تضع Headers يدوية مثل Content-Type، المتصفح سيتكفل بها مع FormData
38:         }
39:       );
40: 
41:       if (!response.ok) {
42:         const errorData = await response.json();
43:         console.error("Cloudinary Detailed Error:", errorData);
44:         throw new Error(`فشل في الرفع: ${errorData.error?.message || response.status}`);
45:       }
46: 
47:       const data = await response.json();
48:       return data.secure_url || data.url;
49: 
50:     } catch (error) {
51:       console.error('خطأ في رفع الملف:', error);
52:       throw error;
53:     }
54:   }
55:   /**
56:    * دالة للإبقاء على التوافق مع الكود القديم إذا كان مستخدماً في أماكن أخرى
57:    * (يمكنك استخدام uploadFile مباشرة للكل)
58:    */
59:   async uploadImage(file: File): Promise<string> {
60:     return this.uploadFile(file);
61:   }
62: 
63:   /**
64:    * رفع عدة ملفات
65:    */
66:   async uploadMultipleFiles(files: File[]): Promise<string[]> {
67:     const uploadPromises = files.map(file => this.uploadFile(file));
68:     return Promise.all(uploadPromises);
69:   }
70: }
71: 
72: export const cloudinaryService = new CloudinaryService();

12: const convertToDealObject = (data: any): Deal => {
13:   return {
14:     ...data,
15:     createdAt: data.createdAt instanceof Timestamp ?
16:       data.createdAt.toDate().toISOString() :
17:       (typeof data.createdAt === 'string' ? data.createdAt : new Date().toISOString()),
18:     updatedAt: data.updatedAt instanceof Timestamp ?
19:       data.updatedAt.toDate().toISOString() :
20:       (typeof data.updatedAt === 'string' ? data.updatedAt : new Date().toISOString())
21:   };
22: };
23: 
24: // Helper function to recursively remove undefined values (Firestore rejects them)
25: const scrubObject = (obj: any): any => {
26:   if (Array.isArray(obj)) return obj.map(scrubObject);
27:   if (obj !== null && typeof obj === 'object' && !(obj instanceof Timestamp)) {
28:     // ⭐ استثناء serverTimestamp
29:     if (obj.type === 'serverTimestamp') {
30:       return serverTimestamp();
31:     }
32: 
33:     return Object.fromEntries(
34:       Object.entries(obj)
35:         .filter(([_, v]) => v !== undefined)
36:         .map(([k, v]) => [k, scrubObject(v)])
37:     );
38:   }
39:   return obj;
40: };

178:     return onSnapshot(q, (snapshot) => {

192:           paymentData: inst.paymentData ? {
193:             ...inst.paymentData,
194:             paymentDate: inst.paymentData.paymentDate instanceof Timestamp ?
195:               inst.paymentData.paymentDate.toDate().toISOString() :
196:               (typeof inst.paymentData.paymentDate === 'string' ? inst.paymentData.paymentDate : undefined)
197:           } : undefined
198:         })) || [];
199: 
200:         return {
201:           id: doc.id,
202:           ...data,
203:           // تحويل التواريخ
204:           createdAt: data.createdAt instanceof Timestamp ?
205:             data.createdAt.toDate().toISOString() : data.createdAt,
206:           updatedAt: data.updatedAt instanceof Timestamp ?
207:             data.updatedAt.toDate().toISOString() : data.updatedAt,

209:           statusHistory: data.statusHistory?.map((history: any) => ({

213:               (typeof history.timestamp === 'string' ? history.timestamp : new Date().toISOString())

215:           // تحويل التواريخ في payments

217:             ...payment,

276:         installments: updatedInstallments,
277:         installmentPlanEnabled: installmentPlanEnabled,
278:         updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),

280:       }));

283:         dealId,
284:         count: updatedInstallments.length,
285:         enabled: installmentPlanEnabled
286:       });
287: 
288:     } catch (error) {

338:   // إضافة دفعة جديدة
339:   async addPayment(
340:     dealId: string,
341:     payment: Omit<DealPayment, 'id'>,
342:     userId: string,
343:     userName: string,
344:     userRole: string
345:   ): Promise<string> {
346:     try {
347:       const dealRef = doc(db, 'deals', dealId);
348:       const deal = await this.getDeal(dealId);
349: 
350:       const paymentId = crypto.randomUUID();
351:       const cleanPayment = Object.fromEntries(
352:         Object.entries(payment).filter(([_, v]) => v !== undefined)
353:       );
354: 
355:       const newPayment: DealPayment = {
356:         ...cleanPayment,
357:         id: paymentId
358:       } as DealPayment;
359: 
360:       const updatedPayments = [...(deal.payments || []), newPayment];
361: 
362:       // حساب المبلغ المتبقي (فقط المدفوعات المؤكدة أو التي لها سليب)
363:       const totalPaid = updatedPayments.reduce((sum, p) => {
364:         if (p.bankSwiftImage || p.confirmedBySupplier) return sum + (p.amount || 0);
365:         return sum;
366:       }, 0);
367:       const remainingAmount = deal.totalAmount - totalPaid;
368: 
369:       // منطق تلقائي: عند إضافة دفعة، تنتقل الحالة إلى "بانتظار الدفعة الأولى" إذا كانت "أولي"
370:       let newStatus: DealStatus = deal.status;
371: 
372:       if (deal.status === 'initial') {
373:         newStatus = 'first_payment_pending';
374:       }
375: 
376:       // تسجيل النشاط
377:       await this.addActivity(dealId, {
378:         type: 'payment',
379:         action: 'إضافة دفعة',
380:         details: `تم إضافة ${payment.type === 'first' ? 'الدفعة الأولى' : 'الدفعة الثانية'} - ${payment.bankSwiftImage ? 'مع سليب' : 'مطالبة فقط'}`,
381:         userId,
382:         userName,
383:         userRole,
384:         metadata: { paymentId, amount: payment.amount, type: payment.type }
385:       });
386: 
387:       // ⭐ إعادة حساب حالة جميع الدفعات (Installments) بناءً على المدفوعات المحدثة
388:       const updatedInstallments = (deal.installments || []).map(inst => {
389:         // تجميع كل المدفوعات المرتبطة بهذه الدفعة
390:         const instPayments = updatedPayments.filter(p => p.installmentId === inst.id);
391: 
392:         // حساب مجموع المدفوع فقط إذا كان هناك سليب أو تأكيد
393:         const instTotalPaid = instPayments.reduce((sum, p) => {
394:           if (p.bankSwiftImage || p.confirmedBySupplier) return sum + (p.amount || 0);
395:           return sum;
396:         }, 0);
397: 
398:         let instStatus: 'unpaid' | 'partially_paid' | 'paid' | 'cancelled' = 'unpaid';
399:         if (inst.status === 'cancelled') {
400:           instStatus = 'cancelled';
401:         } else {
402:           if (instTotalPaid >= inst.amount * 0.99) instStatus = 'paid';
403:           else if (instTotalPaid > 0) instStatus = 'partially_paid';
404:         }
405: 
406:         // تحديث البيانات
407:         return {
408:           ...inst,
409:           status: instStatus,
410:           paymentData: {
411:             ...inst.paymentData,
412:             amountPaid: instTotalPaid,
413:             // نأخذ معرف آخر عملية دفع مرتبطة
414:             paymentId: instPayments.length > 0 ? instPayments[instPayments.length - 1].id : undefined,
415:             // نأخذ تاريخ آخر عملية دفع مرتبطة
416:             paymentDate: instPayments.length > 0 ? instPayments[instPayments.length - 1].paymentDate : undefined
417:           }
418:         };
419:       });
420: 
421:       const updateData: any = {
422:         payments: updatedPayments,
423:         installments: updatedInstallments, // ⭐ حفظ تحديثات الدفعات
424:         remainingAmount,
425:         status: newStatus,
426:         updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
427:         updatedBy: userId
428:       };
429: 
430:       await updateDoc(dealRef, scrubObject(updateData));
431: 
432:       return paymentId;
433:     } catch (error) {
434:       console.error('Error adding payment:', error);
435:       throw error;
436:     }
437:   },

439:   // تأكيد الدفعة من المورد
440:   async confirmPayment(
441:     dealId: string,
442:     paymentId: string,
443:     userId: string,
444:     userName: string,
445:     userRole: string,
446:     confirmationImage?: string,
447:     notes?: string,
448:     manualConfirmationDate?: string,
449:     cashBoxId?: string, // optional; prefer payment.cashBoxId if not provided
450:     expectedCurrency: string = 'USD'
451:   ): Promise<void> {
452:     try {
453:       const dealRef = doc(db, 'deals', dealId);
454: 
455:       await runTransaction(db, async (transaction) => {
456:         const dealDoc = await transaction.get(dealRef);
457:         if (!dealDoc.exists()) throw new Error('Deal not found');
458: 
459:         const dealData = dealDoc.data() as Deal;
460:         const payments = dealData.payments || [];
461:         const paymentIndex = payments.findIndex(p => p.id === paymentId);
462:         if (paymentIndex === -1) throw new Error('Payment not found in deal');
463: 
464:         const payment = payments[paymentIndex] as any;
465: 
466:         // 🔴 التعديل: التحقق إذا كان قد تم الخصم بالفعل عند رفع السليب
467:         if (payment.cashBoxWithdrawalAt) {
468:           console.log('الدفعة تم خصمها بالفعل عند رفع السليب، فقط تسجيل تأكيد المورد');
469:           // فقط نقوم بتأكيد المورد دون خصم إضافي
470:         } else if (payment.bankSwiftImage && !payment.cashBoxWithdrawalAt) {
471:           // إذا كان هناك سليب ولكن لم يتم الخصم بعد
472:           throw new Error('يجب خصم المبلغ من الصندوق أولاً عند رفع السليب قبل تأكيد المورد');
473:         }
474: 
475:         const confirmationDate = manualConfirmationDate || new Date().toISOString();
476: 
477:         // تحديث الدفعة
478:         const updatedPayment = {
479:           ...payment,
480:           confirmedBySupplier: true,
481:           confirmedAt: confirmationDate,
482:           paymentConfirmationDate: confirmationDate,
483:           confirmedBy: userId,
484:           supplierConfirmationImage: confirmationImage,
485:           supplierNotes: notes
486:         };
487: 
488:         const newPayments = [...payments];
489:         newPayments[paymentIndex] = updatedPayment;
490: 
491:         // Log activity
492:         const now = new Date().toISOString();
493:         const activityRef = doc(collection(db, 'deals', dealId, 'activities'));
494:         const activity = {
495:           id: activityRef.id,
496:           type: 'payment_confirmed_by_supplier',
497:           action: 'تأكيد الدفعة من المورد',
498:           details: `تم تأكيد الدفعة ${paymentId.substring(0, 8)} من المورد${notes ? `: ${notes}` : ''}`,
499:           userId,
500:           userName,
501:           userRole,
502:           timestamp: now,
503:           metadata: { paymentId }
504:         };
505: 
506:         // ⭐ تحديث حالة الدفعة (Installment) إلى مدفوعة عند التأكيد
507:         let updatedInstallments = dealData.installments || [];
508:         if (payment.installmentId) {
509:           updatedInstallments = updatedInstallments.map(inst => {
510:             if (inst.id === payment.installmentId) {
511:               // التحقق من أن المبلغ يغطي الدفعة
512:               const totalPaid = (inst.paymentData?.amountPaid || 0);
513:               // إذا كان المبلغ المدفوع يغطي 99% من الدفعة نعتبرها مدفوعة (لتجاوز فروقات العملة)
514:               const isFullyPaid = totalPaid >= (inst.amount * 0.99);
515:               return {
516:                 ...inst,
517:                 status: isFullyPaid ? 'paid' : 'partially_paid',
518:                 paymentData: {
519:                   ...inst.paymentData,
520:                   paymentConfirmationDate: confirmationDate
521:                 }
522:               };
523:             }
524:             return inst;
525:           });
526:         }
527: 
528:         // Update deal doc
529:         transaction.update(dealRef, {
530:           payments: newPayments,
531:           installments: updatedInstallments, // ⭐ حفظ تحديثات الدفعات
532:           updatedAt: now,
533:           updatedBy: userId
534:         });
535: 
536:         // Add activity subdoc
537:         transaction.set(activityRef, activity);
538:       });
539:     } catch (error) {
540:       console.error('Error confirming payment:', error);
541:       throw error;
542:     }
543:   },

545:   // إنشاء صفقة جديدة مع السجلات
546:   // في dealsService.ts - تحديث دالة createDeal
547: 
548:   async createDeal(
549:     dealData: Record<string, any>,
550:     userId: string,
551:     userName: string,
552:     userRole: string
553:   ): Promise<string> {
554:     try {
555:       const dealNumber = await this.getNextDealNumber();
556:       const now = new Date().toISOString();
557: 
558:       // ⭐ تحضير الدفعات بشكل صحيح
559:       let processedInstallments = [];
560:       if (dealData.installmentPlanEnabled && dealData.installments && dealData.installments.length > 0) {
561:         const totalPercentage = dealData.installments.reduce(
562:           (sum: number, inst: any) => sum + (inst.percentage || 0),
563:           0
564:         );
565: 
566:         if (Math.abs(totalPercentage - 100) > 0.01) {
567:           throw new Error('مجموع نسب الدفعات يجب أن يكون 100%');
568:         }
569: 
570:         const grandTotal = dealData.totalAmount || 0;
571: 
572:         // ⭐ تحويل الدفعات بشكل صحيح
573:         processedInstallments = dealData.installments.map((installment: any) => {
574:           const amount = Math.round(((installment.percentage || 0) / 100) * grandTotal * 100) / 100;
575: 
576:           return {
577:             ...installment,
578:             id: installment.id || crypto.randomUUID(),
579:             amount: amount,
580:             status: 'unpaid',
581:             // ⭐ إضافة timestamps
582:             createdAt: serverTimestamp(),
583:             updatedAt: serverTimestamp()
584:           };
585:         });
586:       }
587: 
588:       const requiredData = {
589:         dealNumber,
590:         status: 'initial' as DealStatus,
591:         // ⭐ استخدام processedInstallments بدلاً من dealData.installments
592:         installments: processedInstallments,
593:         installmentPlanEnabled: dealData.installmentPlanEnabled || false,
594:         payments: [],
595:         statusHistory: [{
596:           status: 'initial',
597:           timestamp: now,
598:           notes: 'تم إنشاء الصفقة',
599:           changedBy: userId
600:         }],
601:         activityLog: [],
602:         createdBy: userId,
603:         createdAt: serverTimestamp(),
604:         updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
605:         updatedBy: userId
606:       };
607: 
608:       const { dealNumber: _, ...cleanDealData } = dealData;
609: 
610:       const newDeal = {
611:         ...cleanDealData,
612:         ...requiredData
613:       };
614: 
615:       const docRef = await addDoc(collection(db, 'deals'), scrubObject(newDeal));
616: 
617:       // تسجيل النشاط
618:       await this.addActivity(docRef.id, {
619:         type: 'status_change',
620:         action: 'إنشاء صفقة',
621:         details: `تم إنشاء الصفقة ${dealNumber} ${dealData.installmentPlanEnabled ? `مع ${processedInstallments.length} دفعة` : ''}`,
622:         userId,
623:         userName,
624:         userRole,
625:         metadata: {
626:           dealNumber,
627:           hasInstallmentPlan: dealData.installmentPlanEnabled,
628:           installmentCount: processedInstallments.length
629:         }
630:       });
631: 
632:       return docRef.id;
633:     } catch (error) {
634:       console.error('Error creating deal:', error);
635:       throw error;
636:     }
637:   },

639:   // إضافة دالة لربط الدفعات بالمدفوعات
640:   async linkPaymentToInstallment(
641:     dealId: string,
642:     paymentId: string,
643:     installmentId: string,
644:     amountPaid: number,
645:     userId: string,
646:     userName: string,
647:     userRole: string
648:   ): Promise<void> {
649:     try {
650:       const dealRef = doc(db, 'deals', dealId);
651:       const deal = await this.getDeal(dealId);
652: 
653:       // العثور على الدفعة والمدفوعة
654:       const installmentIndex = deal.installments?.findIndex(inst => inst.id === installmentId);
655:       if (installmentIndex === -1) throw new Error('الدفعة غير موجودة');
656: 
657:       const paymentIndex = deal.payments?.findIndex(p => p.id === paymentId);
658:       if (paymentIndex === -1) throw new Error('المدفوعة غير موجودة');
659: 
660:       const installment = deal.installments![installmentIndex];
661:       const payment = deal.payments![paymentIndex];
662: 
663:       // تحديث حالة الدفعة
664:       const updatedInstallments = [...(deal.installments || [])];
665:       const totalPaidForInstallment = (installment.paymentData?.amountPaid || 0) + amountPaid;
666: 
667:       let newStatus: 'unpaid' | 'partially_paid' | 'paid' = 'unpaid';
668:       if (totalPaidForInstallment >= installment.amount) {
669:         newStatus = 'paid';
670:       } else if (totalPaidForInstallment > 0) {
671:         newStatus = 'partially_paid';
672:       }
673: 
674:       updatedInstallments[installmentIndex] = {
675:         ...installment,
676:         status: newStatus,
677:         paymentData: {
678:           ...installment.paymentData,
679:           paymentId,
680:           amountPaid: totalPaidForInstallment,
681:           paymentDate: payment.paymentDate
682:         }
683:       };
684: 
685:       // تسجيل النشاط
686:       await this.addActivity(dealId, {
687:         type: 'payment',
688:         action: 'ربط دفعة',
689:         details: `تم ربط دفعة ${installment.installmentNumber} بمبلغ ${amountPaid}$`,
690:         userId,
691:         userName,
692:         userRole,
693:         metadata: {
694:           installmentId,
695:           paymentId,
696:           amountPaid,
697:           installmentNumber: installment.installmentNumber
698:         }
699:       });
700: 
701:       // تحديث الصفقة
702:       await updateDoc(dealRef, scrubObject({
703:         installments: updatedInstallments,
704:         updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
705:         updatedBy: userId
706:       }));
707: 
708:     } catch (error) {
709:       console.error('Error linking payment to installment:', error);
710:       throw error;
711:     }
712:   },
713:   // تحديث الصفقة مع تسجيل النشاط
714:   async updateDeal(
715:     dealId: string,
716:     updates: Partial<Deal>,
717:     userId: string,
718:     userName: string,
719:     userRole: string,
720:     action: string,
721:     details?: string
722:   ): Promise<void> {
723:     try {
724:       const dealRef = doc(db, 'deals', dealId);
725: 
726:       // ⭐ معالجة تحديثات الدفعات بشكل خاص
727:       let processedUpdates = { ...updates };
728: 
729:       // إذا كان هناك تحديث للدفعات، أضف timestamps
730:       if (updates.installments && updates.installments.length > 0) {
731:         processedUpdates.installments = updates.installments.map(inst => ({
732:           ...inst,
733:           updatedAt: serverTimestamp() as unknown as string,
734:           // إذا كانت دفعة جديدة، أضف createdAt
735:           createdAt: inst.createdAt || (serverTimestamp() as unknown as string)
736:         }));
737:       }
738: 
739:       // إزالة الحقول التي لا نريد تحديثها
740:       const { id, createdAt, ...updateFields } = processedUpdates;
741: 
742:       const updateData = {
743:         ...updateFields,
744:         updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
745:         updatedBy: userId
746:       };
747: 
748:       // ⭐ تسجيل النشاط مع تفاصيل الدفعات
749:       if (action) {
750:         const cleanUpdates = Object.fromEntries(
751:           Object.entries(updateFields).filter(([_, v]) => v !== undefined)
752:         );
753: 
754:         // ⭐ تحديد إذا كان هناك تغيير في الدفعات
755:         const hasInstallmentChanges = updates.installments !== undefined;
756:         const installmentDetails = hasInstallmentChanges ?
757:           `تم تحديث جدول الدفعات (${updates.installments?.length || 0} دفعة)` :
758:           '';
759: 
760:         await this.addActivity(dealId, {
761:           type: 'item_update',
762:           action,
763:           details: details ? `${details} ${installmentDetails}` : installmentDetails,
764:           userId,
765:           userName,
766:           userRole,
767:           metadata: {
768:             updates: cleanUpdates,
769:             installmentCount: updates.installments?.length || 0
770:           }
771:         });
772:       }
773: 
774:       await updateDoc(dealRef, scrubObject(updateData));
775: 
776:       // ⭐ سجل التحقق بعد التحديث
777:       console.log('✅ تم تحديث الصفقة:', {
778:         dealId,
779:         hasInstallments: updates.installments?.length || 0,
780:         installmentPlanEnabled: updates.installmentPlanEnabled
781:       });
782: 
783:     } catch (error) {
784:       console.error('Error updating deal:', error);
785:       throw error;
786:     }
787:   },

790:   // الحصول على الصفقة
791:   async getDeal(dealId: string): Promise<Deal> {
792:     try {
793:       const dealDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'deals', dealId));
794:       if (!dealDoc.exists()) {
795:         throw new Error('Deal not found');
796:       }
797: 
798:       const data = dealDoc.data();
799: 
800:       // ⭐ تحديث: تحويل التواريخ في installments إذا كانت موجودة
801:       const installments = data.installments?.map((inst: any) => ({
802:         ...inst,
803:         // تحويل التواريخ في installment
804:         createdAt: inst.createdAt instanceof Timestamp ?
805:           inst.createdAt.toDate().toISOString() :
806:           (typeof inst.createdAt === 'string' ? inst.createdAt : new Date().toISOString()),
807:         updatedAt: inst.updatedAt instanceof Timestamp ?
808:           inst.updatedAt.toDate().toISOString() :
809:           (typeof inst.updatedAt === 'string' ? inst.updatedAt : new Date().toISOString()),
810:         // تحويل التواريخ في paymentData
811:         paymentData: inst.paymentData ? {
812:           ...inst.paymentData,
813:           paymentDate: inst.paymentData.paymentDate instanceof Timestamp ?
814:             inst.paymentData.paymentDate.toDate().toISOString() :
815:             (typeof inst.paymentData.paymentDate === 'string' ? inst.paymentData.paymentDate : undefined),
816:           paymentConfirmationDate: inst.paymentData.paymentConfirmationDate instanceof Timestamp ?
817:             inst.paymentData.paymentConfirmationDate.toDate().toISOString() :
818:             (typeof inst.paymentData.paymentConfirmationDate === 'string' ? inst.paymentData.paymentConfirmationDate : undefined)
819:         } : undefined
820:       })) || [];
821: 
822:       return {
823:         id: dealDoc.id,
824:         ...data,
825:         // تحويل التواريخ من Timestamp إلى string
826:         createdAt: data.createdAt instanceof Timestamp ?
827:           data.createdAt.toDate().toISOString() :
828:           (typeof data.createdAt === 'string' ? data.createdAt : new Date().toISOString()),
829:         updatedAt: data.updatedAt instanceof Timestamp ?
830:           data.updatedAt.toDate().toISOString() :
831:           (typeof data.updatedAt === 'string' ? data.updatedAt : new Date().toISOString()),
832:         // تحويل التواريخ في statusHistory إذا كانت Timestamp
833:         statusHistory: data.statusHistory?.map((history: any) => ({
834:           ...history,
835:           timestamp: history.timestamp instanceof Timestamp ?
836:             history.timestamp.toDate().toISOString() :
837:             (typeof history.timestamp === 'string' ? history.timestamp : new Date().toISOString())
838:         })) || [],
839:         // ⭐ إضافة installments المحولة
840:         installments: installments,
841:         // ⭐ ضمان قيمة installmentPlanEnabled
842:         installmentPlanEnabled: data.installmentPlanEnabled || false
843:       } as Deal;
844:     } catch (error) {
845:       console.error('Error getting deal:', error);
846:       throw error;
847:     }
848:   },
849: 
850:   // الحصول على سجل النشاطات
851:   async getDealActivities(dealId: string): Promise<DealActivity[]> {
852:     try {
853:       const activitiesRef = collection(db, 'deals', dealId, 'activities');
854:       const snapshot = await getDocs(query(activitiesRef, orderBy('timestamp', 'desc')));
855: 
856:       return snapshot.docs.map(doc => ({
857:         id: doc.id,
858:         ...doc.data(),
859:         timestamp: doc.data().timestamp instanceof Timestamp ?
860:           doc.data().timestamp.toDate().toISOString() :
861:           (typeof doc.data().timestamp === 'string' ? doc.data().timestamp : new Date().toISOString())
862:       } as DealActivity));
863:     } catch (error) {
864:       console.error('Error getting activities:', error);
865:       throw error;
866:     }
867:   },
868: 
869:   // الطريقة الأفضل - استخدام Counters collection
870:   async getNextDealNumber(): Promise<string> {
871:     try {
872:       // استخدم orderBy حسب dealNumber نفسه، وليس createdAt
873:       const q = query(
874:         collection(db, "deals"),
875:         orderBy("dealNumber", "desc"),
876:         limit(1)
877:       );
878: 
879:       const snapshot = await getDocs(q);
880: 
881:       if (snapshot.empty) return "D-0001";
882: 
883:       const lastDeal = snapshot.docs[0].data();
884:       const lastDealNumber = lastDeal.dealNumber;
885: 
886:       if (!lastDealNumber || !lastDealNumber.startsWith('D-')) {
887:         console.warn('آخر رقم صفقة غير صالح:', lastDealNumber);
888:         return "D-0001";
889:       }
890: 
891:       // استخراج الرقم من "D-0001"
892:       const numberPart = lastDealNumber.substring(2);
893:       const lastNumber = parseInt(numberPart, 10);
894: 
895:       if (isNaN(lastNumber)) {
896:         console.warn('تعذر تحويل الرقم:', numberPart);
897:         return "D-0001";
898:       }
899: 
900:       const nextNumber = lastNumber + 1;
901:       return `D-${nextNumber.toString().padStart(4, '0')}`;
902: 
903:     } catch (error) {
904:       console.error('خطأ في توليد رقم الصفقة:', error);
905:       const timestamp = Date.now().toString().slice(-6);
906:       return `D-${timestamp}`; // رقم احتياطي
907:     }
908:   },
909:   async updatePayment(
910:     dealId: string,
911:     paymentId: string,
912:     updates: Partial<DealPayment>,
913:     userId: string,
914:     userName: string,
915:     userRole: string
916:   ): Promise<void> {
917:     try {
918:       const dealRef = doc(db, 'deals', dealId);
919:       const deal = await this.getDeal(dealId);
920: 
921:       const cleanUpdates = Object.fromEntries(
922:         Object.entries(updates).filter(([_, v]) => v !== undefined)
923:       );
924: 
925:       const updatedPayments = (deal.payments || []).map(payment => {
926:         if (payment.id === paymentId) {
927:           return { ...payment, ...cleanUpdates };
928:         }
929:         return payment;
930:       });
931: 
932:       // Recalculate totals: Only count if confirmed OR has swift
933:       // This ensures "Payment is done after lifting the slip" logic
934:       const totalPaid = updatedPayments.reduce((sum, p) => {
935:         if (p.bankSwiftImage || p.confirmedBySupplier) return sum + (p.amount || 0);
936:         return sum;
937:       }, 0);
938: 
939:       const remainingAmount = deal.totalAmount - totalPaid;
940: 
941:       // التحديث التلقائي عند التواجد في الحالة الأولية
942:       let newStatus: DealStatus = deal.status;
943:       if (deal.status === 'initial') {
944:         newStatus = 'first_payment_pending';
945:       }
946: 
947:       // Log activity
948:       await this.addActivity(dealId, {
949:         type: 'payment',
950:         action: 'تحديث دفعة',
951:         details: 'تم تحديث بيانات الدفعة',
952:         userId,
953:         userName,
954:         userRole,
955:         metadata: { paymentId, updates: cleanUpdates }
956:       });
957: 
958:       // ⭐ إعادة حساب حالة جميع الدفعات (Installments) بناءً على المدفوعات المحدثة
959:       const updatedInstallments = (deal.installments || []).map(inst => {
960:         // تجميع كل المدفوعات المرتبطة بهذه الدفعة من القائمة المحدثة
961:         const instPayments = updatedPayments.filter(p => p.installmentId === inst.id);
962: 
963:         // حساب مجموع المدفوع فقط إذا كان هناك سليب أو تأكيد
964:         const instTotalPaid = instPayments.reduce((sum, p) => {
965:           if (p.bankSwiftImage || p.confirmedBySupplier) return sum + (p.amount || 0);
966:           return sum;
967:         }, 0);
968: 
969:         let instStatus: 'unpaid' | 'partially_paid' | 'paid' | 'cancelled' = 'unpaid';
970:         if (inst.status === 'cancelled') {
971:           instStatus = 'cancelled';
972:         } else {
973:           if (instTotalPaid >= inst.amount * 0.99) instStatus = 'paid';
974:           else if (instTotalPaid > 0) instStatus = 'partially_paid';
975:         }
976: 
977:         // تحديث البيانات
978:         return {
979:           ...inst,
980:           status: instStatus,
981:           paymentData: {
982:             ...inst.paymentData,
983:             amountPaid: instTotalPaid,
984:             // نأخذ معرف آخر عملية دفع مرتبطة
985:             paymentId: instPayments.length > 0 ? instPayments[instPayments.length - 1].id : undefined,
986:             // نأخذ تاريخ آخر عملية دفع مرتبطة
987:             paymentDate: instPayments.length > 0 ? instPayments[instPayments.length - 1].paymentDate : undefined
988:           }
989:         };
990:       });
991: 
992:       const updateData: any = {
993:         payments: updatedPayments,
994:         installments: updatedInstallments, // ⭐ حفظ تحديثات الدفعات
995:         remainingAmount,
996:         status: newStatus,
997:         updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
998:         updatedBy: userId
999:       };
1000: 
1001:       await updateDoc(dealRef, scrubObject(updateData));
1002:     } catch (error) {
1003:       console.error('Error updating payment:', error);
1004:       throw error;
1005:     }
1006:   },
1007: 
1008:   async updatePaymentWithSwift(
1009:     dealId: string,
1010:     paymentId: string,
1011:     updates: Partial<DealPayment>,
1012:     userId: string,
1013:     userName: string,
1014:     userRole: string,
1015:     cashBoxId: string
1016:   ): Promise<void> {
1017:     try {
1018:       const dealRef = doc(db, 'deals', dealId);
1019: 
1020:       // التحقق من وجود صندوق مالي
1021:       if (!cashBoxId) {
1022:         throw new Error('يجب اختيار صندوق مالي');
1023:       }
1024: 
1025:       // التحقق من وجود سليب (Swift)
1026:       if (!updates.bankSwiftImage) {
1027:         throw new Error('يجب رفع صورة السليب');
1028:       }
1029: 
1030:       // التحقق من الرصيد في الصندوق (نستخدم transaction)
1031:       await runTransaction(db, async (transaction) => {
1032:         // 1. الحصول على الصفقة والدفعة
1033:         const dealDoc = await transaction.get(dealRef);
1034:         if (!dealDoc.exists()) {
1035:           throw new Error('الصفقة غير موجودة');
1036:         }
1037: 
1038:         const dealData = dealDoc.data() as Deal;
1039:         const payments = dealData.payments || [];
1040:         const paymentIndex = payments.findIndex(p => p.id === paymentId);
1041:         if (paymentIndex === -1) {
1042:           throw new Error('الدفعة غير موجودة');
1043:         }
1044: 
1045:         const payment = payments[paymentIndex];
1046: 
1047:         // 2. التحقق إذا تم الخصم بالفعل
1048:         if (payment.cashBoxWithdrawalAt) {
1049:           throw new Error('تم خصم هذه الدفعة بالفعل من الصندوق');
1050:         }
1051: 
1052:         // 3. الحصول على الصندوق المالي
1053:         const cashBoxRef = doc(db, 'cashBoxes', cashBoxId);
1054:         const cashBoxDoc = await transaction.get(cashBoxRef);
1055:         if (!cashBoxDoc.exists()) {
1056:           throw new Error('الصندوق المالي غير موجود');
1057:         }
1058: 
1059:         const cashBox = cashBoxDoc.data() as any;
1060: 
1061:         // 4. حساب المبلغ الكلي (الدفعة + تكلفة الحوالة)
1062:         const paymentAmount = updates.amount || payment.amount || 0;
1063:         const transferCost = updates.transferCost || payment.transferCost || 0;
1064:         const totalToWithdraw = paymentAmount + transferCost;
1065: 
1066:         if (cashBox.currentBalance < totalToWithdraw) {
1067:           throw new Error(`الرصيد غير كافي في ${cashBox.name}! الرصيد المتاح: ${cashBox.currentBalance} ${cashBox.currency}، المطلوب: ${totalToWithdraw} ${cashBox.currency}`);
1068:         }
1069: 
1070:         // 5. تحديث رصيد الصندوق
1071:         const newBalance = cashBox.currentBalance - totalToWithdraw;
1072:         const now = new Date().toISOString();
1073: 
1074:         // 6. إنشاء حركة سحب في الصندوق
1075:         const transactionsCol = collection(db, 'cashBoxTransactions');
1076: 
1077:         // حركة الدفع الرئيسية
1078:         const paymentTransactionRef = doc(transactionsCol);
1079:         const paymentTransaction = {
1080:           id: paymentTransactionRef.id,
1081:           cashBoxId: cashBoxId,
1082:           type: 'withdrawal',
1083:           amount: paymentAmount,
1084:           currency: cashBox.currency,
1085:           description: `دفع صفقة ${dealData.dealNumber || dealId}`,
1086:           reference: `DEAL-${dealData.dealNumber || dealId}-PAYMENT-${paymentId}`,
1087:           date: now,
1088:           createdBy: userName,
1089:           userId: userId,
1090:           createdAt: now,
1091:           balanceAfter: cashBox.currentBalance - paymentAmount,
1092:           relatedDealId: dealId,
1093:           relatedPaymentId: paymentId,
1094:           dealNumber: dealData.dealNumber,
1095:           paymentDate: updates.paymentDate || new Date().toISOString(),
1096:           usdToIls: updates.usdToIls
1097:         };
1098: 
1099:         transaction.set(paymentTransactionRef, scrubObject(paymentTransaction));
1100: 
1101:         // حركة تكلفة الحوالة (إذا كانت موجودة)
1102:         let transferTransactionId = null;
1103:         let transferTransactionRef: any = null;
1104:         if (transferCost > 0) {
1105:           transferTransactionRef = doc(transactionsCol);
1106:           transferTransactionId = transferTransactionRef.id;
1107:           const transferTransaction = {
1108:             id: transferTransactionId,
1109:             cashBoxId: cashBoxId,
1110:             type: 'withdrawal',
1111:             amount: transferCost,
1112:             currency: cashBox.currency,
1113:             description: `تكلفة حوالة صفقة ${dealData.dealNumber || dealId}`,
1114:             reference: `DEAL-${dealData.dealNumber || dealId}-PAYMENT-${paymentId}-TRANSFER`,
1115:             date: now,
1116:             createdBy: userName,
1117:             userId: userId,
1118:             createdAt: now,
1119:             balanceAfter: newBalance,
1120:             relatedDealId: dealId,
1121:             relatedPaymentId: paymentId,
1122:             dealNumber: dealData.dealNumber
1123:           };
1124:           transaction.set(transferTransactionRef, scrubObject(transferTransaction));
1125:         }
1126: 
1127:         // 7. تحديث رصيد الصندوق
1128:         transaction.update(cashBoxRef, scrubObject({
1129:           currentBalance: newBalance,
1130:           updatedAt: now,
1131:           lastTransactionId: paymentTransactionRef.id,
1132:           lastTransactionDate: now
1133:         }));
1134: 
1135:         // 8. تحديث بيانات الدفعة مع إزالة القيم undefined
1136:         const updatedPaymentData: any = {
1137:           ...scrubObject(updates),
1138:           cashBoxId: cashBoxId,
1139:           cashBoxName: cashBox.name,
1140:           cashBoxWithdrawalAt: now,
1141:           cashBoxWithdrawalBy: userName,
1142:           cashBoxTransactionIds: [
1143:             paymentTransactionRef.id,
1144:             ...(transferTransactionId ? [transferTransactionId] : [])
1145:           ],
1146:           _cashBoxSettled: true,
1147:           dealNumber: dealData.dealNumber
1148:         };
1149: 
1150:         // دمج مع البيانات الحالية
1151:         const updatedPayment = {
1152:           ...payment,
1153:           ...updatedPaymentData
1154:         };
1155: 
1156:         // إزالة أي قيم undefined نهائياً
1157:         const cleanUpdatedPayment = scrubObject(updatedPayment);
1158: 
1159:         const newPayments = [...payments];
1160:         newPayments[paymentIndex] = cleanUpdatedPayment;
1161: 
1162:         // 9. إعادة حساب المبالغ
1163:         const totalPaid = newPayments.reduce((sum: number, p: any) => {
1164:           if (p.bankSwiftImage) return sum + (p.amount || 0);
1165:           return sum;
1166:         }, 0);
1167: 
1168:         const remainingAmount = (dealData.totalAmount || 0) - totalPaid;
1169: 
1170:         // ⭐ تحديث حالة جميع الدفعات (Installments) بناءً على المدفوعات المحدثة
1171:         let updatedInstallments = dealData.installments || [];
1172:         updatedInstallments = updatedInstallments.map(inst => {
1173:           // تجميع كل المدفوعات المرتبطة بهذه الدفعة
1174:           const instPayments = newPayments.filter(p => p.installmentId === inst.id);
1175: 
1176:           // حساب مجموع المدفوع فقط إذا كان هناك سليب أو تأكيد
1177:           const instTotalPaid = instPayments.reduce((sum, p) => {
1178:             if (p.bankSwiftImage || p.confirmedBySupplier) return sum + (p.amount || 0);
1179:             return sum;
1180:           }, 0);
1181: 
1182:           let instStatus: 'unpaid' | 'partially_paid' | 'paid' | 'cancelled' = 'unpaid';
1183:           if (inst.status === 'cancelled') {
1184:             instStatus = 'cancelled';
1185:           } else {
1186:             if (instTotalPaid >= inst.amount * 0.99) instStatus = 'paid';
1187:             else if (instTotalPaid > 0) instStatus = 'partially_paid';
1188:           }
1189: 
1190:           return {
1191:             ...inst,
1192:             status: instStatus,
1193:             paymentData: {
1194:               ...inst.paymentData,
1195:               amountPaid: instTotalPaid,
1196:               paymentId: instPayments.length > 0 ? instPayments[instPayments.length - 1].id : undefined,
1197:               paymentDate: instPayments.length > 0 ? instPayments[instPayments.length - 1].paymentDate : undefined
1198:             }
1199:           };
1200:         });
1201: 
1202:         // 10. تسجيل النشاط
1203:         const activityRef = doc(collection(db, 'deals', dealId, 'activities'));
1204:         const activity = {
1205:           id: activityRef.id,
1206:           type: 'payment_swift_uploaded',
1207:           action: 'رفع سليب البنك وخصم من الصندوق',
1208:           details: `تم رفع سليب البنك للدفعة ${paymentId.substring(0, 8)} وخصم ${totalToWithdraw} ${cashBox.currency} من الصندوق: ${cashBox.name}`,
1209:           userId,
1210:           userName,
1211:           userRole,
1212:           timestamp: now,
1213:           metadata: scrubObject({
1214:             paymentId,
1215:             amount: paymentAmount,
1216:             transferCost: transferCost,
1217:             totalWithdrawn: totalToWithdraw,
1218:             cashBoxId: cashBoxId,
1219:             cashBoxName: cashBox.name,
1220:             cashBoxBalanceBefore: cashBox.currentBalance,
1221:             cashBoxBalanceAfter: newBalance
1222:           })
1223:         };
1224: 
1225:         transaction.set(activityRef, scrubObject(activity));
1226: 
1227:         // 11. تحديث الصفقة مع إزالة القيم undefined
1228:         transaction.update(dealRef, scrubObject({
1229:           payments: newPayments,
1230:           installments: updatedInstallments, // ⭐ حفظ تحديثات الدفعات
1231:           remainingAmount: remainingAmount,
1232:           updatedAt: now,
1233:           updatedBy: userId
1234:         }));
1235:       });
1236: 
1237:     } catch (error) {
1238:       console.error('Error updating payment with swift:', error);
1239:       throw error;
1240:     }
1241:   },
1242: 
1243:   async cancelPayment(
1244:     dealId: string,
1245:     paymentId: string,
1246:     userId: string,
1247:     userName: string,
1248:     userRole: string
1249:   ): Promise<void> {
1250:     try {
1251:       const dealRef = doc(db, 'deals', dealId);
1252:       const dealSnap = await getDoc(dealRef);
1253: 
1254:       if (!dealSnap.exists()) {
1255:         throw new Error('الصفقة غير موجودة');
1256:       }
1257: 
1258:       const deal = dealSnap.data() as Deal;
1259:       const updatedPayments = deal.payments?.filter(p => p.id !== paymentId) || [];
1260: 
1261:       // Update deal
1262:       await updateDoc(dealRef, scrubObject({
1263:         payments: updatedPayments,
1264:         updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
1265:         updatedBy: userId
1266:       }));
1267: 
1268:       // Add activity log
1269:       await this.addActivity(dealId, {
1270:         type: 'payment',
1271:         action: 'payment_cancelled',
1272:         details: `تم إلغاء الدفعة ${paymentId.substring(0, 8)}`,
1273:         userId,
1274:         userName,
1275:         userRole,
1276:         timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
1277:       });
1278: 
1279:     } catch (error) {
1280:       console.error('Error cancelling payment:', error);
1281:       throw error;
1282:     }
1283:   },
1284: 
1285:   async deleteDeal(dealId: string): Promise<void> {
1286:     try {
1287:       const dealRef = doc(db, 'deals', dealId);
1288:       await deleteDoc(dealRef);
1289:     } catch (error) {
1290:       console.error('Error deleting deal:', error);
1291:       throw error;
1292:     }
1293:   }
