======= services\firebaseStorageService.ts =======
1: import { ref, uploadBytes, getDownloadURL } from 'firebase/storage';
2: import { storage } from '@/firebaseConfig';
3: 
4: export interface UploadedFile {
5:     name: string;
6:     url: string;
7:     size: number;
8:     type: string;
9: }
10: 
11: export const firebaseStorageService = {
12:     // رفع ملف إلى Firebase Storage
13:     async uploadFile(file: File, folder: string = 'invoice-pdfs'): Promise<UploadedFile> {
14:         try {
15:             // إنشاء اسم فريد للملف
16:             const timestamp = Date.now();
17:             const randomString = Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 15);
18:             const safeFileName = file.name.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]/g, '_');
19:             const fileName = `${timestamp}_${randomString}_${safeFileName}`;
20:             const filePath = `${folder}/${fileName}`;
21: 
22:             // إنشاء مرجع للملف
23:             const storageRef = ref(storage, filePath);
24: 
25:             // رفع الملف
26:             const snapshot = await uploadBytes(storageRef, file);
27: 
28:             // الحصول على رابط التحميل
29:             const downloadURL = await getDownloadURL(snapshot.ref);
30: 
31:             return {
32:                 name: file.name,
33:                 url: downloadURL,
34:                 size: file.size,
35:                 type: file.type
36:             };
37:         } catch (error) {
38:             console.error('Error uploading file to Firebase:', error);
39:             throw new Error('فشل رفع الملف إلى التخزين');
40:         }
41:     },
42: 
43:     // رفع ملف PDF
44:     async uploadPdfFile(file: File): Promise<UploadedFile> {
45:         if (file.type !== 'application/pdf') {
46:             throw new Error('يسمح فقط بملفات PDF');
47:         }
48: 
49:         return this.uploadFile(file, 'invoice-pdfs');
50:     }
51: };

81:       id,

83:       url,
84:       createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
85:     };

87:     return id;
88:   },

93:   },

110: // --- خدمة حالة النشاط ---
111: export const activityService = {
112:   // تهيئة حالة النشاط للمستخدم
113:   async initializeActivityStatus(userId: string): Promise<void> {
114:     const activityRef = doc(db, "activityStatus", userId);
115: 
116:     const activityData: ActivityStatus = {
117:       userId,
118:       lastCheckIn: new Date().toISOString(),
119:       activeMinutesToday: 0,
120:       checkinClickCount: 0,
121:       isCurrentlyActive: true,
122:       checkInButtonEnabled: true,
123:       lastActivityCheck: new Date().toISOString()
124:     };
125: 
126:     await setDoc(activityRef, activityData);
127:   },
128: 
129:   // تسجيل ضغطة زر التأكيد
130:   async recordCheckIn(userId: string): Promise<{ success: boolean; points: number }> {
131:     const activityRef = doc(db, "activityStatus", userId);
132:     const activitySnap = await getDoc(activityRef);
133: 
134:     if (!activitySnap.exists()) {
135:       await this.initializeActivityStatus(userId);
136:     }
137: 
138:     const activityData = activitySnap.data() as ActivityStatus;
139: 
140:     // التحقق من أن الزر مفعل
141:     if (!activityData.checkInButtonEnabled) {
142:       throw new Error("نظام النقاط معطل لحسابك");
143:     }
144: 
145:     const now = new Date();
146:     const lastCheckIn = new Date(activityData.lastCheckIn);
147:     const timeDiff = now.getTime() - lastCheckIn.getTime();
148:     const minutesDiff = timeDiff / (1000 * 60);
149: 
150:     // منع الضغط المتكرر خلال أقل من دقيقة
151:     if (minutesDiff < 1) {
152:       return { success: false, points: 0 };
153:     }
154: 
155:     // تحديث البيانات
156:     const updates: Partial<ActivityStatus> = {
157:       lastCheckIn: now.toISOString(),
158:       checkinClickCount: activityData.checkinClickCount + 1,
159:       isCurrentlyActive: true,
160:       lastActivityCheck: now.toISOString()
161:     };
162: 
163:     await updateDoc(activityRef, updates);
164: 
165:     // تحديث النقاط اليومية
166:     const pointsEarned = DEFAULT_POINTS_SYSTEM.activityPointsPerClick;
167:     await this.updateDailyPoints(userId, pointsEarned, 0);
168: 
169:     return { success: true, points: pointsEarned };
170:   },
171: 
172:   // التحقق من النشاط التلقائي
173:   async checkActivityStatus(userId: string): Promise<void> {
174:     const activityRef = doc(db, "activityStatus", userId);
175:     const activitySnap = await getDoc(activityRef);
176: 
177:     if (!activitySnap.exists()) return;
178: 
179:     const activityData = activitySnap.data() as ActivityStatus;
180:     const now = new Date();
181:     const lastCheckIn = new Date(activityData.lastCheckIn);
182:     const timeDiff = now.getTime() - lastCheckIn.getTime();
183:     const minutesDiff = timeDiff / (1000 * 60);
184: 
185:     if (minutesDiff > 10 && activityData.isCurrentlyActive) {
186:       // إيقاف النشاط بعد 10 دقائق بدون ضغط
187:       await updateDoc(activityRef, {
188:         isCurrentlyActive: false,
189:         lastActivityCheck: now.toISOString()
190:       });
191:     }
192:   },

194:   // تحديث النقاط اليومية (محدثة لدعم نقاط الحضور)
195:   async updateDailyPoints(userId: string, activityPoints: number, taskPoints: number, attendancePoints: number = 0): Promise<void> {
196:     const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
197:     const pointsRef = doc(db, "pointsHistory", userId, "days", today);
198: 
199:     const pointsSnap = await getDoc(pointsRef);
200:     const activityData = await this.getActivityStatus(userId);
201: 
202:     if (pointsSnap.exists()) {
203:       const currentPoints = pointsSnap.data() as DailyPoints;
204:       const newAttendancePoints = currentPoints.attendancePoints || 0;
205:       const totalPoints = currentPoints.totalPoints + activityPoints + taskPoints + attendancePoints;
206: 
207:       await updateDoc(pointsRef, {
208:         activityPoints: currentPoints.activityPoints + activityPoints,
209:         taskPoints: currentPoints.taskPoints + taskPoints,
210:         attendancePoints: newAttendancePoints + attendancePoints,
211:         totalPoints: totalPoints,
212:         checkinClicks: activityData?.checkinClickCount || 0,
213:         workMinutes: activityData?.activeMinutesToday || 0,
214:         attended: (currentPoints.attended || false) || (attendancePoints > 0) // تحديث حالة الحضور
215:       });
216:     } else {
217:       const newDailyPoints: DailyPoints = {
218:         date: today,
219:         userId,
220:         workMinutes: activityData?.activeMinutesToday || 0,
221:         activityPoints,
222:         taskPoints,
223:         attendancePoints: attendancePoints,
224:         totalPoints: activityPoints + taskPoints + attendancePoints,
225:         checkinClicks: activityData?.checkinClickCount || 0,
226:         completedTasks: 0,
227:         attended: attendancePoints > 0 // تعيين حالة الحضور
228:       };
229:       await setDoc(pointsRef, newDailyPoints);
230:     }
231:   },

234:   async addAttendancePoints(userId: string, date: string): Promise<void> {
235:     const attendancePoints = 10; // 10 نقاط للحضور
236:     await this.updateDailyPoints(userId, 0, 0, attendancePoints);

287:   // دالة للتحقق إذا كان الوقت الحالي ضمن نطاق التعطيل
288:   isTimeInRange: (currentTime: string, startTime: string, endTime: string): boolean => {
289:     const [currentHours, currentMinutes] = currentTime.split(':').map(Number);
290:     const [startHours, startMinutes] = startTime.split(':').map(Number);
291:     const [endHours, endMinutes] = endTime.split(':').map(Number);
292: 
293:     const currentTotal = currentHours * 60 + currentMinutes;
294:     const startTotal = startHours * 60 + startMinutes;
295:     const endTotal = endHours * 60 + endMinutes;
296: 
297:     return currentTotal >= startTotal && currentTotal <= endTotal;
298:   },

395:     const settingsRef = doc(db, "systemSettings", "globalDailyDisable");
396:

415:     } else {
416:       // إذا تم تعطيل الإعدادات العامة، تفعيل جميع الأزرار

418:     }

421:   // تطبيق الإعدادات العامة على جميع الموظفين
422:   // في activityService - أصلح هذه الدالة
423:   applyGlobalDisableToAllEmployees: async (): Promise<void> => {
424:     try {
425:       const globalSettings = await activityService.getGlobalDailyDisableSchedule();
426:       if (!globalSettings || !globalSettings.isEnabled) {
427:         console.log('⚠️ الإعدادات العامة غير مفعلة');
428:         return;
429:       }
430: 
431:       const now = new Date();
432:       const currentTime = now.getHours().toString().padStart(2, '0') + ':' + now.getMinutes().toString().padStart(2, '0');
433: 
434:       const isInDisabledRange = activityService.isTimeInRange(
435:         currentTime,
436:         globalSettings.startTime,
437:         globalSettings.endTime
438:       );
439: 
440:       console.log('⏰ تطبيق الإعدادات العامة:', {
441:         currentTime,
442:         startTime: globalSettings.startTime,
443:         endTime: globalSettings.endTime,
444:         isInDisabledRange,
445:         shouldDisable: isInDisabledRange
446:       });
447: 
448:       // جلب جميع المستخدمين
449:       const usersSnapshot = await getDocs(collection(db, "users"));
450:       const employees = usersSnapshot.docs
451:         .map(doc => doc.data() as User)
452:         .filter(user => user.role === 'employee');
453: 
454:       let updatedCount = 0;
455: 
456:       for (const employee of employees) {
457:         const activityRef = doc(db, "activityStatus", employee.id);
458:         const activitySnap = await getDoc(activityRef);
459: 
460:         if (activitySnap.exists()) {
461:           const activityData = activitySnap.data() as ActivityStatus;
462: 
463:           // إذا كان الموظف لا يستخدم إعدادات فردية، نطبق الإعدادات العامة
464:           const shouldUseGlobalSettings = !activityData.dailyDisableEnabled;
465: 
466:           if (shouldUseGlobalSettings) {
467:             // تحديث حالة زر التأكيد بناءً على الإعدادات العامة
468:             if (activityData.checkInButtonEnabled === isInDisabledRange) {
469:               await updateDoc(activityRef, {
470:                 checkInButtonEnabled: !isInDisabledRange,
471:                 useGlobalSettings: true,
472:                 lastActivityCheck: now.toISOString()
473:               });
474:               updatedCount++;
475:             }
476:           }
477:         } else {
478:           // إذا لم يكن هناك سجل نشاط، إنشائه مع الإعدادات العامة
479:           const newActivity: ActivityStatus = {
480:             userId: employee.id,
481:             lastCheckIn: now.toISOString(),
482:             activeMinutesToday: 0,
483:             checkinClickCount: 0,
484:             isCurrentlyActive: false,
485:             checkInButtonEnabled: !isInDisabledRange,
486:             lastActivityCheck: now.toISOString(),
487:             useGlobalSettings: true
488:           };
489:           await setDoc(activityRef, newActivity);
490:           updatedCount++;
491:         }
492:       }
493: 
494:       console.log(`✅ تم تحديث ${updatedCount} من ${employees.length} موظف`);
495:     } catch (error) {
496:       console.error('❌ خطأ في تطبيق الإعدادات العامة:', error);
497:     }
498:   },
499: 
500:   // تفعيل جميع أزرار التأكيد
501:   enableAllCheckInButtons: async (): Promise<void> => {
502:     try {
503:       const usersSnapshot = await getDocs(collection(db, "users"));
504:       const employees = usersSnapshot.docs
505:         .map(doc => doc.data() as User)
506:         .filter(user => user.role === 'employee');
507: 
508:       for (const employee of employees) {
509:         const activityRef = doc(db, "activityStatus", employee.id);
510:         const activitySnap = await getDoc(activityRef);
511: 
512:         if (activitySnap.exists()) {
513:           const activityData = activitySnap.data() as ActivityStatus;
514: 
515:           // إذا كان الموظف يستخدم الإعدادات العامة فقط، نفعّل الزر
516:           if (activityData.useGlobalSettings && !activityData.dailyDisableEnabled) {
517:             await updateDoc(activityRef, {
518:               checkInButtonEnabled: true,
519:               lastActivityCheck: new Date().toISOString()
520:             });
521:           }
522:         }
523:       }
524: 
525:       console.log(`تم تفعيل جميع الأزرار للموظفين الذين يستخدمون الإعدادات العامة`);
526:     } catch (error) {
527:       console.error('Error enabling all check-in buttons:', error);
528:     }
529:   },

552: // --- خدمة نقاط المهام ---
553: export const taskPointsService = {
554:   // حساب نقاط المهمة بناءً على الوقت
555:   async calculateTaskPoints(taskId: string, startTime: string, endTime: string): Promise<number> {
556:     const start = new Date(startTime);
557:     const end = new Date(endTime);
558:     const timeDiff = end.getTime() - start.getTime();
559:     const minutesDiff = timeDiff / (1000 * 60);
560: 
561:     if (minutesDiff <= 30) {
562:       return DEFAULT_POINTS_SYSTEM.taskPointsFast;
563:     } else {
564:       return DEFAULT_POINTS_SYSTEM.taskPointsNormal;
565:     }
566:   },
567: 
568:   // تسجيل نقاط المهمة (محدثة)
569:   async recordTaskPoints(userIds: string[], points: number): Promise<void> {
570:     // توزيع النقاط على جميع الموظفين المعينين
571:     const pointsPerUser = Math.floor(points / userIds.length);
572: 
573:     for (const userId of userIds) {
574:       await activityService.updateDailyPoints(userId, 0, pointsPerUser, 0);
575: 
576:       // تحديث عدد المهام المكتملة لكل موظف
577:       const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
578:       const pointsRef = doc(db, "pointsHistory", userId, "days", today);
579:       const pointsSnap = await getDoc(pointsRef);
580: 
581:       if (pointsSnap.exists()) {
582:         const currentPoints = pointsSnap.data() as DailyPoints;
583:         await updateDoc(pointsRef, {
584:           completedTasks: (currentPoints.completedTasks || 0) + 1
585:         });
586:       } else {
587:         // إذا لم يكن هناك سجل لهذا اليوم، إنشائه
588:         const newDailyPoints: DailyPoints = {
589:           date: today,
590:           userId,
591:           workMinutes: 0,
592:           activityPoints: 0,
593:           taskPoints: pointsPerUser,
594:           attendancePoints: 0,
595:           totalPoints: pointsPerUser,
596:           checkinClicks: 0,
597:           completedTasks: 1,
598:           attended: false
599:         };
600:         await setDoc(pointsRef, newDailyPoints);
601:       }
602:     }
603:   }
604: };

606: // --- خدمة سجل النقاط ---
607: export const pointsHistoryService = {
608:   // الحصول على سجل النقاط اليومي
609:   async getDailyPoints(userId: string, date: string): Promise<DailyPoints | null> {
610:     const pointsRef = doc(db, "pointsHistory", userId, "days", date);
611:     const pointsSnap = await getDoc(pointsRef);
612:     return pointsSnap.exists() ? pointsSnap.data() as DailyPoints : null;
613:   },
614: 
615:   // الحصول على تاريخ النقاط لفترة محددة
616:   async getPointsHistory(userId: string, startDate: string, endDate: string): Promise<DailyPoints[]> {
617:     const pointsCol = collection(db, "pointsHistory", userId, "days");
618:     const q = query(
619:       pointsCol,
620:       where("date", ">=", startDate),
621:       where("date", "<=", endDate)
622:     );
623: 
624:     const snapshot = await getDocs(q);
625:     return snapshot.docs.map(doc => doc.data() as DailyPoints);
626:   },
627: 
628:   // الاشتراك في تحديثات النقاط اليومية
629:   subscribeToDailyPoints(userId: string, callback: (points: DailyPoints | null) => void) {
630:     const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
631:     const pointsRef = doc(db, "pointsHistory", userId, "days", today);
632: 
633:     return onSnapshot(pointsRef, (snapshot) => {
634:       callback(snapshot.exists() ? snapshot.data() as DailyPoints : null);
635:     });
636:   },
637: 
638:   // إدارة النقاط يدوياً (للمدير) - محدثة لدعم نقاط الحضور
639:   async updatePointsManually(userId: string, date: string, updates: Partial<DailyPoints>): Promise<void> {
640:     const pointsRef = doc(db, "pointsHistory", userId, "days", date);
641:     const pointsSnap = await getDoc(pointsRef);
642: 
643:     if (pointsSnap.exists()) {
644:       const current = pointsSnap.data() as DailyPoints;
645: 
646:       // حساب الإجمالي مع مراعاة جميع أنواع النقاط
647:       const newActivityPoints = updates.activityPoints !== undefined ? updates.activityPoints : current.activityPoints;
648:       const newTaskPoints = updates.taskPoints !== undefined ? updates.taskPoints : current.taskPoints;
649:       const newAttendancePoints = updates.attendancePoints !== undefined ? updates.attendancePoints : current.attendancePoints;
650: 
651:       const updatedPoints = {
652:         ...current,
653:         ...updates,
654:         totalPoints: newActivityPoints + newTaskPoints + newAttendancePoints
655:       };
656: 
657:       await updateDoc(pointsRef, updatedPoints);
658:     } else {
659:       const newPoints: DailyPoints = {
660:         date,
661:         userId,
662:         workMinutes: updates.workMinutes || 0,
663:         activityPoints: updates.activityPoints || 0,
664:         taskPoints: updates.taskPoints || 0,
665:         attendancePoints: updates.attendancePoints || 0,
666:         totalPoints: (updates.activityPoints || 0) +
667:           (updates.taskPoints || 0) +
668:           (updates.attendancePoints || 0),
669:         checkinClicks: updates.checkinClicks || 0,
670:         completedTasks: updates.completedTasks || 0,
671:         attended: updates.attended || false
672:       };
673:       await setDoc(pointsRef, newPoints);
674:     }
675:   },
676: 
677:   // إضافة نقاط الحضور يدوياً (دالة جديدة)
678:   async addManualAttendancePoints(userId: string, date: string): Promise<void> {
679:     const pointsRef = doc(db, "pointsHistory", userId, "days", date);
680:     const pointsSnap = await getDoc(pointsRef);
681: 
682:     const attendancePoints = 10; // 10 نقاط للحضور
683: 
684:     if (pointsSnap.exists()) {
685:       const current = pointsSnap.data() as DailyPoints;
686:       await updateDoc(pointsRef, {
687:         attendancePoints: (current.attendancePoints || 0) + attendancePoints,
688:         totalPoints: (current.totalPoints || 0) + attendancePoints,
689:         attended: true
690:       });
691:     } else {
692:       const newPoints: DailyPoints = {
693:         date,
694:         userId,
695:         workMinutes: 0,
696:         activityPoints: 0,
697:         taskPoints: 0,
698:         attendancePoints: attendancePoints,
699:         totalPoints: attendancePoints,
700:         checkinClicks: 0,
701:         completedTasks: 0,
702:         attended: true
703:       };
704:       await setDoc(pointsRef, newPoints);
705:     }
706:   },
707: 
708:   // إزالة نقاط الحضور يدوياً (دالة جديدة)
709:   async removeAttendancePoints(userId: string, date: string): Promise<void> {
710:     const pointsRef = doc(db, "pointsHistory", userId, "days", date);
711:     const pointsSnap = await getDoc(pointsRef);
712: 
713:     if (pointsSnap.exists()) {
714:       const current = pointsSnap.data() as DailyPoints;
715:       const currentAttendancePoints = current.attendancePoints || 0;
716: 
717:       await updateDoc(pointsRef, {
718:         attendancePoints: 0,
719:         totalPoints: (current.totalPoints || 0) - currentAttendancePoints,
720:         attended: false
721:       });
722:     }
723:   }
724: };

813:   const col = collection(db, 'publicGallery');
814:   
815:   let q;
816:   if (lastVisible) {
817:     // جلب الصفحة التالية بعد آخر مستند
818:     q = query(col, orderBy('createdAt', 'desc'), startAfter(lastVisible), limit(pageSize));
819:   } else {
820:     // جلب الصفحة الأولى
821:     q = query(col, orderBy('createdAt', 'desc'), limit(pageSize));
822:   }
823:

825:   const items = snapshot.docs.map(d => d.data() as GalleryItem);
826:   const lastDoc = snapshot.docs[snapshot.docs.length - 1]; // نحتفظ بآخر مستند للصفحة التالية
827:   
828:   return { items, lastDoc };

884: // Cash Box Transactions Service
885: export const cashBoxTransactionsService = {
886:   // Get transactions for a specific cash box
887:   getTransactions: async (cashBoxId: string, limitCount: number = 50): Promise<CashBoxTransaction[]> => {
888:     try {
889:       const q = query(
890:         collection(db, "cashBoxTransactions"), 
891:         where("cashBoxId", "==", cashBoxId),
892:         orderBy("date", "desc"),
893:         orderBy("createdAt", "desc"),
894:         limit(limitCount)
895:       );
896:       const snapshot = await getDocs(q);
897:       return snapshot.docs.map(doc => ({
898:         id: doc.id,
899:         ...doc.data()
900:       } as CashBoxTransaction));
901:     } catch (error) {
902:       console.error("Error fetching transactions:", error);
903:       return [];
904:     }
905:   },
906: 
907:   // Subscribe to transactions
908:   subscribeToTransactions: (cashBoxId: string, callback: (transactions: CashBoxTransaction[]) => void, limitCount: number = 50) => {
909:     const q = query(
910:       collection(db, "cashBoxTransactions"), 
911:       where("cashBoxId", "==", cashBoxId),
912:       orderBy("date", "desc"),
913:       orderBy("createdAt", "desc"),
914:       limit(limitCount)
915:     );
916:     return onSnapshot(q, (snapshot) => {
917:       const transactions = snapshot.docs.map(doc => ({
918:         id: doc.id,
919:         ...doc.data()
920:       } as CashBoxTransaction));
921:       callback(transactions);
922:     });
923:   },
924: 
925:   // Add a new transaction and update cash box balance atomically
926:   addTransaction: async (transactionData: Omit<CashBoxTransaction, "id" | "createdAt" | "balanceAfter">): Promise<void> => {
927:     const cashBoxRef = doc(db, "cashBoxes", transactionData.cashBoxId);
928:     const transactionRef = doc(collection(db, "cashBoxTransactions"));
929:     
930:     await runTransaction(db, async (transaction) => {
931:       const cashBoxDoc = await transaction.get(cashBoxRef);
932:       if (!cashBoxDoc.exists()) {
933:         throw new Error("Cash Box does not exist!");
934:       }
935: 
936:       const cashBox = cashBoxDoc.data() as CashBox;
937:       
938:       // Calculate new balance
939:       let newBalance = cashBox.currentBalance;
940:       if (transactionData.type === 'deposit') {
941:         newBalance += transactionData.amount;
942:       } else if (transactionData.type === 'withdrawal') {
943:         newBalance -= transactionData.amount;
944:       } else if (transactionData.type === 'adjustment') {
945:         // Adjustments might be positive or negative, assuming amount is signed or handling type specific logic
946:         // For simplicity, let's assume 'adjustment' updates the balance by the amount (signed) or we treat it like deposit/withdrawal
947:         // If the user enters a negative amount for adjustment, it decreases. 
948:         // Let's stick to Requirements: logic says "Deposits increase", "Withdrawals decrease". Adjustment not strictly defined but usually signed.
949:         // Assuming user passes signed amount for adjustment or we handle it. 
950:         // Let's assume adjustment amount is what we ADD to the balance (can be negative).
951:         newBalance += transactionData.amount;
952:       }
953: 
954:       const now = new Date().toISOString();
955:       const newTransaction: CashBoxTransaction = {
956:         id: transactionRef.id,
957:         ...transactionData,
958:         createdAt: now,
959:         balanceAfter: newBalance
960:       };
961: 
962:       // Update Cash Box
963:       transaction.update(cashBoxRef, {
964:         currentBalance: newBalance,
965:         updatedAt: now
966:       });
967: 
968:       // Create Transaction
969:       transaction.set(transactionRef, newTransaction);
970:     });
971:   }
972: };

1189: // Items Service
1190: export const itemsService = {
1191:   // Check if HS Code is unique (Primary or Alternative)
1192: 
1193: 
1194:     getItemById: async (itemId: string): Promise<Item | null> => {
1195:     try {
1196:       const docRef = doc(db, "items", itemId);
1197:       const docSnap = await getDoc(docRef);
1198:       
1199:       if (docSnap.exists()) {
1200:         const data = docSnap.data();
1201:         return { 
1202:           id: docSnap.id, 
1203:           ...data,
1204:           // تأكد من تحويل التواريخ إذا كانت من نوع Timestamp
1205:           createdAt: data.createdAt?.toDate?.()?.toISOString() || data.createdAt,
1206:           updatedAt: data.updatedAt?.toDate?.()?.toISOString() || data.updatedAt
1207:         } as Item;
1208:       }
1209:       return null;
1210:     } catch (error) {
1211:       console.error("Error getting item:", error);
1212:       throw error;
1213:     }
1214:   },
1215:   
1216:   checkItemHsCodeUnique: async (hsCode: string, excludeItemId?: string): Promise<boolean> => {
1217:     if (!hsCode) return true;
1218:     
1219:     try {
1220:       // Check in hsCodePrimary
1221:       const q1 = query(collection(db, "items"), where("hsCodePrimary", "==", hsCode));
1222:       const snap1 = await getDocs(q1);
1223:       
1224:       const existsInPrimary = snap1.docs.some(doc => doc.id !== excludeItemId);
1225:       if (existsInPrimary) return false;
1226: 
1227:       // Check in hsCodeAlternative
1228:       const q2 = query(collection(db, "items"), where("hsCodeAlternative", "==", hsCode));
1229:       const snap2 = await getDocs(q2);
1230: 
1231:       const existsInAlternative = snap2.docs.some(doc => doc.id !== excludeItemId);
1232:       if (existsInAlternative) return false;
1233: 
1234:       return true;

1299: // Invoices Service
1300: export const invoicesService = {
1301:   subscribeToInvoices: (callback: (invoices: Invoice[]) => void) => {
1302:     // ترتيب حسب الرقم التسلسلي تنازلياً
1303:     const q = query(collection(db, "invoices"), orderBy("createdAt", "desc"));
1304:     return onSnapshot(q, (snapshot) => {
1305:       const invoices = snapshot.docs.map(doc => doc.data() as Invoice);
1306:       callback(invoices);
1307:     });
1308:   },
1309: 
1310:   getNextInvoiceNumber: async (): Promise<string> => {
1311:     try {
1312:       // 1. جلب آخر فاتورة تم إنشاؤها
1313:       const q = query(collection(db, "invoices"), orderBy("createdAt", "desc"), limit(1));
1314:       const snapshot = await getDocs(q);
1315: 
1316:       if (snapshot.empty) {
1317:         return "i-0001"; // أول رقم في حال عدم وجود فواتير
1318:       }
1319: 
1320:       const lastInvoice = snapshot.docs[0].data() as Invoice;
1321:       const lastNumberString = lastInvoice.invoiceNumber; // مثال: "i-0001"
1322:       
1323:       // إذا لم يكن هناك رقم فاتورة (تراثي)، نبدأ من جديد أو نتجاوز
1324:       if (!lastNumberString || !lastNumberString.startsWith('i-')) {
1325:          return "i-0001";
1326:       }
1327: 
1328:       // 2. استخراج الرقم وزيادته
1329:       const parts = lastNumberString.split('-');
1330:       if (parts.length === 2 && !isNaN(parseInt(parts[1]))) {
1331:         const nextNumber = parseInt(parts[1]) + 1;
1332:         // تنسيق الرقم الجديد ليكون 4 خانات (0006)
1333:         return `i-${nextNumber.toString().padStart(4, '0')}`;
1334:       }
1335: 
1336:       return `i-${Date.now().toString().slice(-4)}`;
1337:       
1338:     } catch (error) {
1339:       console.error("Error generating next invoice number:", error);
1340:       return "i-0001";
1341:     }
1342:   },
1343: 
1344:   addInvoiceToDb: async (invoice: Omit<Invoice, 'serialNumber'>) => {
1345:     // 1. توليد رقم الفاتورة إذا لم يكن موجوداً
1346:     let invoiceNumber = invoice.invoiceNumber;
1347:     if (!invoiceNumber) {
1348:         invoiceNumber = await invoicesService.getNextInvoiceNumber();
1349:     }
1350: 
1351:     // 2. تجهيز البيانات
1352:     const invoiceRef = doc(db, "invoices", invoice.id);
1353:     const newInvoice: any = {
1354:       ...invoice,
1355:       invoiceNumber,
1356:       // serialNumber لم يعد ضرورياً للعرض ولكن قد نحتاجه للتوافق، يمكننا استخدام نفس الرقم
1357:       serialNumber: invoiceNumber.replace('i-', ''),
1358:     };
1359: 
1360:     // دالة مساعدة لحذف الـ undefined
1361:     const removeUndefined = (obj: any) => JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(obj));
1362: 
1363:     await setDoc(invoiceRef, removeUndefined(newInvoice));
1364:   },
1365: 
1366:   updateInvoiceInDb: async (invoice: Invoice) => {
1367:     if (invoice.isHistorical) {
1368:       console.warn("Cannot update historical invoice");
1369:       // throw new Error("لا يمكن تعديل الفواتير المؤرشفة (Historical)");
1370:       // سنسمح بالتحديث الآن ولكن يمكننا إظهار تحذير في الواجهة
1371:     }
1372: 
1373:     const invoiceRef = doc(db, "invoices", invoice.id);
1374:     // دالة مساعدة لحذف الـ undefined
1375:     const removeUndefined = (obj: any) => JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(obj));
1376:     await updateDoc(invoiceRef, removeUndefined(invoice) as Record<string, any>);
1377:   },
1378: 
1379:   deleteInvoiceFromDb: async (invoiceId: string) => {
1380:     const invoiceRef = doc(db, "invoices", invoiceId);
1381:     await deleteDoc(invoiceRef);
1382:   }
1383: };

1388:   checkSupplierUniqueness: async (
1389:     data: { email?: string; phone?: string; mobile?: string },
1390:     currentSupplierId?: string
1391:   ): Promise<{ isUnique: boolean; field?: string; existingName?: string }> => {
1392:     try {
1393:       console.log("🔍 فحص تكرار بيانات المورد...");
1394: 
1395:       // 1. فحص البريد الإلكتروني
1396:       if (data.email && data.email.trim()) {
1397:         const cleanEmail = data.email.trim();
1398:         const q = query(collection(db, "suppliers"), where("email", "==", cleanEmail));
1399:         const snapshot = await getDocs(q);
1400:         
1401:         const duplicate = snapshot.docs.find(doc => doc.id !== currentSupplierId);
1402:         if (duplicate) {
1403:           return { isUnique: false, field: 'email', existingName: duplicate.data().tradeName };
1404:         }
1405:       }
1406: 
1407:       // 2. فحص رقم الهاتف
1408:       if (data.phone && data.phone.trim()) {
1409:         const cleanPhone = data.phone.trim();
1410:         const q = query(collection(db, "suppliers"), where("phone", "==", cleanPhone));
1411:         const snapshot = await getDocs(q);
1412:         
1413:         const duplicate = snapshot.docs.find(doc => doc.id !== currentSupplierId);
1414:         if (duplicate) {
1415:           return { isUnique: false, field: 'phone', existingName: duplicate.data().tradeName };
1416:         }
1417:       }
1418: 
1419:       // 3. فحص رقم الجوال
1420:       if (data.mobile && data.mobile.trim()) {
1421:         const cleanMobile = data.mobile.trim();
1422:         const q = query(collection(db, "suppliers"), where("mobile", "==", cleanMobile));
1423:         const snapshot = await getDocs(q);
1424:         
1425:         const duplicate = snapshot.docs.find(doc => doc.id !== currentSupplierId);
1426:         if (duplicate) {
1427:           return { isUnique: false, field: 'mobile', existingName: duplicate.data().tradeName };
1428:         }
1429:       }
1430: 
1431:       return { isUnique: true };
1432: 
1433:     } catch (error) {
1434:       console.error("❌ خطأ في فحص بيانات المورد:", error);
1435:       return { isUnique: true }; // السماح بالمرور في حالة الخطأ التقني لتجنب التعطيل
1436:     }
1437:   },
1438:

1447:   // تم التعديل: إنشاء رقم مورد تسلسلي تلقائياً
1448:   addSupplierToDb: async (supplier: Omit<Supplier, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt' | 'supplierId'>): Promise<Supplier> => {
1449:     // 1. جلب آخر مورد مرتباً حسب رقم المورد تنازلياً
1450:     const q = query(collection(db, "suppliers"), orderBy("supplierId", "desc"), limit(1));
1451:     const snapshot = await getDocs(q);
1452: 
1453:     let nextIdNumber = 1;
1454: 
1455:     if (!snapshot.empty) {
1456:       const lastSupplier = snapshot.docs[0].data() as Supplier;
1457:       // محاولة استخراج الرقم من آخر معرف (بافتراض أنه رقمي)
1458:       const lastIdParsed = parseInt(lastSupplier.supplierId, 10);
1459:       if (!isNaN(lastIdParsed)) {
1460:         nextIdNumber = lastIdParsed + 1;
1461:       }
1462:     }
1463: 
1464:     // تنسيق الرقم ليصبح 4 خانات (مثال: 0001, 0002)
1465:     const newSupplierId = String(nextIdNumber).padStart(4, '0');
1466: 
1467:     const id = crypto.randomUUID();
1468:     const now = new Date().toISOString();
1469: 
1470:     const newSupplier: Supplier = {
1471:       id,
1472:       ...supplier,
1473:       type: supplier.type || 'factory', // ضمان وجود النوع
1474:       supplierId: newSupplierId, // إسناد الرقم التلقائي
1475:       createdAt: now,
1476:       updatedAt: now
1477:     };
1478:     const supplierRef = doc(db, "suppliers", id);
1479:     await setDoc(supplierRef, newSupplier);
1480:     return newSupplier;
1481:   },
1482: 
1483:   updateSupplierInDb: async (supplier: Supplier) => {

1486:       ...supplier,
1487:       updatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
1488:     };
1489:     await updateDoc(supplierRef, removeUndefined(updatedSupplier) as Record<string, any>);
1490:   },

1495:   },

======= services\geminiService.ts =======
1: 
2: import { GoogleGenAI, Type } from "@google/genai";
3: import { Product, SearchQuery, GeminiAnalysis } from '../types';
4: 
5: const ai = new GoogleGenAI({ apiKey: process.env.API_KEY as string });
6: 
7: const fileToGenerativePart = async (file: File) => {
8:   const base64EncodedDataPromise = new Promise<string>((resolve) => {
9:     const reader = new FileReader();
10:     reader.onloadend = () => resolve((reader.result as string).split(',')[1]);
11:     reader.readAsDataURL(file);
12:   });
13:   return {
14:     inlineData: { data: await base64EncodedDataPromise, mimeType: file.type },
15:   };
16: };
17: 
18: /**
19:  * Pure Gemini Implementation
20:  * Analyzes the image/request and acts as the sourcing engine itself.
21:  * Returns structured analysis + recommended products based on AI knowledge.
22:  */
23: export const findProducts = async (query: SearchQuery): Promise<Product[]> => {
24:   try {
25:     const imagePart = await fileToGenerativePart(query.image);
26:     
27:     // We ask Gemini to act as the sourcing engine and generate realistic market data
28:     // since we removed the external eBay API.
29:     const promptText = `
30:       You are an expert product sourcing agent for Chinese markets (AliExpress, Alibaba, 1688).
31:       
32:       Analyze this product image and description: "${query.description}".
33:       Target Price: $${query.targetPrice}.
34: 
35:       1. Analyze the product visually (materials, features, probable manufacturing cost).
36:       2. Generate a list of 6-10 REALISTIC product recommendations that you would find in these markets.
37:       3. For each product, provide:
38:          - A realistic market title.
39:          - A price close to the target price (vary them slightly).
40:          - A store name (simulate realistic Chinese supplier names).
41:          - A similarity score (0-100) based on the user's request.
42:          - A realistic URL (use 'https://alibaba.com/search?q=KEYWORD' format).
43:       
44:       Output strictly in JSON format.
45:     `;
46: 
47:     const response = await ai.models.generateContent({
48:       model: "gemini-2.5-flash",
49:       contents: { parts: [imagePart, { text: promptText }] },
50:       config: {
51:         responseMimeType: "application/json",
52:         responseSchema: {
53:             type: Type.OBJECT,
54:             properties: {
55:                 marketAnalysis: { type: Type.STRING, description: "Brief analysis of the product sourcing feasibility" },
56:                 recommendedPriceRange: { type: Type.STRING, description: "e.g. $10 - $15" },
57:                 products: { 
58:                     type: Type.ARRAY,
59:                     items: {
60:                         type: Type.OBJECT,
61:                         properties: {
62:                             name: { type: Type.STRING },
63:                             price: { type: Type.NUMBER },
64:                             store: { type: Type.STRING },
65:                             similarity: { type: Type.NUMBER },
66:                             url: { type: Type.STRING },
67:                             description: { type: Type.STRING }
68:                         }
69:                     }
70:                 }
71:             }
72:         }
73:       },
74:     });
75: 
76:     if (!response.text) {
77:         throw new Error("Gemini failed to analyze the sourcing request.");
78:     }
79: 
80:     const data = JSON.parse(response.text) as GeminiAnalysis;
81: 
82:     // Post-process: Since AI cannot generate real hosted image URLs, 
83:     // we will use a placeholder service with the product name, or re-use the input image for the top match.
84:     // For UI purposes, we map the results to the Product interface.
85:     
86:     return data.products.map((p, index) => ({
87:         name: p.name,
88:         price: p.price,
89:         // We simulate different images for visual variety using a placeholder service
90:         imageUrl: index === 0 
91:             ? 'https://placehold.co/400x400/e2e8f0/1e293b?text=Best+Match' // Placeholder for top match (implies user image visually)
92:             : `https://placehold.co/400x400/f1f5f9/475569?text=${encodeURIComponent(p.name.substring(0, 20))}`,
93:         store: p.store,
94:         similarity: p.similarity,
95:         url: p.url,
96:         description: p.description
97:     }));
98: 
99:   } catch (error) {
100:     console.error("Error in Gemini sourcing workflow:", error);
101:     throw error;
102:   }
103: };


======= services\itemServiceHelpers.ts =======
1: import { Invoice, Supplier, Item } from '../types';
2: 
3: /**
4:  * جلب جميع الفواتير التي تحتوي على صنف معين
5:  */
6: export const getInvoicesByItem = (allInvoices: Invoice[], itemId: string): Invoice[] => {
7:   return allInvoices.filter(invoice => 
8:     invoice.items && invoice.items.some(invItem => invItem.itemId === itemId)
9:   );
10: };
11: 
12: /**
13:  * جلب جميع الموردين الذين تم شراء هذا الصنف منهم
14:  * يتم ذلك عن طريق البحث في الفواتير أولاً ثم استخراج الموردين
15:  */
16: export const getSuppliersByItem = (
17:   allInvoices: Invoice[], 
18:   allSuppliers: Supplier[], 
19:   itemId: string
20: ): { supplier: Supplier, lastPurchaseDate: string, totalQuantity: number }[] => {
21:   
22:   // 1. نجد الفواتير التي تحتوي الصنف
23:   const relevantInvoices = getInvoicesByItem(allInvoices, itemId);
24: 
25:   // 2. نقوم بتجميع البيانات حسب المورد
26:   const supplierMap = new Map<string, { lastDate: string, quantity: number }>();
27: 
28:   relevantInvoices.forEach(inv => {
29:     const itemInInvoice = inv.items.find(i => i.itemId === itemId);
30:     const qty = itemInInvoice ? Number(itemInInvoice.quantity) : 0;
31:     
32:     if (inv.supplierId) {
33:       const existing = supplierMap.get(inv.supplierId) || { lastDate: '', quantity: 0 };
34:       
35:       // تحديث آخر تاريخ شراء
36:       const invDate = inv.createdAt;
37:       const isNewer = !existing.lastDate || new Date(invDate) > new Date(existing.lastDate);
38:       
39:       supplierMap.set(inv.supplierId, {
40:         lastDate: isNewer ? invDate : existing.lastDate,
41:         quantity: existing.quantity + qty
42:       });
43:     }
44:   });
45: 
46:   // 3. نربط المعرفات ببيانات الموردين الكاملة
47:   const result: { supplier: Supplier, lastPurchaseDate: string, totalQuantity: number }[] = [];
48:   
49:   supplierMap.forEach((data, supplierId) => {
50:     const supplierObj = allSuppliers.find(s => s.id === supplierId);
51:     if (supplierObj) {
52:       result.push({
53:         supplier: supplierObj,
54:         lastPurchaseDate: data.lastDate,
55:         totalQuantity: data.quantity
56:       });
57:     }
58:   });
59: 
60:   return result;
61: };

======= services\notificationsService.ts =======
1: import { db } from "../firebaseConfig";
2: import {
3:     collection,
4:     query,
5:     where,
6:     onSnapshot,
7:     addDoc,
8:     updateDoc,
9:     doc,
10:     orderBy,
11:     limit,
12:     serverTimestamp,
13:     Timestamp
14: } from "firebase/firestore";
15: import { AppNotification } from "../types";
16: 
17: const COLLECTION_NAME = "notifications";
18: 
19: export const notificationsService = {
20:     // Subscribe to unread notifications for a user OR public notifications (all_managers)
21:     subscribeToNotifications: (userId: string, callback: (notifications: AppNotification[]) => void) => {
22:         // حماية: إذا لم يكن هناك معرف مستخدم، لا تقم بالاستعلام
23:         if (!userId) return () => { };
24: 
25:         const q = query(
26:             collection(db, COLLECTION_NAME),
27:             where("userId", "in", [userId, "all_managers"]),
28:             orderBy("createdAt", "desc"),
29:             limit(50)
30:         );
31: 
32:         return onSnapshot(q, (snapshot) => {
33:             const notifications = snapshot.docs.map((doc) => ({
34:                 id: doc.id,
35:                 ...doc.data(),
36:             })) as AppNotification[];
37: 
38:             // ⭐ الفلتر الجديد: إزالة أي تكرار بناءً على الـ ID
39:             const uniqueNotifications = Array.from(new Map(notifications.map(item => [item.id, item])).values());
40: 
41:             callback(uniqueNotifications);
42:         }, (error) => {
43:             console.error("Error fetching notifications:", error);
44:         });
45:     },
46: 
47:     // Add a new notification
48:     addNotification: async (notification: Omit<AppNotification, "id" | "createdAt" | "isRead">) => {
49:         try {
50:             await addDoc(collection(db, COLLECTION_NAME), {
51:                 ...notification,
52:                 isRead: false,
53:                 createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
54:             });
55:         } catch (error) {
56:             console.error("Error adding notification:", error);
57:         }
58:     },
59: 
60:     // Mark a notification as read
61:     markAsRead: async (notificationId: string) => {
62:         try {
63:             const docRef = doc(db, COLLECTION_NAME, notificationId);
64:             await updateDoc(docRef, {
65:                 isRead: true,
66:             });
67:         } catch (error) {
68:             console.error("Error marking notification as read:", error);
69:         }
70:     },
71: 
72:     // Mark all as read
73:     markAllAsRead: async (userId: string, notificationIds: string[]) => {
74:         try {
75:             const promises = notificationIds.map(id =>
76:                 updateDoc(doc(db, COLLECTION_NAME, id), { isRead: true })
77:             );
78:             await Promise.all(promises);
79:         } catch (error) {
80:             console.error("Error marking all notifications as read:", error);
81:         }
82:     }
83: };

======= services\pointsService.ts =======
1: import { 
2:   doc, 
3:   getDoc, 
4:   setDoc, 
5:   updateDoc, 
6:   collection, 
7:   query, 
8:   where, 
9:   getDocs,
10:   onSnapshot,
11:   Timestamp 
12: } from "firebase/firestore";
13: import { db } from "../firebaseConfig";
14: import { ActivityStatus, DailyPoints, PointsSystem } from "../types";
15: 
16: // إعدادات النظام الافتراضية
17: const DEFAULT_POINTS_SYSTEM: PointsSystem = {
18:   activityPointsPerClick: 1,
19:   taskPointsFast: 10,
20:   taskPointsNormal: 5,
21:   maxActivityPointsPerDay: 50
22: };
23: 
24: // --- خدمة حالة النشاط ---
25: export const activityService = {
26:   // تهيئة حالة النشاط للمستخدم
27:   async initializeActivityStatus(userId: string): Promise<void> {
28:     const activityRef = doc(db, "activityStatus", userId);
29:     const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
30:     
31:     const activityData: ActivityStatus = {
32:       userId,
33:       lastCheckIn: new Date().toISOString(),
34:       activeMinutesToday: 0,
35:       checkinClickCount: 0,
36:       isCurrentlyActive: true,
37:       checkInButtonEnabled: true,
38:       lastActivityCheck: new Date().toISOString()
39:     };
40:     
41:     await setDoc(activityRef, activityData);
42:   },
43: 
44:   // تسجيل ضغطة زر التأكيد
45:   async recordCheckIn(userId: string): Promise<{ success: boolean; points: number }> {
46:     const activityRef = doc(db, "activityStatus", userId);
47:     const activitySnap = await getDoc(activityRef);
48:     
49:     if (!activitySnap.exists()) {
50:       await this.initializeActivityStatus(userId);
51:     }
52: 
53:     const activityData = activitySnap.data() as ActivityStatus;
54:     
55:     // التحقق من أن الزر مفعل
56:     if (!activityData.checkInButtonEnabled) {
57:       throw new Error("نظام النقاط معطل لحسابك");
58:     }
59: 
60:     const now = new Date();
61:     const lastCheckIn = new Date(activityData.lastCheckIn);
62:     const timeDiff = now.getTime() - lastCheckIn.getTime();
63:     const minutesDiff = timeDiff / (1000 * 60);
64: 
65:     // منع الضغط المتكرر خلال أقل من دقيقة
66:     if (minutesDiff < 1) {
67:       return { success: false, points: 0 };
68:     }
69: 
70:     // تحديث البيانات
71:     const updates: Partial<ActivityStatus> = {
72:       lastCheckIn: now.toISOString(),
73:       checkinClickCount: activityData.checkinClickCount + 1,
74:       isCurrentlyActive: true,
75:       lastActivityCheck: now.toISOString()
76:     };
77: 
78:     await updateDoc(activityRef, updates);
79: 
80:     // تحديث النقاط اليومية
81:     const pointsEarned = DEFAULT_POINTS_SYSTEM.activityPointsPerClick;
82:     await this.updateDailyPoints(userId, pointsEarned, 0);
83: 
84:     return { success: true, points: pointsEarned };
85:   },
86: 
87:   // التحقق من النشاط التلقائي كل دقيقة
88:   async checkActivityStatus(userId: string): Promise<void> {
89:     const activityRef = doc(db, "activityStatus", userId);
90:     const activitySnap = await getDoc(activityRef);
91:     
92:     if (!activitySnap.exists()) return;
93: 
94:     const activityData = activitySnap.data() as ActivityStatus;
95:     const now = new Date();
96:     const lastCheckIn = new Date(activityData.lastCheckIn);
97:     const timeDiff = now.getTime() - lastCheckIn.getTime();
98:     const minutesDiff = timeDiff / (1000 * 60);
99: 
100:     if (minutesDiff > 10 && activityData.isCurrentlyActive) {
101:       // إيقاف النشاط بعد 10 دقائق بدون ضغط
102:       await updateDoc(activityRef, {
103:         isCurrentlyActive: false,
104:         lastActivityCheck: now.toISOString()
105:       });

160:   async calculateTaskPoints(taskId: string, startTime: string, endTime: string): Promise<number> {
161:     const start = new Date(startTime);
162:     const end = new Date(endTime);
163:     const timeDiff = end.getTime() - start.getTime();
164:     const minutesDiff = timeDiff / (1000 * 60);
165: 
166:     if (minutesDiff <= 30) {
167:       return DEFAULT_POINTS_SYSTEM.taskPointsFast;
168:     } else {
169:       return DEFAULT_POINTS_SYSTEM.taskPointsNormal;
170:     }
171:   },

242:         taskPoints: updates.taskPoints || 0,
243:         totalPoints: (updates.activityPoints || 0) + (updates.taskPoints || 0),
244:         checkinClicks: updates.checkinClicks || 0,
245:         completedTasks: updates.completedTasks || 0,
246:         attendancePoints: 0,
247:         attended: false
248:       };

47:       where("itemId", "==", itemId),

49:     );

54:   // دالة جديدة: جلب آخر سعر من مورد معين لصنف معين
55:   getLastSupplierPrice: async (supplierId: string, itemId: string): Promise<number> => {
56:     if (!supplierId || !itemId) return 0;
57:     
58:     try {
59:       const q = query(
60:         collection(db, "supplier_prices"),
61:         where("supplierId", "==", supplierId),
62:         where("itemId", "==", itemId),
63:         orderBy("date", "desc"),
64:         limit(1)
65:       );
66:       
67:       const snapshot = await getDocs(q);
68:       
69:       if (!snapshot.empty) {
70:         const priceRecord = snapshot.docs[0].data() as SupplierItemPrice;
71:         return priceRecord.price || 0;
72:       }
73:       
74:       return 0;
75:     } catch (error) {
76:       console.error("Error fetching last supplier price:", error);
77:       return 0;
78:     }
79:   },
80: 
81:   // دالة إضافية: جلب كل الأسعار من مورد معين لأصناف متعددة
82:   getSupplierPricesForItems: async (supplierId: string, itemIds: string[]): Promise<Record<string, number>> => {
83:     const prices: Record<string, number> = {};
84:     
85:     try {
86:       // إذا كانت هناك مجموعة كبيرة من الأصناف، يمكن تحسين هذا
87:       const q = query(
88:         collection(db, "supplier_prices"),
89:         where("supplierId", "==", supplierId),
90:         where("itemId", "in", itemIds.length > 0 ? itemIds : ['']), // Firestore requires non-empty array
91:         orderBy("date", "desc")
92:       );
93:       
94:       const snapshot = await getDocs(q);
95:       
96:       // تجميع أحدث سعر لكل صنف
97:       snapshot.docs.forEach(doc => {
98:         const priceRecord = doc.data() as SupplierItemPrice;
99:         if (!prices[priceRecord.itemId]) {
100:           prices[priceRecord.itemId] = priceRecord.price;
101:         }
102:       });
103:       
104:     } catch (error) {
105:       console.error("Error fetching supplier prices for items:", error);
106:     }
107:     
108:     return prices;
109:   },
110: 
111:   // دالة إضافية: جلب كل أسعار المورد (لتاريخ معين أو حديثة)

117:         orderBy("date", "desc"),
118:         limit(limitCount)
119:       );

122:       return snapshot.docs.map(doc => doc.data() as SupplierItemPrice);
123:     } catch (error) {
124:       console.error("Error fetching supplier all prices:", error);
125:       return [];
126:     }
127:   }

======= services\shipmentsPaymentService.ts =======
1: import {
2:     collection, query, where, orderBy, limit,
3:     addDoc, updateDoc, doc, getDocs, getDoc,

9: 
10: // Helper function to recursively remove undefined values (Firestore rejects them)
11: const scrubObject = (obj: any): any => {
12:     if (Array.isArray(obj)) return obj.map(scrubObject);
13:     if (obj !== null && typeof obj === 'object' && !(obj instanceof Timestamp)) {
14:         if (obj.type === 'serverTimestamp') {
15:             return serverTimestamp();
16:         }
17:         return Object.fromEntries(
18:             Object.entries(obj)
19:                 .filter(([_, v]) => v !== undefined)
20:                 .map(([k, v]) => [k, scrubObject(v)])
21:         );
22:     }
23:     return obj;
24: };
25: 
26: export const shipmentsPaymentService = {
27:     // حفظ الدفعات للشحنة
28:     async saveShipmentInstallments(
29:         shipmentId: string,
30:         installments: ShipmentInstallment[],
31:         installmentPlanEnabled: boolean,
32:         userId: string,
33:         userName: string
34:     ): Promise<void> {
35:         try {
36:             const shipmentRef = doc(db, 'shipments', shipmentId);
37:             const shipmentDoc = await getDoc(shipmentRef);
38: 
39:             if (!shipmentDoc.exists()) {
40:                 throw new Error('الشحنة غير موجودة');
41:             }
42: 
43:             const shipment = shipmentDoc.data() as Shipment;
44:             const totalAmount = shipment.totalShippingCostUsd || 0;
45: 
46:             const updatedInstallments = installments.map(inst => {
47:                 const amount = Math.round(((inst.percentage || 0) / 100) * totalAmount * 100) / 100;
48:                 return {
49:                     ...inst,
50:                     amount: amount,
51:                     updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
52:                     createdAt: inst.createdAt || serverTimestamp()
53:                 };
54:             });
55: 
56:             await updateDoc(shipmentRef, scrubObject({
57:                 installments: updatedInstallments,
58:                 installmentPlanEnabled: installmentPlanEnabled,
59:                 updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
60:                 updatedBy: userId
61:             }));
62: 
63:             console.log('✅ تم حفظ دفعات الشحنة:', {
64:                 shipmentId,
65:                 count: updatedInstallments.length,
66:                 enabled: installmentPlanEnabled
67:             });
68: 
69:         } catch (error) {
70:             console.error('Error saving shipment installments:', error);
71:             throw error;
72:         }
73:     },

75:     // إضافة دفعة جديدة (مطالبة)
76:     async addPayment(
77:         shipmentId: string,
78:         payment: Omit<ShipmentPayment, 'id'>,
79:         userId: string,
80:         userName: string,
81:         userRole: string
82:     ): Promise<string> {
83:         try {
84:             const shipmentRef = doc(db, 'shipments', shipmentId);
85:             const shipmentDoc = await getDoc(shipmentRef);
86: 
87:             if (!shipmentDoc.exists()) {
88:                 throw new Error('الشحنة غير موجودة');
89:             }
90: 
91:             const shipment = shipmentDoc.data() as Shipment;
92:             const paymentId = crypto.randomUUID();
93: 
94:             const cleanPayment = Object.fromEntries(
95:                 Object.entries(payment).filter(([_, v]) => v !== undefined)
96:             );
97: 
98:             const newPayment: ShipmentPayment = {
99:                 ...cleanPayment,
100:                 id: paymentId
101:             } as ShipmentPayment;
102: 
103:             const updatedPayments = [...(shipment.payments || []), newPayment];
104: 
105:             // حساب المبلغ المتبقي
106:             const totalPaid = updatedPayments.reduce((sum, p) => {
107:                 if (p.bankSwiftImage || p.confirmedBySupplier) return sum + (p.amount || 0);
108:                 return sum;
109:             }, 0);
110:             const remainingAmount = shipment.totalShippingCostUsd - totalPaid;
111: 
112:             // تحديث حالة الشحنة
113:             let newStatus: ShipmentStatus = shipment.status;
114:             if (shipment.status === 'draft') {
115:                 newStatus = 'payment_pending';
116:             }
117: 
118:             // تحديث حالة الدفعات (Installments)
119:             const updatedInstallments = (shipment.installments || []).map(inst => {
120:                 const instPayments = updatedPayments.filter(p => p.installmentId === inst.id);
121:                 const instTotalPaid = instPayments.reduce((sum, p) => {
122:                     if (p.bankSwiftImage || p.confirmedBySupplier) return sum + (p.amount || 0);
123:                     return sum;
124:                 }, 0);
125: 
126:                 let instStatus: 'unpaid' | 'partially_paid' | 'paid' | 'cancelled' = 'unpaid';
127:                 if (inst.status === 'cancelled') {
128:                     instStatus = 'cancelled';
129:                 } else {
130:                     if (instTotalPaid >= inst.amount * 0.99) instStatus = 'paid';
131:                     else if (instTotalPaid > 0) instStatus = 'partially_paid';
132:                 }
133: 
134:                 return {
135:                     ...inst,
136:                     status: instStatus,
137:                     paymentData: {
138:                         ...inst.paymentData,
139:                         amountPaid: instTotalPaid,
140:                         paymentId: instPayments.length > 0 ? instPayments[instPayments.length - 1].id : undefined,
141:                         paymentDate: instPayments.length > 0 ? instPayments[instPayments.length - 1].paymentDate : undefined
142:                     }
143:                 };
144:             });
145: 
146:             const updateData: any = {
147:                 payments: updatedPayments,
148:                 installments: updatedInstallments,
149:                 remainingAmount,
150:                 status: newStatus,
151:                 updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
152:                 updatedBy: userId
153:             };
154: 
155:             await updateDoc(shipmentRef, scrubObject(updateData));
156: 
157:             return paymentId;
158:         } catch (error) {
159:             console.error('Error adding shipment payment:', error);
160:             throw error;
161:         }
162:     },
163: 
164:     // رفع السليب مع الخصم من الصندوق

235:                     date: now,

305:                     return sum;

333:                             paymentId: instPayments.length > 0 ? instPayments[instPayments.length - 1].id : undefined,

32: // --- Helpers ---

34: // تنظيف الكائن من القيم undefined
35: const scrubObject = (obj: any): any => {
36:     if (Array.isArray(obj)) return obj.map(scrubObject);
37:     if (obj !== null && typeof obj === "object" && !(obj instanceof Timestamp)) {
38:         // إذا كان serverTimestamp نتركه كما هو
39:         if (obj && obj['_methodName'] === 'serverTimestamp') return obj;
40: 
41:         return Object.fromEntries(
42:             Object.entries(obj)
43:                 .filter(([_, v]) => v !== undefined && v !== null && v !== '') // تصفية القيم الفارغة
44:                 .map(([k, v]) => [k, scrubObject(v)])
45:         );
46:     }
47:     return obj;
48: };
49: // تحويل التواريخ من Firestore Timestamps إلى ISO Strings للواجهة
50: const processShipmentData = (docId: string, data: any): Shipment => {
51:     const convertDate = (date: any) => date?.toDate?.()?.toISOString() || date;
52: 
53:     return {
54:         id: docId,
55:         ...data,
56:         createdAt: convertDate(data.createdAt),
57:         updatedAt: convertDate(data.updatedAt),
58:         shippingInfo: data.shippingInfo ? {
59:             ...data.shippingInfo,
60:             departureDate: convertDate(data.shippingInfo.departureDate),
61:             arrivalDate: convertDate(data.shippingInfo.arrivalDate),
62:             shipmentStatus: data.shippingInfo.shipmentStatus ? {
63:                 ...data.shippingInfo.shipmentStatus,
64:                 statusDate: convertDate(data.shippingInfo.shipmentStatus.statusDate)
65:             } : undefined
66:         } : { shippingType: 'sea' },
67:         payments: data.payments?.map((p: any) => ({
68:             ...p,
69:             paymentDate: convertDate(p.paymentDate),
70:             paymentConfirmationDate: convertDate(p.paymentConfirmationDate),
71:             cashBoxWithdrawalAt: convertDate(p.cashBoxWithdrawalAt),
72:             confirmedAt: convertDate(p.confirmedAt)
73:         })) || [],
74:         installments: data.installments?.map((i: any) => ({
75:             ...i,
76:             dueDate: convertDate(i.dueDate),
77:             createdAt: convertDate(i.createdAt),
78:             updatedAt: convertDate(i.updatedAt),
79:             paymentData: i.paymentData ? {
80:                 ...i.paymentData,
81:                 paymentDate: convertDate(i.paymentData.paymentDate)
82:             } : undefined
83:         })) || []
84:     } as Shipment;
85: };
86: 
87: // حساب حالة الشحنة
88: const calculateShipmentStatus = (totalCost: number, payments: ShipmentPayment[]): ShipmentStatus => {
89:     if (!totalCost || totalCost <= 0) return 'draft';
90: 
91:     const totalPaid = payments
92:         .filter(p => p.confirmedBySupplier)
93:         .reduce((sum, p) => sum + (p.amount || 0), 0);
94: 
95:     const hasPendingPayments = payments.some(p => (p.bankSwiftImage || p.cashBoxWithdrawalAt) && !p.confirmedBySupplier);
96: 
97:     if (totalPaid >= totalCost * 0.99) return 'paid'; // هامش خطأ بسيط للعملات
98:     if (totalPaid > 0) return 'partially_paid';
99:     if (hasPendingPayments) return 'payment_pending';
100: 
101:     return 'draft'; // أو الحالة الحالية
102: };

151:         return deals.map(d => ({
152:             ...d,
153:             distributedCost: Math.round(((d.totalVolume / totalVolume) * totalCostUsd) * 100) / 100
154:         }));

256:     // 8. Update Payment with Swift & Withdraw from CashBox (Transactional)
257:     // This matches the logic from shipmentsPaymentService but fits into shipmentsService
258:     updatePaymentWithSwift: async (
259:         shipmentId: string,
260:         paymentId: string,
261:         updates: Partial<ShipmentPayment>,
262:         userId: string,
263:         userName: string,
264:         cashBoxId: string
265:     ): Promise<void> => {
266:         if (!cashBoxId) throw new Error('يجب اختيار صندوق مالي');
267:         if (!updates.bankSwiftImage) throw new Error('يجب رفع صورة السليب');
268: 
269:         try {
270:             await runTransaction(db, async (transaction) => {
271:                 // 1. Get Shipment
272:                 const shipmentRef = doc(db, COLLECTION_NAME, shipmentId);
273:                 const shipmentDoc = await transaction.get(shipmentRef);
274:                 if (!shipmentDoc.exists()) throw new Error('الشحنة غير موجودة');
275: 
276:                 const shipmentData = shipmentDoc.data() as Shipment;
277:                 const payments = shipmentData.payments || [];
278:                 const paymentIndex = payments.findIndex(p => p.id === paymentId);
279:                 if (paymentIndex === -1) throw new Error('الدفعة غير موجودة');
280: 
281:                 const payment = payments[paymentIndex];
282:                 if (payment.cashBoxWithdrawalAt) throw new Error('تم خصم هذه الدفعة بالفعل من الصندوق');
283: 
284:                 // 2. Get CashBox
285:                 const cashBoxRef = doc(db, CASH_BOXES_COLLECTION, cashBoxId);
286:                 const cashBoxDoc = await transaction.get(cashBoxRef);
287:                 if (!cashBoxDoc.exists()) throw new Error('الصندوق المالي غير موجود');
288: 
289:                 const cashBox = cashBoxDoc.data() as any;
290: 
291:                 // 3. Calculate Totals
292:                 const paymentAmount = updates.amount || payment.amount || 0;
293:                 const transferCost = updates.transferCost || payment.transferCost || 0;
294:                 const totalToWithdraw = paymentAmount + transferCost;
295: 
296:                 if (cashBox.currentBalance < totalToWithdraw) {
297:                     throw new Error(`الرصيد غير كافي في ${cashBox.name}! الرصيد المتاح: ${cashBox.currentBalance} ${cashBox.currency}`);
298:                 }
299: 
300:                 const now = new Date().toISOString();
301:                 const newBalance = cashBox.currentBalance - totalToWithdraw;
302: 
303:                 // 4. Create Transaction Records
304:                 const transactionsCol = collection(db, TRANSACTIONS_COLLECTION);
305: 
306:                 // Main Payment Transaction
307:                 const paymentTransactionRef = doc(transactionsCol);
308:                 const paymentTransactionId = paymentTransactionRef.id;
309:                 const paymentTransaction = {
310:                     id: paymentTransactionId,
311:                     cashBoxId: cashBoxId,
312:                     type: 'withdrawal',
313:                     amount: paymentAmount,
314:                     currency: cashBox.currency,
315:                     description: `دفع شحنة ${shipmentData.shipmentNumber || shipmentId}`,
316:                     reference: `SHIPMENT-${shipmentData.shipmentNumber}-PAYMENT-${paymentId}`,
317:                     date: now,
318:                     createdBy: userName,
319:                     userId: userId,
320:                     createdAt: serverTimestamp(),
321:                     balanceAfter: cashBox.currentBalance - paymentAmount,
322:                     relatedShipmentId: shipmentId,
323:                     relatedPaymentId: paymentId
324:                 };
325:                 transaction.set(paymentTransactionRef, scrubObject(paymentTransaction));
326: 
327:                 // Transfer Cost Transaction (if any)
328:                 let transferTransactionId = null;
329:                 if (transferCost > 0) {
330:                     const transferTransactionRef = doc(transactionsCol);
331:                     transferTransactionId = transferTransactionRef.id;
332:                     const transferTransaction = {
333:                         id: transferTransactionId,
334:                         cashBoxId: cashBoxId,
335:                         type: 'withdrawal',
336:                         amount: transferCost,
337:                         currency: cashBox.currency,
338:                         description: `تكلفة حوالة شحنة ${shipmentData.shipmentNumber}`,
339:                         reference: `SHIPMENT-${shipmentData.shipmentNumber}-PAYMENT-${paymentId}-TRANSFER`,
340:                         date: now,
341:                         createdBy: userName,
342:                         userId: userId,
343:                         createdAt: serverTimestamp(),
344:                         balanceAfter: newBalance,
345:                         relatedShipmentId: shipmentId,
346:                         relatedPaymentId: paymentId
347:                     };
348:                     transaction.set(transferTransactionRef, scrubObject(transferTransaction));
349:                 }
350: 
351:                 // 5. Update CashBox
352:                 transaction.update(cashBoxRef, {
353:                     currentBalance: newBalance,
354:                     updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
355:                     lastTransactionId: paymentTransactionId
356:                 });
357: 
358:                 // 6. Update Shipment Payment
359:                 const updatedPayment = {
360:                     ...payment,
361:                     ...updates,
362:                     cashBoxId: cashBoxId,
363:                     cashBoxName: cashBox.name,
364:                     cashBoxWithdrawalAt: now,
365:                     cashBoxWithdrawalBy: userName,
366:                     cashBoxTransactionIds: [
367:                         paymentTransactionId,
368:                         ...(transferTransactionId ? [transferTransactionId] : [])
369:                     ],
370:                     _cashBoxSettled: true
371:                 };
372: 
373:                 const newPayments = [...payments];
374:                 newPayments[paymentIndex] = updatedPayment;
375: 
376:                 // 7. Update Installments Status
377:                 let updatedInstallments = shipmentData.installments || [];
378:                 updatedInstallments = updatedInstallments.map(inst => {
379:                     const instPayments = newPayments.filter(p => p.installmentId === inst.id);
380:                     const instTotalPaid = instPayments.reduce((sum, p) => sum + (p.amount || 0), 0);
381: 
382:                     let instStatus = inst.status;
383:                     if (instTotalPaid >= inst.amount * 0.99) instStatus = 'paid';
384:                     else if (instTotalPaid > 0) instStatus = 'partially_paid';
385: 
386:                     return {
387:                         ...inst,
388:                         status: instStatus,
389:                         paymentData: {
390:                             ...inst.paymentData,
391:                             amountPaid: instTotalPaid,
392:                             paymentId: instPayments[instPayments.length - 1]?.id,
393:                             paymentDate: instPayments[instPayments.length - 1]?.paymentDate
394:                         }
395:                     };
396:                 });
397: 
398:                 // 8. Commit Shipment Update
399:                 transaction.update(shipmentRef, scrubObject({
400:                     payments: newPayments,
401:                     installments: updatedInstallments,
402:                     updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
403:                     updatedBy: userId
404:                 }));
405:             });
406:         } catch (error) {
407:             console.error("Error in updatePaymentWithSwift:", error);
408:             throw error;
409:         }
410:     },
411: 
412:     // 9. Confirm Payment (Supplier Confirmation)

415:         paymentId: string,
416:         userId: string,
417:         userName: string,

453:                     if (inst.id === p.installmentId) {
454:                         // Check total paid for this installment
455:                         const instPayments = payments.filter(pay => pay.installmentId === inst.id);
456:                         const totalPaid = instPayments.reduce((acc, curr) => acc + (curr.amount || 0), 0);
457: 
458:                         return {
459:                             ...inst,
460:                             status: totalPaid >= inst.amount * 0.99 ? 'paid' : 'partially_paid',
461:                             paymentData: { ...inst.paymentData, paymentConfirmationDate: confirmationDate }
462:                         };
463:                     }
464:                     return inst;
465:                 });
466:             }
467: 
468:             await updateDoc(shipmentRef, scrubObject({
469:                 payments: payments,
470:                 installments: installments,
471:                 status: newStatus,
472:                 updatedAt: serverTimestamp()
473:             }));
474: 
475:         } catch (error) {
476:             console.error("Error confirming payment:", error);
477:             throw error;
478:         }
479:     },
480: 
481:     // 10. Cancel Payment
482:     cancelPayment: async (shipmentId: string, paymentId: string, userId: string, userName: string): Promise<void> => {
483:         try {
484:             const shipmentRef = doc(db, COLLECTION_NAME, shipmentId);
485:             const shipmentDoc = await getDoc(shipmentRef);
486:             if (!shipmentDoc.exists()) throw new Error('الشحنة غير موجودة');
487: 
488:             const shipmentData = shipmentDoc.data() as Shipment;
489:             const payments = shipmentData.payments || [];
490: 
491:             // Note: If funds were withdrawn from cashbox, we are simply deleting the record here.
492:             // In a strict accounting system, you might want to create a refund transaction or block deletion.
493:             const updatedPayments = payments.filter(p => p.id !== paymentId);
494: 
495:             const newStatus = calculateShipmentStatus(shipmentData.totalShippingCostUsd || 0, updatedPayments);
496: 
497:             // Reset Installments
498:             let installments = shipmentData.installments || [];
499:             installments = installments.map(inst => {
500:                 const instPayments = updatedPayments.filter(p => p.installmentId === inst.id);
501:                 const instTotalPaid = instPayments.reduce((sum, p) => sum + (p.amount || 0), 0);
502: 
503:                 let status = inst.status;
504:                 if (instTotalPaid === 0) status = 'unpaid';
505:                 else if (instTotalPaid < inst.amount) status = 'partially_paid';
506: 
507:                 return {
508:                     ...inst,
509:                     status: status as any,
510:                     paymentData: instPayments.length > 0 ? {
511:                         paymentId: instPayments[instPayments.length - 1].id,
512:                         amountPaid: instTotalPaid,
513:                         paymentDate: instPayments[instPayments.length - 1].paymentDate
514:                     } : undefined
515:                 };
516:             });
517: 
518:             await updateDoc(shipmentRef, scrubObject({
519:                 payments: updatedPayments,
520:                 installments: installments,
521:                 status: newStatus,
522:                 updatedAt: serverTimestamp()
523:             }));
524: 
525:         } catch (error) {
526:             console.error("Error cancelling payment:", error);
527:             throw error;
528:         }
529:     },
530: 
531:     // 11. Delete Shipment
532:     deleteShipment: async (shipmentId: string): Promise<void> => {
533:         try {
534:             const { deleteDoc } = await import("firebase/firestore");
535:             const docRef = doc(db, COLLECTION_NAME, shipmentId);
536:             await deleteDoc(docRef);
537:         } catch (error) {
538:             console.error("Error deleting shipment:", error);
539:             throw error;
540:         }
541:     }
542: };

======= services\subCategoriesService.ts =======
1: import {
2:     collection,
3:     doc,
4:     setDoc,
5:     deleteDoc,
6:     updateDoc,
7:     onSnapshot,
8:     query,
9:     orderBy,
10:     where,
11:     getDocs
12: } from "firebase/firestore";
13: import { SubCategory } from "../types"; // 🔴 تأكد من مسار ملف الأنواع
14: import { db } from "@/firebaseConfig";
15: 
16: export const subCategoriesService = {
17:     // 1. اشتراك في الفئات الفرعية (Real-time Listener)
18:     subscribeToSubCategories: (callback: (subCategories: SubCategory[]) => void) => {
19:         // ترتيب النتائج حسب تاريخ الإنشاء تنازلياً
20:         const q = query(collection(db, "subCategories"), orderBy("createdAt", "desc"));
21: 
22:         return onSnapshot(q, (snapshot) => {
23:             const data = snapshot.docs.map((doc) => doc.data() as SubCategory);
24:             callback(data);
25:         }, (error) => {
26:             console.error("Error subscribing to sub-categories:", error);
27:         });
28:     },
29: 
30:     // 2. إضافة فئة فرعية جديدة
31:     addSubCategoryToDb: async (subCategory: SubCategory) => {
32:         try {
33:             // استخدام ID المرسل أو إنشاء واحد جديد إذا لم يوجد
34:             const id = subCategory.id || crypto.randomUUID();
35:             const subCategoryRef = doc(db, "subCategories", id);
36: 
37:             const newSubCategory = {
38:                 ...subCategory,
39:                 id,
40:                 createdAt: subCategory.createdAt || new Date().toISOString()
41:             };
42: 
43:             await setDoc(subCategoryRef, newSubCategory);
44:             console.log("Sub-category added successfully");
45:         } catch (error) {
46:             console.error("Error adding sub-category:", error);
47:             throw error;
48:         }
49:     },
50: 
51:     // 3. تحديث فئة فرعية
52:     updateSubCategoryInDb: async (subCategory: SubCategory) => {
53:         try {
54:             if (!subCategory.id) throw new Error("SubCategory ID is required for update");
55: 
56:             const subCategoryRef = doc(db, "subCategories", subCategory.id);
57:             await updateDoc(subCategoryRef, subCategory as any);
58:             console.log("Sub-category updated successfully");
59:         } catch (error) {
60:             console.error("Error updating sub-category:", error);
61:             throw error;
62:         }
63:     },
64: 
65:     // 4. حذف فئة فرعية
66:     deleteSubCategoryFromDb: async (id: string) => {
67:         try {
68:             const subCategoryRef = doc(db, "subCategories", id);
69:             await deleteDoc(subCategoryRef);
70:             console.log("Sub-category deleted successfully");
71:         } catch (error) {
72:             console.error("Error deleting sub-category:", error);
73:             throw error;
74:         }
75:     },
76: 
77:     // 5. (اختياري) جلب الفئات الفرعية التابعة لفئة رئيسية معينة (مرة واحدة بدون اشتراك)
78:     getSubCategoriesByParentId: async (categoryId: string): Promise<SubCategory[]> => {
79:         try {
80:             const q = query(
81:                 collection(db, "subCategories"),
82:                 where("categoryId", "==", categoryId)
83:             );
84:             const snapshot = await getDocs(q);
85:             return snapshot.docs.map(doc => doc.data() as SubCategory);
86:         } catch (error) {
87:             console.error("Error fetching sub-categories by parent:", error);
88:             return [];
89:         }
90:     }
91: };

======= services\supplierServiceHelpers.ts =======
1: import { Invoice, InvoiceItem, Supplier } from '../types';
2: 
3: /**
4:  * جلب جميع الفواتير الخاصة بمورد معين
5:  */
6: export const getInvoicesBySupplier = (allInvoices: Invoice[], supplierId: string): Invoice[] => {
7:   return allInvoices.filter(invoice => invoice.supplierId === supplierId);
8: };
9: 
10: /**
11:  * جلب جميع الأصناف التي تم شراؤها من مورد معين
12:  * يتم تجميع البيانات من الفواتير لاستخراج الأصناف الفريدة وحساب الكميات
13:  */
14: export const getItemsBySupplier = (
15:   allInvoices: Invoice[], 
16:   supplierId: string
17: ): { item: InvoiceItem, lastPurchaseDate: string, totalQuantity: number, totalSpent: number }[] => {
18:   
19:   // 1. نجد الفواتير الخاصة بالمورد
20:   const supplierInvoices = getInvoicesBySupplier(allInvoices, supplierId);
21: 
22:   // 2. تجميع الأصناف
23:   const itemsMap = new Map<string, { 
24:     itemData: InvoiceItem, 
25:     lastDate: string, 
26:     quantity: number,
27:     spent: number 
28:   }>();
29: 
30:   supplierInvoices.forEach(inv => {
31:     inv.items.forEach(invItem => {
32:       // نستخدم اسم الصنف كمعرف فريد إذا لم يكن هناك ID ثابت، أو نستخدم ID الصنف إذا توفر
33:       const key = invItem.itemId || invItem.name; 
34:       
35:       const existing = itemsMap.get(key) || { 
36:         itemData: invItem, 
37:         lastDate: '', 
38:         quantity: 0,
39:         spent: 0
40:       };
41: 
42:       // تحديث التاريخ للأحدث
43:       const invDate = inv.createdAt;
44:       const isNewer = !existing.lastDate || new Date(invDate) > new Date(existing.lastDate);
45: 
46:       itemsMap.set(key, {
47:         itemData: invItem, // نحتفظ بآخر بيانات للصنف
48:         lastDate: isNewer ? invDate : existing.lastDate,
49:         quantity: existing.quantity + Number(invItem.quantity || 0),
50:         spent: existing.spent + Number(invItem.totalPrice || 0)
51:       });
52:     });
53:   });
54: 
55:   // 3. تحويل Map إلى مصفوفة
56:   return Array.from(itemsMap.values()).map(data => ({
57:     item: data.itemData,
58:     lastPurchaseDate: data.lastDate,
59:     totalQuantity: data.quantity,
60:     totalSpent: data.spent
61:   }));
62: };

81: export const isTaskAssignedToUser = (task: Task, userId: string): boolean => {
82:     if (Array.isArray(task.assignedTo)) {
83:         return task.assignedTo.includes(userId);
84:     }
85:     return task.assignedTo === userId;
86: };

88: export const getUserSubmissions = (task: Task, userId: string): Submission[] => {
89:     return task.submissions?.filter(sub => sub.userId === userId) || [];
90: };
91: 
92: export const getUserTaskStatus = (task: Task, userId: string) => {
93:     const userSubmissions = getUserSubmissions(task, userId);
94: 
95:     if (userSubmissions.length > 0) {
96:         const latestSubmission = userSubmissions[userSubmissions.length - 1];
97:         return {
98:             hasSubmission: true,
99:             status: latestSubmission.status || 'pending',
100:             submissionCount: userSubmissions.length,
101:             latestSubmission: latestSubmission
102:         };
103:     }
104: 
105:     return {
106:         hasSubmission: false,
107:         status: 'not_started',
108:         submissionCount: 0,
109:         latestSubmission: null
110:     };
111: };
