======= utils\invoiceConversionUtils.ts =======
1: import { Deal, Shipment, Invoice, InvoiceItem, DealPayment, ShipmentPayment } from "../types";
2: 
3: /**
4:  * Calculates the effective exchange rate for a given total amount and payments.
5:  * 
6:  * Logic:
7:  * 1. Paid_USD = Sum of all USD payment amounts that are confirmed or have a bank swift.
8:  * 2. Paid_ILS = Sum of (Payment_Amount_USD * usdToIls_Rate) for those payments.
9:  * 3. Unpaid_USD = Total_USD - Paid_USD.
10:  * 4. Unpaid_ILS = Unpaid_USD * remainingBalanceRate.
11:  * 5. Effective_Rate = (Paid_ILS + Unpaid_ILS) / Total_USD.
12:  */
13: export const calculateEffectiveRate = (
14:     totalAmountUsd: number,
15:     payments: (DealPayment | ShipmentPayment)[],
16:     remainingBalanceRate: number
17: ): number => {
18:     if (totalAmountUsd <= 0) return remainingBalanceRate;
19: 
20:     let paidUsd = 0;
21:     let paidIls = 0;
22: 
23:     payments.forEach((p) => {
24:         // Only count payments that are actually executed (confirmed or swift uploaded)
25:         if (p.bankSwiftImage || p.confirmedBySupplier || (p as any).cashBoxWithdrawalAt) {
26:             paidUsd += p.amount || 0;
27:             paidIls += (p.amount || 0) * (p.usdToIls || 0);
28:         }
29:     });
30: 
31:     const unpaidUsd = Math.max(0, totalAmountUsd - paidUsd);
32:     const unpaidIls = unpaidUsd * remainingBalanceRate;
33: 
34:     const totalIlsValue = paidIls + unpaidIls;
35: 
36:     return totalIlsValue / totalAmountUsd;
37: };
38: 
39: /**
40:  * Prepares a partial Invoice object from a Deal and its parent Shipment.
41:  */
42: export const prepareInvoiceFromDeal = (
43:     deal: Deal,
44:     shipment: Shipment,
45:     dealRemainingRate: number,
46:     shipmentRemainingRate: number
47: ): Partial<Invoice> => {
48:     // 1. Calculate Effective Rate for the Deal (Items)
49:     const dealEffectiveRate = calculateEffectiveRate(
50:         deal.totalAmount,
51:         deal.payments || [],
52:         dealRemainingRate
53:     );
54: 
55:     // 2. Calculate Effective Rate for the Shipment (Shipping Cost)
56:     const shipmentEffectiveRate = calculateEffectiveRate(
57:         shipment.totalShippingCostUsd,
58:         shipment.payments || [],
59:         shipmentRemainingRate
60:     );
61: 
62:     // 3. Convert Items to NIS
63:     const nisItems: InvoiceItem[] = (deal.items || []).map((item) => {
64:         const unitPriceIls = item.unitPrice * dealEffectiveRate;
65:         return {
66:             ...item,
67:             id: crypto.randomUUID(), // New ID for invoice item
68:             unitPrice: Math.round(unitPriceIls * 100) / 100,
69:             totalPrice: Math.round(unitPriceIls * (item.quantity || 0) * 100) / 100,
70:         };
71:     });
72: 
73:     // 4. Calculate Subtotal in NIS
74:     const subtotalIls = nisItems.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.totalPrice, 0);
75: 
76:     // 5. Convert Shipping Cost to NIS
77:     // Logic updated:
78:     // a) Internal Shipping from Deal (e.g. within China) -> use Deal Rate
79:     const internalShippingUsd = deal.shippingCost || 0;
80:     const internalShippingIls = internalShippingUsd * dealEffectiveRate;
81: 
82:     // b) Global Shipping from Shipment (Distributed + Extra) -> use Shipment Rate
83:     const dealShipmentInfo = shipment.deals.find(d => d.dealId === deal.id);
84:     const distributedCostUsd = dealShipmentInfo?.distributedCost || 0;
85:     const extraCostsUsd = dealShipmentInfo?.extraCosts || 0;
86: 
87:     const globalShippingIls = (distributedCostUsd + extraCostsUsd) * shipmentEffectiveRate;
88: 
89:     // Total Shipping in NIS
90:     const totalShippingCostIls = Math.round((internalShippingIls + globalShippingIls) * 100) / 100;
91: 
92:     // 6. Final Invoice Construction
93:     const invoice: Partial<Invoice> = {
94:         invoiceNumber: `${deal.dealNumber}-INV`,
95:         supplierId: deal.supplierId,
96:         factoryName: deal.factoryName,
97:         dealId: deal.id,
98:         dealNumber: deal.dealNumber,
99:         items: nisItems,
100:         subtotal: subtotalIls,
101:         shippingCost: totalShippingCostIls,
102:         shippingIncluded: deal.shippingIncluded,
103:         discountAmount: Math.round((deal.discountAmount || 0) * dealEffectiveRate * 100) / 100,
104:         taxRate: deal.taxRate,
105:         taxType: deal.taxType,
106:         currency: 'ILS' as any, // Explicitly NIS
107:         invoiceDate: deal.dealDate || new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
108:         invoiceName: deal.internalNotes || '',
109:         supplierInvoiceNumber: deal.supplierInvoiceNumber || '',
110:         alibabaOrderLink: deal.alibabaOrderLink || '',
111:         notes: deal.internalNotes || '',
112:         status: 'incomplete',
113:         totalWeight: deal.totalWeight,
114:         totalVolume: deal.totalVolume,
115:         supplierSnapshot: deal.supplierSnapshot,
116:         quoteImages: deal.quoteImages || [],
117:         quotePdfs: deal.quotePdfs || [],
118:         conversionMetadata: {
119:             dealEffectiveRate,
120:             shipmentEffectiveRate,
121:             internalShippingUsd,
122:             globalShippingUsd: distributedCostUsd,
123:             extraCostsUsd: extraCostsUsd,
124:             totalUsd: deal.totalAmount,
125:             remainingBalanceRate: dealRemainingRate
126:         },
127:         dealInfo: {
128:             dealId: deal.id,
129:             dealNumber: deal.dealNumber,
130:             shippingMethod: deal.shippingMethod,
131:             paymentMethod: deal.paymentMethod,
132:             warrantyDuration: deal.warrantyDuration,
133:             certificates: deal.certificates,
134:             shipmentNotes: deal.shipmentNotes,
135:             productionDays: deal.productionDays,
136:             deliveryDays: deal.deliveryDays,
137:             createdBy: deal.createdBy,
138:             createdAt: deal.createdAt,
139:             alibabaOrderLink: deal.alibabaOrderLink,
140:             internalNotes: deal.internalNotes,
141:             firstPaymentDate: deal.firstPaymentDate,
142:             startedProductionAt: deal.startedProductionAt,
143:             originalStatus: deal.status,
144:             totalWeight: deal.totalWeight,
145:             totalVolume: deal.totalVolume,
146:             quoteImages: deal.quoteImages || [],
147:             quotePdfs: deal.quotePdfs || [],
148:             supplierSnapshot: deal.supplierSnapshot,
149:         } as any
150:     };
151: 
152:     // Recalculate Financials
153:     // 1. Discount is already converted
154:     const afterDiscount = Math.max(0, subtotalIls - (invoice.discountAmount || 0));
155: 
156:     // 2. Shipping Influence on Tax (if not included in price)
157:     const shippingToInclude = invoice.shippingIncluded ? 0 : totalShippingCostIls;
158:     const taxableBase = afterDiscount + shippingToInclude;
159: 
160:     let taxAmountIls = 0;
161:     if (invoice.taxType === 'amount') {
162:         // If tax was a fixed USD amount in the deal, convert it using deal rate
163:         taxAmountIls = Math.round((deal.taxAmount || 0) * dealEffectiveRate * 100) / 100;
164:     } else {
165:         // If tax is a percentage, calculate it from the new NIS taxable base
166:         taxAmountIls = taxableBase * ((invoice.taxRate || 0) / 100);
167:     }
168: 
169:     invoice.taxAmount = Math.round(taxAmountIls * 100) / 100;
170:     invoice.grandTotal = Math.round((taxableBase + taxAmountIls) * 100) / 100;
171: 
172:     return invoice;
173: };
